### [1] [Domain-level metacognitive monitoring in frontier LLMs: A 33-model atlas](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06673)
*Jon-Paul Cacioli*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 针对33个前沿LLM在MMLU六域上的元认知监控研究（47,151观测值）发现，聚合指标掩盖了显著的域级变异：应用/专业知识最易监控，自然科学和形式推理最难监控，六域分组仅为实用基准分类而非潜在结构，且探针格式具有特异性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 聚合元认知质量分数掩盖了MMLU基准域内的模型变异，需要在域级别探索LLM的元认知监控能力差异。

Method: 对来自8个模型家族的33个前沿LLM进行测试，每个模型在6个MMLU域（每域250题）上作答，使用口头置信度（0-100）计算每个模型-域单元的Type-2 AUROC，同时进行主体层面一致性分析、族内配置形状聚类分析、探针格式特异性验证。共47,151个观测值。

Result: 所有高于随机水平的聚合监控模型都显示出非平凡的域级变异：应用/专业知识域最易监控（平均AUROC=.742，21/33模型排名前2），形式推理和自然科学最难（27/33模型排名后2）；中间三域统计上无法区分（Kendall's W=.164）。族内配置形状聚类在Anthropic、Google-Gemini、Qwen显著（p<.0001）但DeepSeek、Google-Gemma、OpenAI不显著。Bootstrap 95%CI中位宽度.199，聚合分半稳定性r=.893，配置级分半稳定性较弱（总中位数r=.184）。

Conclusion: 研究结果表明，聚合指标会掩盖基准域的稳定变异性，支持在特定应用领域部署前进行基准阶段域筛选。6域分组是务实的基准分类法而非经验证的潜在结构，不同模型家族在配置形状聚类上存在差异，探针格式特异性得到验证。

Abstract: Aggregate metacognitive quality scores mask within-model variation across MMLU benchmark domains. We administered 1,500 MMLU items (250 per domain, under an a priori six-domain grouping) to 33 frontier LLMs from eight model families and computed Type-2 AUROC per model-domain cell using verbalized confidence (0-100). Total observations: 47,151. Every model with above-chance aggregate monitoring showed non-trivial domain-level variation. Applied/Professional knowledge was reliably the easiest benchmark domain to monitor (mean AUROC = .742, ranked top-2 in 21 of 33 models); Formal Reasoning and Natural Science were reliably the hardest (one of the two ranked bottom-2 in 27 of 33 models). The three middle domains were statistically indistinguishable (Kendall's W = .164). A subject-level coherence analysis (within-domain similarity ratio = 0.95) confirms the six-domain grouping is a pragmatic benchmark taxonomy, not a validated latent construct. Within-family profile-shape clustering is significant for Anthropic, Google-Gemini, and Qwen (permutation p < .0001) but not DeepSeek, Google-Gemma, or OpenAI. Gemma 4 31B showed a +.202 AUROC improvement over Gemma 3 27B. Three models classified Invalid on binary KEEP/WITHDRAW probes produced normal profiles under verbalized confidence, confirming probe-format specificity. Bootstrap 95% CIs on 198 cells have median width .199. Split-half aggregate stability r = .893; profile-level split-half is weaker (grand median r = .184). These results show stable benchmark-domain variation obscured by aggregate metrics, and support benchmark-stage domain screening as a step before deployment in specific application areas.

</details>


### [2] [VITA-QinYu: Expressive Spoken Language Model for Role-Playing and Singing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06765)
*Jiacheng Xu,Heting Gao,Liufei Xie,Zhenchuan Yang,Lijiang Li,Yiting Chen,Bin Zhang,Meng Chen,Chaoyu Fu,Weifeng Zhao,Wenjiang Zhou*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: VITA-QinYu是首个端到端口语语言模型，支持自然对话、角色扮演和歌唱三种表达模式。采用混合语音-文本范式结合多码本音频令牌实现丰富表达性，通过15.8K小时合成数据训练。在角色扮演和歌唱任务上显著超越同类模型，同时保持最先进的对话能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类语音传达超越语言内容的表达性，包括个性、情绪或表演元素（如安慰性语调或哼唱歌曲），这些被形式化为角色扮演和歌唱。当前的口语语言模型（SLM）仅支持自然对话，缺乏对这些表达性功能的支持。

Method: 采用混合语音-文本范式，扩展了交错式文本-音频建模，使用多码本音频令牌，设计实现了更丰富的副语言表示，同时保持模态间的清晰分离以避免干扰。开发了综合数据生成流程，合成总计15.8K小时的数据用于训练。

Result: 在角色扮演客观基准上超越同类SLM 7个百分点；在5分制MOS歌唱评分上超越同类模型0.13分；在C3和URO对话基准上分别超越先前SLM 1.38和4.98个百分点，达到最先进的对话准确性和流畅性。

Conclusion: VITA-QinYu是首个支持角色扮演和歌唱生成的端到端表达性口语语言模型。代码和模型已开源，提供流式和全双工交互的完整演示支持。

Abstract: Human speech conveys expressiveness beyond linguistic content, including personality, mood, or performance elements, such as a comforting tone or humming a song, which we formalize as role-playing and singing. We present VITA-QinYu, the first expressive end-to-end (E2E) spoken language model (SLM) that goes beyond natural conversation to support both role-playing and singing generation. VITA-QinYu adopts a hybrid speech-text paradigm that extends interleaved text-audio modeling with multi-codebook audio tokens, a design enabling richer paralinguistic representation while preserving a clear separation between modalities to avoid interference. We further develop a comprehensive data generation pipeline to synthesize a total of 15.8K hours of natural conversation, role-playing, and singing data for training. VITA-QinYu demonstrates superior expressiveness, outperforming peer SLMs by 7 percentage points on objective role-playing benchmarks, and surpassing peer models by 0.13 points on a 5-point MOS scale for singing. Simultaneously, it achieves state-of-the-art conversational accuracy and fluency, exceeding prior SLMs by 1.38 and 4.98 percentage points on the C3 and URO benchmarks, respectively. We open-source our code and models and provide an easy-to-use demo with full-stack support for streaming and full-duplex interaction.

</details>


### [3] [IntentGrasp: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Intent Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06832)
*Yuwei Yin,Chuyuan Li,Giuseppe Carenini*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: IntentGrasp是一个用于评估大语言模型(LLM)意图理解能力的综合基准测试，基于49个高质量开源语料库构建，涵盖12个领域，包含262,759条训练样本和两个评估集。当前主流模型在该基准上表现不佳(All Set低于60%，Gem Set低于25%)，且提出的意图微调(IFT)方法能显著提升模型性能，提升超过30个F1分数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前LLM助手在理解用户意图方面仍有明显不足，缺乏专门的基准来系统评估和改进这一关键能力。

Method: 通过语料库筛选、意图标签情境化和任务格式统一三个步骤构建基准；提出意图微调(IFT)方法对模型进行微调训练。

Result: 20个LLM在基准上表现欠佳，17/20模型在Gem Set上不如随机猜测(15.2%)；IFT方法在All Set上提升30+ F1分数，在Gem Set上提升20+分数；留一域实验证明IFT具有强跨领域泛化能力。

Conclusion: 意图理解是LLM发展的关键方向，IFT是提升该能力的有效途径，对构建更智能、安全的AI助手具有重要意义。

Abstract: Accurately understanding the intent behind speech, conversation, and writing is crucial to the development of helpful Large Language Model (LLM) assistants. This paper introduces IntentGrasp, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating the intent understanding capability of LLMs. Derived from 49 high-quality, open-licensed corpora spanning 12 diverse domains, IntentGrasp is constructed through source datasets curation, intent label contextualization, and task format unification. IntentGrasp contains a large-scale training set of 262,759 instances and two evaluation sets: an All Set of 12,909 test cases and a more balanced and challenging Gem Set of 470 cases. Extensive evaluations on 20 LLMs across 7 families (including frontier models such as GPT-5.4, Gemini-3.1-Pro, and Claude-Opus-4.7) demonstrate unsatisfactory performance, with scores below 60% on All Set and below 25% on Gem set. Notably, 17 out of 20 tested models perform worse than a random-guess baseline (15.2%) on Gem Set, while the estimated human performance is ~81.1%, showing substantial room for improvement. To enhance such ability, this paper proposes Intentional Fine-Tuning (IFT), which fine-tunes the models on the training set in IntentGrasp, yielding significant gains of 30+ F1 points on All Set and 20+ points on Gem Set. Tellingly, the leave-one-domain-out (Lodo) experiments further demonstrate the strong cross-domain generalizability of IFT, verifying that it is a promising approach to substantially enhancing the intent understanding of LLMs. Overall, by benchmarking and boosting intent understanding ability, this study sheds light on a promising path towards more intentional, capable, and safe AI assistants for human benefits and social good.

</details>


### [4] [TajPersLexon: A Tajik-Persian Lexical Resource and Hybrid Model for Cross-Script Low-Resource NLP](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06886)
*Mullosharaf K. Arabov*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文发布了包含40,112词对的Tajik-Persian平行词汇资源TajPersLexon，用于低资源跨脚本检索场景。实验表明神经和检索方法可达到98-99%准确率，且轻量级混合模型在OCR纠正任务中以96.4%准确率提供了最佳的准确率-效率权衡，验证了该任务的可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Tajik语和Persian语之间的跨脚本词汇检索、对齐和OCR后纠正在实际应用中具有重要价值，但现有大型多语言模型在此低资源跨脚本场景下表现不佳。

Method: 采用三类方法进行基准测试：（i）轻量级混合管道，（ii）神经序列到序列模型，（iii）检索方法。所有实验在CPU-only环境下进行，使用固定随机种子以确保完全可复现。

Result: 神经和检索基线达到98-99%的top-1准确率；混合模型在OCR后纠正任务中达到96.4%的准确率，且具有更好的效率表现。

Conclusion: TajPersLexon在低资源跨脚本词汇匹配任务中是可行的；混合模型在准确率和效率之间取得了最佳平衡（OCR任务达96.4%）；大型多语言句子Transformer在此任务上反而失败；代码和数据将公开以确保可复现性。

Abstract: This work introduces TajPersLexon, a curated Tajik--Persian parallel lexical resource of 40,112 word and short-phrase pairs for cross-script lexical retrieval, transliteration, and alignment in low-resource settings. We conduct a comprehensive CPU-only benchmark comparing three methodological families: (i) a lightweight hybrid pipeline, (ii) neural sequence-to-sequence models, and (iii) retrieval methods. Our evaluation establishes that the task is essentially solvable, with neural and retrieval baselines achieving 98-99% top-1 accuracy. Crucially, we demonstrate that while large multilingual sentence transformers fail on this exact lexical matching, our interpretable hybrid model offers a favorable accuracy-efficiency trade-off for practical applications, achieving 96.4% accuracy in an OCR post-correction task. All experiments use fixed random seeds for full reproducibility. The dataset, code, and models will be publicly released.

</details>


### [5] [MIST: Multimodal Interactive Speech-based Tool-calling Conversational Assistants for Smart Homes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06897)
*Maximillian Chen,Xuanming Zhang,Michael Peng,Zhou Yu,Alexandros Papangelis,Yohan Jo*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了MIST，一个用于评估多模态大语言模型在语音驱动IoT设备控制任务上的合成数据集，发现当前模型在该领域存在显著差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实世界IoT设备的语音控制面临独特挑战：需同时处理时空约束、语音输入、动态状态追踪和混合主动交互模式，但现有研究对此关注不足。

Method: 构建了MIST数据集——一个多轮、语音驱动的IoT代码生成任务，并开发了可扩展的数据生成框架。

Result: 开闭源多模态LLM之间存在显著差距，即使是前沿闭源LLM仍有较大提升空间。

Conclusion: MIST及数据生成框架的发布将推动物理世界约束推理的混合主动语音助手研究。

Abstract: The rise of Internet of Things (IoT) devices in the physical world necessitates voice-based interfaces capable of handling complex user experiences. While modern Large Language Models (LLMs) already demonstrate strong tool-usage capabilities, modeling real-world IoT devices presents a difficult, understudied challenge which combines modeling spatiotemporal constraints with speech inputs, dynamic state tracking, and mixed-initiative interaction patterns. We introduce MIST (the Multimodal Interactive Speech-based Tool-calling Dataset), a synthetic multi-turn, voice-driven code generation task that operates over IoT devices. We find that there is a significant gap between open- and closed-weight multimodal LLMs on MIST, and that even frontier closed-weight LLMs have substantial headroom. We release MIST and an extensible data generation framework to build related datasets in order to facilitate research on mixed-initiative voice assistants which reason about physical world constraints.

</details>


### [6] [Cognitive Agent Compilation for Explicit Problem Solver Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07040)
*Hyeongdon Moon,Carolyn Rosé,John Stamper*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出认知智能体编译(CAC)框架，利用强教师LLM将问题解决知识编译为显式目标智能体，以解决通用LLM在教育场景中缺乏可解释性和可控性的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前LLM因广泛预训练而难以约束，不适合需要可控性的教育场景。教育系统需要可检查和可编辑的知识状态：教育者需了解系统假设学习者掌握的知识，学习者需系统能基于显式技能、错误概念和策略进行推理。

Method: 受认知架构启发，提出CAC框架，将(i)知识表示、(ii)问题解决策略、(iii)验证与更新规则三者分离。使用强教师LLM将问题解决知识编译为显式目标智能体。使用小型语言模型实现早期概念验证。

Result: 展示了关键设计权衡，特别是在显式控制与可扩展泛化之间的矛盾。证明了使用小型语言模型进行概念验证的可行性。

Conclusion: CAC作为迈向教育应用边界知识AI的初步尝试，旨在使有限问题解决在教育场景中更具可检查性和可编辑性。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are widely used for tutoring, feedback generation, and content creation, but their broad pretraining makes them hard to constrain and poor substitutes for controllable learners. Educational systems often require inspectable and editable knowledge states: educators want to know what a system assumes the learner knows, and learners benefit when the system can justify actions in terms of explicit skills, misconceptions, and strategies. Inspired by cognitive architectures, we propose Cognitive Agent Compilation (CAC), a framework that uses a strong teacher LLM to compile problem-solving knowledge into an explicit target agent. CAC separates (i) knowledge representation, (ii) problem-solving policy, and (iii) verification and update rules, with the goal of making bounded problem solving more inspectable and editable in educational settings. We present an early proof of concept implemented with Small Language Models that surfaces key design trade-offs, particularly between explicit control and scalable generalization, and positions CAC as an initial step toward bounded-knowledge AI for educational applications.

</details>


### [7] [Reflections and New Directions for Human-Centered Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06901)
*Caleb Ziems,Dora Zhao,Rose E. Wang,Matthew Jörke,Ahmad Rushdi,Advit Deepak,Sunny Yu,Anshika Agarwal,Harshvardhan Agarwal,Gabriela Aranguiz-Dias,Aditri Bhagirath,Justine Breuch,Huanxing Chen,Ruishi Chen,Sarah Chen,Haocheng Fan,William Fang,Cat Gonzales Fergesen,Daniel Frees,Tian Gao,Ziqing Huang,Vishal Jain,Yucheng Jiang,Kirill Kalinin,Su Doga Karaca,Arpandeep Khatua,Teland La,Isabelle Levent,Miranda Li,Xinling Li,Yongce Li,Angela Liu,Minsik Oh,Nathan J. Paek,Anthony Qin,Emily Redmond,Michael J. Ryan,Aadesh Salecha,Xiaoxian Shen,Pranava Singhal,Shashanka Subrahmanya,Mei Tan,Irawadee Thawornbut,Michelle Vinocour,Xiaoyue Wang,Zheng Wang,Henry Jin Weng,Pawan Wirawarn,Shirley Wu,Sophie Wu,Yichen Xie,Patrick Ye,Sean Zhang,Yutong Zhang,Cathy Zhou,Yiling Zhao,James Landay,Diyi Yang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个"以人为中心的大型语言模型"(HCLLMs)开发框架，整合了NLP、HCI和负责任AI的视角，强调在模型开发的每个阶段（从系统设计到部署）都应认真对待人类关切、偏好、价值观和目标，而不仅仅是在后期训练阶段简单处理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着LLM在商业、教育、金融、医疗、法律、科学等领域的全球影响力日益增强，单纯追求技术能力已不足够，必须在模型开发的每个阶段将人类优先事项纳入考量。

Method: 整合NLP、HCI和负责任AI三个领域的研究视角，提出覆盖整个开发流程的以人为中心的框架，涵盖系统设计、数据获取、模型训练、评估和负责任部署等各个阶段。

Result: 提供了一套覆盖模型开发生命周期各阶段的以人为中心的洞察和建议。

Conclusion: 通过一个关于HCLLMs与未来工作关系的案例研究，展示了该框架的应用价值和实际意义。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly shaping the private and professional lives of users, with numerous applications in business, education, finance, healthcare, law, and science. With this rise in global influence comes greater urgency to build, evaluate, and deploy these systems in a manner that prioritizes not only technical capabilities but also human priorities. This work presents a framework for developing Human-Centered Large Language Models (HCLLMs), which integrates perspectives from Natural Language Processing (NLP), Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), and responsible AI. Considering the ethics, economics, and technical objectives of language modeling, we argue that model developers need to address human concerns, preferences, values, and goals, not only during a cursory post-training stage, but rather with rigor and care at every stage of the pipeline. This paper offers human-centered insights and recommendations for developers at each stage, from system design to data sourcing, model training, evaluation, and responsible deployment. Then we conclude with a case study, applying these insights to understand the future of work with HCLLMs.

</details>


### [8] [MELD: Multi-Task Equilibrated Learning Detector for AI-Generated Text](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06903)
*Chenjun Li,Cheng Wan,Johannes C. Paetzold*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: MELD是一个用于AI生成文本检测的多任务均衡学习框架，通过在主检测任务上附加生成器家族、攻击类型和源域的辅助头来学习更丰富的表示，并使用EMA教师-攻击增强学生蒸馏和硬负样本排序损失提升鲁棒性。推理时仅保留主检测头，接口与普通检测器相同。在RAID排行榜上表现最强，在自建评估集MELD-eval上达到99.9% TPR（1% FPR）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有检测器多针对单一AI/Human二分类目标优化，当该目标趋于饱和时，模型缺乏动力学习生成器、攻击类型或领域结构。这导致检测器在面对对抗攻击、跨生成器迁移、以及低假阳性率场景下性能急剧下降，无法满足实际部署需求。

Method: MELD采用多任务学习架构：共享编码器连接四个输出头（主检测头+生成器家族/攻击类型/源域三个辅助头），通过学习到的同方差不确定性权重平衡四项损失。训练策略包括：(1) EMA教师在干净输入上预测，攻击增强的学生模型蒸馏至教师；(2) 硬负样本成对排序损失扩大AI文本与易混淆人类文本的分数间距。推理时丢弃所有辅助头，仅保留主检测头。

Result: 在公开RAID排行榜上，MELD是最强的开源检测器，与领先的商业模型具有竞争力，尤其在对抗攻击和低FPR场景下优势明显。在标准保留基准和自建的MELD-eval（新发布聊天模型的评估池）上，MELD无需额外微调即可达到99.9% TPR（1% FPR），而多数基线方法显著退化。

Conclusion: 通过多任务辅助监督学习生成器、攻击和领域结构，结合蒸馏和硬负样本优化，MELD实现了鲁棒、通用且低FPR的AI文本检测。移除辅助头后保持轻量接口，兼具高性能与实用性。

Abstract: Large language models are now embedded in everyday writing workflows, making reliable AI-generated text detection important for academic integrity, content moderation, and provenance tracking. In practice, however, a detector must do more than achieve high aggregate AUROC on clean, in-distribution human and AI text: it should remain robust to attacks and adversarial rewrites, transfer to unseen generators and domains, and operate at low false-positive rates (FPR). Most existing detectors optimize a single AI/Human objective, giving the representation little incentive to learn generator, attack, or domain structure once the binary task saturates. We introduce MELD (Multi-Task Equilibrated Learning Detector), a deployable detector for AI-generated text that enriches binary detection with auxiliary supervision. MELD attaches generator-family, attack-type, and source-domain heads to a shared encoder, and balances the four losses with learned homoscedastic uncertainty weights. To improve robustness, an EMA teacher predicts on clean inputs while an attack-augmented student is distilled toward the teacher. MELD further uses a hard-negative pairwise ranking loss to enlarge the score margin between AI-generated texts and the most confusable human texts. At inference, all auxiliary heads are discarded, giving MELD the same interface and cost as a standard detector. On the public RAID leaderboard, MELD is the strongest open-source detector and is competitive with leading commercial models, especially under attack and at low FPR. Across standard held-out benchmarks, MELD matches or outperforms supervised baselines. We further introduce MELD-eval, a held-out evaluation pool built from recent chat models released by four major LLM providers. *Behzad Shayegh,Mohamed Osama Ahmed,Fred Tung,Leo Feng*

Abstract: Large language models have demonstrated impressive retrieval-augmented capabilities. However, a crucial area remains underexplored: their ability to appropriately adapt responses to the certainty of the retrieved information. It is a limitation with real consequences in high-stakes domains like medicine and finance. We evaluate eight LLMs on their context-certainty obedience, measuring how well they adjust responses to match expressed context certainty. Our analysis reveals systematic limitations: LLMs struggle to recall prior knowledge after observing an uncertain context, misinterpret expressed certainties, and overtrust complex contexts. To address these, we propose an interaction strategy combining prior reminders, certainty recalibration, and context simplification. This approach reduces obedience errors by 25% on average, without modifying model weights, demonstrating the efficacy of interaction design in enhancing LLM reliability. Our contributions include a principled evaluation metric, empirical insights into LLMs' uncertainty handling, and a portable strategy to improve context-certainty obedience across diverse LLMs.

</details>

*Souvik Pramanik,S. M. Riaz Rahman Antu,Shak Mohammad Abyad,Md. Ibrahim Khalil,Md. Shahriar Hussain*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究介绍了MultiSoc-4D——一个孟加拉语社交媒体数据集基准，包含58K+条来自六个平台的评论，采用四维度标注（类别、情感、仇恨言论、讽刺）。研究揭示了LLM在低资源语言标注中存在严重的标签崩塌问题：偏好默认标签导致高假阳性一致率和大量漏检，讽刺检测一致性接近随机水平。该问题在40+个不同架构的LLM中普遍存在。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前LLM自动标注是扩展NLP数据集的核心方法，但针对低资源语言的闭集指令场景下，LLM的行为特征尚未得到充分研究。该研究旨在填补这一空白。

Result: 发现LLM存在"指令诱导的标签崩塌"现象——系统性偏好回退标签（Other、Neutral、No），导致标注一致率虚高但漏检大量少数类别。相比人工校准参考，LLM分别漏检79%和75%的仇恨言论和讽刺内容。讽刺检测的Fleiss' Kappa近乎为零（κ≈-0.001），验证了这是一种"标签一致性幻觉"。在40+个LLM中的基准测试表明，该偏差在不同架构中普遍存在。

Conclusion: 该研究揭示了LLM在低资源语言标注任务中存在系统性的标注偏差问题，提出了"指令诱导的标签崩塌"现象，发现该问题在不同架构的40+个LLM中普遍存在。MultiSoc-4D数据集的发布为Bengali NLP社区提供了重要的诊断基准资源。

Abstract: Annotation automation via Large Language Models (LLMs) is the core approach for scaling NLP datasets; however, LLM behavior with respect to closed-set instructions in low-resource languages has not been well studied. We present MultiSoc-4D, a Bengali social media dataset benchmark, which contains 58K+ social media comments from six sources annotated along four dimensions: category, sentiment, hate speech, and sarcasm. By employing a structured pipeline where ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, and Grok individually annotate separate partitions, while sharing a common validation set of 20%, we diagnose LLM behavior systematically. We discover a prevalent phenomenon called "instruction-induced label collapse", wherein LLMs show a systematic preference towards fallback labels (Other, Neutral, No), leading to high agreement rates but under-detection of minority categories. For example, we find that LLMs failed to detect 79% and 75% of instances with hateful and sarcastic content compared to a human-calibrated reference. Furthermore, we prove that it represents a "label agreement illusion", statistically validated via almost null Fleiss' Kappa ($κ\approx -0.001$) on sarcasm detection. Across 40+ LLMs, we benchmark this annotation bias propagation within the training pipeline, regardless of architectural differences. We release MultiSoc-4D as a diagnostic benchmark for annotation biases in Bengali NLP.

</details>


### [11] [Group of Skills: Group-Structured Skill Retrieval for Agent Skill Libraries](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06978)
*Kun Zeng,Yu Huo,Siyu Zhang,Zi Ye,Yuecheng Zhuo,Haoyue Liu,Yuquan Lu,Junhao Wen,Xiaoying Tang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: GoSkills通过将技能检索对象从扁平技能列表转变为带角色标签的执行上下文，解决现有技能检索方法中技能内部角色不明确的问题。该方法构建以锚点为中心的技能组，通过组图扩展支持组，将选定组计划压缩为有限的原子技能负载，并生成包含Start、Support、Check、Avoid字段的固定执行契约。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有技能增强型智能体依赖大型可重用技能库，但传统检索方法返回原子技能或依赖感知的捆绑包，其内部角色不明确。智能体需要自行推断执行入口、支持技能、可见需求和故障规避指导，这增加了使用复杂性和出错风险。

Method: GoSkills是一种推理时组结构化检索方法，包含四个核心步骤：1)从类型化技能图构建以锚点为中心的技能组；2)通过组图扩展支持组；3)将选定组计划瓶颈化为有限的原子技能负载；4)渲染包含Start、Support、Check、Avoid字段的固定执行契约。该方法无需更改下游智能体、技能负载或执行环境。

Result: 在SkillsBench和ALFWorld基准上的实验表明：GoSkills在小技能预算下保持可见需求覆盖；优于扁平技能访问基线；相比结构化检索参考方法，通常能提升奖励和智能体单独运行时间。

Conclusion: GoSkills有效解决了技能检索中的角色隐式问题，通过组结构化检索和执行契约渲染，为智能体提供了清晰的技能执行上下文，在保持系统兼容性的同时提升了任务性能和运行效率。

Abstract: Skill-augmented agents increasingly rely on large reusable skill libraries, but retrieving relevant skills is not the same as presenting usable context. Existing methods typically return atomic skills or dependency-aware bundles whose internal roles remain implicit, leaving the agent to infer the execution entry point, support skills, visible requirements, and failure-avoidance guidance. We introduce Group of Skills (GoSkills), an inference-time group-structured retrieval method that changes the agent-facing retrieval object from a flat skill list to a compact, role-labeled execution context. GoSkills builds anchor-centered skill groups from a typed skill graph, expands support groups through a group graph, bottlenecks the selected group plan into a bounded set of atomic skill payloads, and renders a fixed execution contract with Start, Support, Check, and Avoid fields, without changing the downstream agent, skill payloads, or execution environment. Experiments on SkillsBench and ALFWorld show that GoSkills preserves visible-requirement coverage under a small skill budget, improves over flat skill-access baselines, and often improves reward and agent-only runtime relative to structural retrieval references.

</details>


### [12] [Towards Closing the Autoregressive Gap in Language Modeling via Entropy-Gated Continuous Bitstream Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07013)
*Georgios Batzolis,Mark Girolami,Luca Ambrogioni*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: The paper proposes bitstream diffusion language modeling, representing text as continuous binary bitstreams with entropy-rate gated stochastic sampling, achieving state-of-the-art results among diffusion language models while eliminating the O(V) vocabulary scaling bottleneck.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Diffusion language models (DLMs) offer parallel, order-agnostic generation but historically lag autoregressive models in sample quality and diversity. While recent continuous flow approaches over token embeddings have narrowed this gap, the paper seeks to further close the autoregressive gap through a novel representation.

Method: 1) Represent semantic tokens as fixed-width analog bit sequences; 2) Matched-filter residual parameterization to isolate contextual learning from analytic independent-bit posteriors; 3) Stochastic sampler applying Langevin-type corrections gated by entropy-rate profile

Result: On LM1B (130M parameters): GenPPL=59.76 at entropy 4.31 using 256 NFEs, outperforming prior DLM baselines and reaching autoregressive reference. On OWT: GenPPL=27.06 at entropy 5.26 using 4× fewer steps than previous 1024-NFE baselines, establishing a new continuous-DLM Pareto frontier.

Conclusion: Bitstream diffusion represents text as binary bitstreams with a matched-filter residual parameterization, using a stochastic sampler with Langevin-type entropy-rate gated corrections. This approach removes the O(V) vocabulary scaling bottleneck by predicting O(log V) bitwise logits via semantic bit-patching.

Abstract: Diffusion language models (DLMs) promise parallel, order-agnostic generation, but on standard benchmarks they have historically lagged behind autoregressive models in sample quality and diversity. Recent continuous flow and diffusion approaches over token embeddings have narrowed this gap, suggesting continuous state spaces are highly effective for language. In this work, we further close the autoregressive gap by modeling text as a continuous diffusion process over fixed-width binary bitstreams. Our approach represents semantic tokens as analog bit sequences and utilizes a matched-filter residual parameterization to isolate contextual learning from analytic independent-bit posteriors. Crucially, we adopt a stochastic sampler that applies Langevin-type corrections gated by the entropy-rate profile, automatically concentrating stochasticity in high-information regions while remaining nearly deterministic elsewhere. On the One Billion Word Benchmark (LM1B), our 130M-parameter bitstream model reaches a generative perplexity ($\GenPPL$) of $59.76$ at matched real-data entropy ($4.31$) using 256 neural function evaluations (NFEs), decisively outperforming prior DLM baselines and reaching the autoregressive reference. On OpenWebText (OWT), our stochastic sampler establishes a new continuous-DLM Pareto frontier, achieving $\GenPPL=27.06$ at an entropy of $5.26$ using $4\times$ fewer steps than previous 1024-NFE baselines. As an additional architectural benefit, bitstream diffusion removes the $\mathcal{O}(V)$ vocabulary scaling bottleneck shared by standard DLMs. By predicting $\mathcal{O}(\log V)$ bitwise logits via semantic bit-patching, our model yields a reduced memory footprint and higher throughput, demonstrating a scalable paradigm for language generation as vocabulary sizes grow.

</details>


### [13] [TCMIIES: A Browser-Based LLM-Powered Intelligent Information Extraction System for Academic Literature](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07507)
*Hanqing Zhao*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: TCMIIES是一个基于浏览器的零安装平台，利用商业LLM API从学术文献中进行结构化信息提取。该系统通过图形界面让研究人员无需编程即可定义自定义提取模式，同时确保数据隐私（纯前端架构本地处理），支持五个主要LLM提供商，实现并发批处理和自动重试机制。评估表明，在中医药研究中结构化输出合规率超过94%，信息提取准确率与领域专家标注相当。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 学术出版物呈指数级增长，现有解决方案存在以下问题：需要专用基础设施、编程专业知识、或需微调的领域特定模型，给专业领域研究人员设置了较高门槛。需要一种既易于使用又能保护隐私且成本效益高的自动化工具来从非结构化科学文本中提取结构化知识。

Method: 1) 纯前端架构实现本地隐私保护；2) 创新性的模式引导提示框架，支持自动系统提示生成；3) 直观的图形界面让用户无需编程即可定义自定义提取模式；4) 支持五大LLM提供商；5) 实现并发批处理与自动重试机制；6) 针对CNKI、万方等中文学术数据库提供智能字段映射功能。

Result: 在中医药研究多个提取场景的综合评估中，结构化输出合规率超过94%，信息提取准确率与领域专家标注水平相当。

Conclusion: TCMIIES为专业领域（尤其是中医药研究）的学术信息提取提供了一个实用、可访问的解决方案，有效弥合了先进LLM能力与领域特定学术信息提取需求之间的差距。该系统具有灵活性、隐私保护性和成本效益，特别适合需要定制化提取工具的专业研究人员。

Abstract: The exponential growth of academic publications has created an urgent need for automated tools capable of extracting structured knowledge from unstructured scientific texts. While large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in natural language understanding and information extraction, existing solutions often require specialized infrastructure, programming expertise, or fine-tuned domain-specific models that create barriers for researchers in specialized fields. This paper presents TCMIIES, a browser-based, zero-installation platform that leverages commercial LLM APIs to perform structured information extraction from academic literature. The system employs a novel schema-guided prompting framework with automatic system prompt generation, enabling researchers to define custom extraction schemas through an intuitive graphical interface without any programming. TCMIIES features a pure front-end architecture that ensures data privacy by processing all information locally in the browser, supports five major LLM providers, implements concurrent batch processing with automatic retry mechanisms, and provides intelligent field mapping for Chinese academic databases including CNKI and Wanfang. We demonstrate the system's effectiveness through comprehensive evaluation across multiple extraction scenarios in Traditional Chinese Medicine research, achieving structured output compliance rates exceeding 94\% and information extraction accuracy comparable to domain-expert annotation. The system represents a practical, accessible solution that bridges the gap between advanced LLM capabilities and domain-specific academic information extraction needs, particularly for researchers in specialized fields who require flexible, privacy-preserving, and cost-effective extraction tools.

</details>


### [14] [NSMQ Riddles: A Benchmark of Scientific and Mathematical Riddles for Quizzing Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07051)
*George Boateng,Naafi Ibrahim,Samuel John,Philemon Badu,Patrick Agyeman-Budu,Jonathan Mensah,Kevin Yeboah,William Edor,Andrew Mensa-Onumah,Nana Yeboah,Victor Wumbor-Apin Kumbol*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 NSMQ Riddles 基准：从加纳国家科学与数学竞赛（NSMQ）第五轮"谜语（riddles）"环节采集的 11 年、共 1,840 道科学与数学谜语（每题至少 3 条线索，平均约 5 条），答案为数字/单词/短短语，支持自动精确匹配评估。对 6 个前沿模型（GPT-5.4、Gemini 3.1 Pro、Claude Opus 4.6、Kimi-K2.5、DeepSeek-V3.1、GPT-OSS-120B，各设高/低推理档）的"离线全线索"与"实时代理（逐块线索+置信度）"两种评测显示：离线最佳 EM 86.54%（GPT-5.4 high），实时代理最佳 EM 75.64%/366 分，仍低于最佳学生选手的 78.21% EM/377 分；化学科最弱（最佳 EM ≤75%，其他学科 >90%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LLM 科学/数学教育评测存在两大缺口：一是数据集几乎全部来自西方语境，Global South（尤其非洲）教育场景被严重边缘化（GPT-4 发布时所有学术基准均无非洲来源），造成地理偏差、限制对模型真实能力与教育落地价值的判断；二是这些基准普遍采用多选题（multiple-choice），选项形式便于自动评分，却大幅降低了任务难度，无法反映真实知识运用的精细度与推理深度。NSMQ 竞赛第五轮谜语环节恰好具备两个关键特性：西非（WASSCE 课程体系：加纳、尼日利亚、冈比亚、塞拉利昂、利比里亚）本地化的高中科学（生物/化学/物理/数学）内容，以及"逐步披露线索、抢答计分"的谜语式短答案结构，既具真实难度又可自动评估。因此需要一个来自全球南方、结构新颖且足够难的科学与数学推理基准。

Method: 数据构建：从 YouTube 公开比赛录像与合作高中获取 PDF 版题目与答案（含学科、场次、年份元数据），用 Mathpix OCR 转 Markdown 并将公式转为 LaTeX，逐份人工比对校正，StackEdit 清理格式，脚本转为 CSV（列含 Clue 1–9、Answer 及多种答案变体、Subject/Contest/Year 等）。答案变体人工构造：去 Markdown 标记、拆分"或"并列答案、符号名与全称互转（如 SO2 / Sulphur (IV) Oxide；hydrogen / H2），最多 4 个纯文本答案。预处理：小写化、去标点、修正空白、去冠词，构建 riddle→answer 映射。另外在 Google Sheet 中人工整理 2019（156 题）、2020（160 题）比赛元数据（日期、参赛学校、哪所学校在第几条线索答对），因资源限制仅这两年完整。评测设置：系统提示将模型设为"science prodigy"，CoT 推理、规定只输出短答案并设"额外文本扣分"惩罚、少样本示例、要求 JSON 输出。指标：主指标 Exact Match（EM），辅以 Fuzzy Match（FM，双向子串匹配，如 tissue/tissues 记为 True）；因竞赛只接受精确答案故以 EM 为主。两种模式：(1) 离线——拼接全部线索一次输入；(2) 实时代理——按每 7 词（对应 5 秒音频转写）的片段逐步喂入，模型同时返回 answer 与 confidence（sure / not sure），不确定则追加下一片段直至给出最终答案，并据答对线索序号换算分数（第1条5分、第2条4分、第3条及以后3分）。API：开放模型用 Together AI，闭源模型用 LangChain 封装 OpenAI，temperature=1，max_tokens=20000。LLM-学生对比仅在 2019 年 156 题上进行。

Result: 离线评测（2019, n=156）：闭源整体优于开源，高推理档普遍优于低推理档；最佳为 GPT-5.4(high) EM 86.54% / FM 91.03%，GPT-5.4(low) 85.90%，Claude Opus 4.6(high) 84.62%，Gemini 3.1(high) 83.97%；开源最好为 GPT-OSS-120B(high) 83.33%、Kimi-K2.5 80.77%、DeepSeek-V3.1 76.28%。FM 普遍高于 EM，说明模型答案"接近但不够精确"。学科分解显示化学是最短板（最佳 EM ≤75%，其他学科最佳 >90%）：失败模式包括泛化化回答（"alkane" 代替 "Cyclohexane"、"amino acid" 代替 "2-Aminoethanoic acid"、"base" 代替 "Milk of Magnesia"）、混淆相邻概念（"kinetic theory of gases" 代替 "Charles' Law"、"free radical substitution" 代替 "Chlorination of methane"）、过度简化有机物命名。实时代理评测：整体性能显著下降，最佳 GPT-5.4(high) EM 75.64% / FM 81.41% / 366 分 / 平均第 4.38 条线索答对；仍低于最佳学生队伍 EM 78.21% 与 377 分（学生无法计算 FM）。模型间出现"抢答时机"的权衡：Claude Opus 4.6 与 GPT-OSS-120B 倾向最早抢答（平均约 3.2–3.4 条线索），虽离线成绩不错，实时成绩显著下滑（Claude 降至约 51–53% EM，GPT-OSS 约 46–47%）；Kimi-K2.5、DeepSeek-V3.1 通常等到第 4 条线索以后再答。总体结论：现有 SOTA LLM 尚不及最优秀的高中生选手，在真实赛制下极可能落败，且真实部署还会受到音频切块长度、转写错误与延迟的额外负面影响。

Conclusion: NSMQ Riddles 填补了全球南方科学与数学推理评测的空白：它提供了首个以谜语为结构的科学/数学短答案基准（1.8K 题，11 年，跨四学科），既是文化与课程语境多元化的代表，也是可自动精确/模糊匹配的严格评测工具。结果显示该基准对当前 SOTA LLM 构成实质挑战（离线 86.54%、实时 75.64%，均低于最佳学生），尤其暴露模型在化学有机物与专有术语精确性上的缺陷，以及在信息不完整、不确定条件下"何时抢答"的决策能力不足。论文据此指出未来需要提升 LLM 在不确定性下的科学推理能力，以支撑面向全球南方学生的 AI 辅导与教育应用。局限：实时代理仅覆盖 2019 年一年、缺音频标注仅是代理而非真实实时评测、题目公开于 YouTube 存在数据污染风险（未做去污染分析）；未来工作包括扩展年份标注、基于音频的实时评测、标注 NSMQ 其他轮次以构建更难更全面的基准，以及开展去污染分析。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown good performance on various science educational benchmarks, demonstrating their potential for use in science and mathematics education. Yet, LLMs tend to be evaluated on science and mathematical educational datasets from the Western world, with an underrepresentation of datasets from the Global South. Furthermore, they tend to have multiple-choice answer options that are trivial to evaluate. In this work, we present NSMQ Riddles, a novel benchmark of Scientific and Mathematical Riddles from Ghana's National Science and Maths Quiz (NSMQ) competition to evaluate LLMs. The NSMQ is an annual live TV competition for senior secondary school students in Ghana that brings together the smartest high school students in Ghana who compete in teams of 2 by answering questions in biology, chemistry, physics, and math over five rounds and five stages until a winning team is crowned for that year. NSMQ Riddles consists of 11 years of riddle questions (n=1.8K) from the 5th round, with each riddle containing a minimum of 3 clues. Students compete to be the first to guess the answer on any of the clues, with earlier clues being vague and also fetching more points. The answers are usually a number, word, or short phrase, allowing for automatic evaluation. ### [15] [GSM-SEM: Benchmark and Framework for Generating Semantically Variant Augmentations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07053)
*Jyotika Singh,Fang Tu,Aziza Mirzadova,Amit Agarwal,Hitesh Laxmichand Patel,Sandip Ghoshal,Miguel Ballesteros,Yassine Benajiba,Weiyi Sun,Graham Horwood,Sujith Ravi,Dan Roth*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: GSM-SEM 是一个"生成—验证—过滤"的随机化、可复用框架，通过改写题目中的实体、属性和关系来构造高语义方差但答案与计算过程保持不变的 GSM8K 变体；作者发布三个经完全人工校验的数据集（GSM8K-SEM、GSM-Symbolic-SEM、GSM-Plus-SEM），并在 14 个 SOTA LLM 上发现一致且统计显著的性能下降（最严格配置下平均降幅约 28%），证明当前模型的数学推理能力对语义变化仍高度敏感。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GSM8K 等基准因被反复用于训练混合与衍生资源，排行榜分数可能更多反映记忆/污染而非真实推理能力；现有鲁棒性变体（改写、实体替换、数字替换、插入干扰句）大多只保留原题的事实骨架与关系结构，语义方差低，只能测试表层不变性而非对新语义条件的适应性；同时静态发布的变体本身也会随时间成为记忆目标。已有鲁棒性评测多集中在较老或较小模型，而新一代 SOTA 模型的退化幅度是否仍然显著尚不清楚。

Method: 流水线四步：(1) 双路语义变体生成——Curation#1 以答案与解题过程为条件"逆向工程"新问题（如把"细菌感染"改为"病毒传播"），Curation#2 在固定全部数值的前提下改写情景/主题；随后用规则校验器确认变体中的数值与原题完全一致以剔除数值漂移。(2) 自动化质量验证：先用 70 条样本人工标注反推 LLM-judge 提示词（GPT-4o 判断答案与问题是否匹配，temp 0.01），生成阶段使用 Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct、Llama-4-Maverick/Scout、GPT-4.1、GPT-4o 五个模型，temp 0.5。(3) 基于词频余弦相似度的冗余剪枝：与原题及已保留变体的相似度阈值 τ=0.85，并做集合级去重。(4) 严格度过滤：用留出模型集 M_hold={Llama-3.3-70B, GPT-4o, GPT-4o-mini} 计算跨模型一致性 cm，全模型一致答对的样本视为"过易"，要求其相似度落在窗口 [α,β] 内，提供 none/min/min-med/med/med-max/max 六档配置（主文采用 med 0.40–0.60）。数据集基于与 GSM-Symbolic 相同的 100 道 GSM8K 原题，每题生成 10 个变体，最终 GSM8K-SEM 685 条、GSM-Symbolic-SEM 2525 条、GSM-Plus-SEM 1436 条，全部经两人独立（阶段二三人投票）人工校验，质量通过率 96.1%、逻辑一致性 99.4%。评测采用零样本、每样本至少 5 次运行取平均，答案判定结合规则数值抽取与 LLM-as-a-judge（GPT-4.1），指标为 Acc、ΔAcc、PDR，并配合 Wilcoxon 检验；另将框架迁移至 BigBenchHard、LogicBench、NLR-BIRD。

Result: med 配置下 14/14 模型在所有 SEM 变体上均显著低于基线（p<0.05）：GSM8K-SEM 平均降幅 4.02%（PDR 3.28%），GSM-Symbolic-SEM 8.28%，GSM-Plus-SEM 13.53%；最严格（max）配置下降可达 12.00%/26.24%/27.68%（平均降幅约 28%）。语义扰动与 symbolic/plus 扰动叠加时退化最显著，说明二者考察的是不同泛化维度；余弦相似度分布显示 GSM8K-SEM 的语义偏移明显大于改写、GSM-Symbolic 与 GSM-Plus，且模型准确率随相似度升高而提升。推理型模型（O3、Gemini-2.5-Pro、GPT-5.x）相对非推理模型仅有边际优势，退化是普遍性的。失败模式包括间接化表述增加认知负荷、单位/币种线索引发量级错误、参照式改写破坏状态跟踪、微小语义偏移触发解题模板误检索、过度复杂化以及在温度 0 下稳定复现的错误；部分变体反而优于原题（因原题存在如"4 周"等歧义，变量澄清了假设）。质量筛选中还发现即使改变了数字、需要新计算的题目模型仍给出原正确答案，提示存在记忆现象。域外实验中 BigBenchHard（2022 年发布）出现约 5% 下降，LogicBench 几乎无下降，2025 年 11 月发布的 NLR-BIRD 无下降，与"发布时间越早越易被记忆"的推断一致。

Conclusion: GSM-SEM 提供了可反复运行、答案保持不变的高语义方差基准变体生成方案，可降低对静态测试集的依赖与记忆偏置，并可与既有鲁棒性套件组合用于叠加式鲁棒性评测。结论是当前 SOTA 模型在仅改变叙事语义、数值与答案保持不变的条件下仍显著退化，说明现有 GSM 榜单成绩高估了真实推理鲁棒性。局限性：最适用于含问题、答案与解题过程的数据集；过滤与评测部分依赖自动判分，可能引入系统性偏差；未做机制性可解释性分析。未来方向包括将语义多变数据用于训练与 RL、进一步收紧严格度过滤以生成更难的评测集，以及用不同留出模型集做定向分析（如旧版模型与推理型模型的对比）。

Abstract: Benchmarks like GSM8K are popular measures of mathematical reasoning, but leaderboard gains can overstate true capability due to memorization of fixed test sets. Most robustness variants apply surface-level perturbations (paraphrases, renamings, number swaps, distractors) that largely preserve the underlying facts, and static releases can themselves become memorization targets over time. We introduce GSM-SEM, a reusable and stochastic framework for generating semantically diverse benchmark variants with substantially higher semantic variance than prior approaches. GSM-SEM perturbs problem statements by modifying entities, attributes, and/or relationships, frequently altering underlying facts and requiring models to recompute solutions under new conditions, while constraining generation to preserve the original calculations/answer and approximate problem difficulty. GSM-SEM generates fresh variants on each run without requiring re-annotation, reducing reliance on static public benchmarks for evaluation and thereby lowering the bias of memorization. We apply GSM-SEM on GSM8K and two existing variation suites (GSM-Symbolic and GSM-Plus), producing GSM8K-SEM, GSM-Symbolic-SEM, and GSM-Plus-SEM. Evaluating 14 SOTA LLMs, we observe consistent performance drops with larger decline when semantic perturbations are coupled with symbolic/plus variations (average drop rate 28% in maximum strictness configuration of GSM-SEM). We publicly release the three SEM variants as fully human-validated datasets. Finally, to demonstrate applicability beyond GSM-style math problems, we apply GSM-SEM to additional benchmarks including BigBenchHard, LogicBench, and NLR-BIRD.

</details>


### [16] [MedExAgent: Training LLM Agents to Ask, Examine, and Diagnose in Noisy Clinical Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07058)
*Yicheng Gao,Xiaolin Zhou,Yahan Li,Yue Zhao,Ruishan Liu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文将临床诊断建模为POMDP问题，引入系统性噪声模拟真实临床场景，训练MedExAgent通过两阶段方法（监督微调+DAPO优化）实现与大型模型相当的诊断性能，同时具备成本效益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有医学LLM基准和自动诊断方法过度简化临床诊断过程，仅关注单轮问答、无噪声对话或顺序检查制作，忽视了临床诊断的交互性和不确定性本质，无法真实反映临床实践中的复杂场景。

Method: 1) 将临床诊断形式化为POMDP框架，定义三种动作类型（提问、医疗检查工具调用、诊断）；2) 设计系统性噪声模型（7种患者噪声+3种检查噪声）；3) 采用两阶段训练：监督微调（基于Calgary-Cambridge临床访谈模型构建的合成对话）+ DAPO优化（组合奖励：诊断准确性、工具调用质量、检查成本包括费用和患者不适度）。

Result: MedExAgent在诊断性能上可与更大的模型相媲美，同时保持了成本效益的检查策略。

Conclusion: MedExAgent在保持成本效益的检查策略的同时，实现了与更大模型相当的诊断性能，验证了将临床诊断建模为POMDP并结合两阶段训练方法的有效性。

Abstract: Real-world clinical diagnosis is a complex process in which the doctor is required to obtain information from both interaction with the patient and conducting medical exams. Additionally, the doctor needs to adapt to different patient personas, as well as noisy and incomplete information that can happen at any time during the process. However, existing benchmarks for medical LLMs and methods for automatic diagnosis largely simplify this process by reducing it to single-turn question answering, noise-free conversations, or sequential exam making, etc., ignoring the interactive and uncertain nature of clinical diagnosis. In this paper, we aim to address this gap by formalizing clinical diagnosis as a Partially Observable Markov Decision Process (POMDP) with three action types: questioning the patient, ordering medical exams as tool calls, and issuing a diagnosis. We also introduce a systematic noise model comprising seven patient noise types and three exam noise types. Using our proposed environment, we train an effective diagnosis agent, \textbf{MedExAgent}, through a two-stage pipeline that first performs supervised finetuning on synthetic conversations structured after the Calgary-Cambridge model for clinical interviews, and then applies DAPO to optimize a composite reward capturing diagnostic accuracy, tool call quality, and exam cost including financial cost and patient discomfort. Through extensive experiments and ablation studies, we demonstrate that MedExAgent achieves diagnostic performance comparable to larger models while maintaining cost-efficient examination strategies.

</details>


### [17] [WiCER: Wiki-memory Compile, Evaluate, Refine Iterative Knowledge Compilation for LLM Wiki Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07068)
*Juan M. Huerta*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文针对LLM Wiki模式中的"编译差距"问题，提出了基于CEGAR思想的WiCER迭代算法，通过诊断评估、事实识别和强制保留三个步骤，在1-2次迭代内即可恢复80%的质量损失，灾难性失败率降低55%。实验覆盖17个领域6800个问题，证明了针对性诊断比通用固定策略更有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM Wiki模式承诺亚秒级延迟和零检索失败的高质量上下文访问，但存在"编译差距"问题：LLM编译将原始文档提炼为wiki时，可能灾难性地丢弃关键事实。需要系统性地表征这一差距并提出解决方案。

Method: WiCER（Wiki-memory Compile, Evaluate, Refine）：一种基于反例引导抽象细化（CEGAR）思想的迭代算法。该方法包含三个核心步骤：1）对编译后的wiki进行诊断探测评估；2）识别被丢弃的关键事实；3）在后续编译中强制保留这些事实。通过1-2次迭代循环实现编译质量的逐步恢复。

Result: 在17个RepLiQA领域（6800个问题）的评估表明：1）全上下文KV缓存推理在精选知识上优于RAG（4.38 vs 4.08分，TTFT快7.3倍）；2）但在大规模下因注意力稀释而性能下降；3）盲目编译完全失败（2.14-2.32分 vs 3.46，灾难性失败率53-60%）；4）WiCER 1-2次迭代恢复80%质量损失，灾难性失败率相对降低55%。

Conclusion: WiCER通过1-2次迭代即可恢复80%的质量损失，将灾难性失败率降低55%。研究表明，针对性诊断（+0.95提升）比通用固定策略（+0.16）更有效，为LLM知识编译提供了可复现的解决方案。

Abstract: The LLM Wiki pattern, to compile and provide domain knowledge into a persistent artifact and serve it to LLMs via KV cache inference, promises context access at sub-second latency with zero retrieval failure. Realizing this requires solving the compilation gap: LLM compilation distilling raw documents into a wiki without catastrophically discarding critical facts. We characterize this gap across 17 RepLiQA domains (6,800 questions): we observe that full context KV cache inference outperforms RAG on curated knowledge (4.38 vs. 4.08 out of 5, 7.3 faster TTFT) but degrades below RAG at scale due to attention dilution, and blind compilation fails entirely (2.14 to 2.32 vs. 3.46, 53 to 60% catastrophic failure rate). To address the compilation gap, we propose WiCER (Wiki-memory Compile, Evaluate, Refine), an iterative algorithm inspired by counterexample-guided abstraction refinement (CEGAR) that closes this gap. WiCER evaluates compiled wikis against diagnostic probes, identifies dropped facts, and forces their preservation in subsequent compilations. One to two iterations recover 80% of lost quality (mean 3.24 vs. 3.47 for raw full-context across the 15 topics with baselines), reducing catastrophic failures by 55% relative. An ablation across all 17 topics confirms that targeted diagnosis (+0.95), not generic pinning (+0.16), drives the gains. All code and benchmarks are released for reproducible research.

</details>


### [18] [Self-Consolidating Language Models: Continual Knowledge Incorporation from Context](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07076)
*Zekun Wang,Anant Gupta,Zihan Dong,Christopher J. MacLellan*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出SCoL框架，通过元强化学习让LLM自主学习在给定当前上下文时生成更新指令，选择应更新的Transformer层，实现持续上下文整合，同时限制对已整合信息的干扰。实验证明该方法在知识获取与保留上优于多种基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM接收的信息以段落流、对话和长上下文工作流形式递增，但更长的上下文窗口并不等同于有用信息被有效保留和复用。现有方法难以在整合新信息的同时限制对已整合信息的干扰，需要一种持续性的上下文整合机制。

Method: 提出SCoL框架，采用元强化学习在不断演化的模型状态下训练，使LLM能够生成指定哪些Transformer层应被更新的文本更新指令。通过监督式QA奖励（SQuAD）和基于似然的内在奖励（LongBench v2）进行训练。

Result: 相比提示工程、摘要、批量测试时训练和顺序微调基线，SCoL在知识获取与保留上均有提升。分析发现模型倾向于选择高Fisher信息量的层进行更新，说明模型学会了将可塑性路由至损失敏感区域。框架支持从短训练流向长评估流的迁移。

Conclusion: SCoL通过让模型自主学习生成更新指令，实现了高效且低干扰的持续上下文整合。该方法在知识获取与保留两个维度均优于基线方法，展现了良好的可扩展性和跨长度迁移能力。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly receive information as streams of passages, conversations, and long-context workflows. While longer context windows expose more evidence, they do not ensure that useful information is preserved and reused. We study continual context consolidation: writing current context into model weights while limiting interference with previously consolidated information. We propose \textbf{S}elf-\textbf{Co}nsolidating \textbf{L}anguage Models (SCoL), a post-training framework in which, given current context, an LLM learns to generate textual update instructions specifying which of its own Transformer layers should be updated. Because committed updates change the model that later generates future selections, we train SCoL with meta-reinforcement learning over an evolving model state. We instantiate SCoL with supervised QA rewards on SQuAD knowledge incorporation and intrinsic likelihood-based rewards for LongBench v2 long-context consolidation. Across both settings, SCoL improves acquisition and retention over prompting, summarization, batch test-time training, and sequential finetuning baselines. Analysis of learned selection patterns shows that SCoL encourages the LLM to generate sparse update locations that align with layers of high Fisher information, suggesting that the model learns to route plasticity toward loss-sensitive regions while limiting interference. Moreover, SCoL transfers from shorter meta-training streams to longer LongBench v2 streams at evaluation, suggesting that our framework supports scalable streaming consolidation.

</details>


### [19] [Beyond Single Ground Truth: Reference Monism as Epistemic Injustice in ASR Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07084)
*Anna Seo Gyeong Choi,Maria Teleki,James Caverlee,Miguel del Rio,Corey Miller,Hoon Choi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文揭示了自动语音识别评估中参考单一主义对失语症患者造成的认知不正义问题，通过引入诠释鸿沟概念和EID指标，论证了现行评估框架的系统性偏见，并提出WER-Range作为更具包容性的替代方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前ASR评估依赖单一"干净"转录作为标准参考，对失语症患者的临床有意义的不流利表达（如停顿、重复、犹豫等）进行负面评判。这种做法将语言多样性错误地量化为系统误差，导致该群体在技术评估中系统性处于不利地位。

Method: 研究团队构建了哲学理论框架来界定"诠释鸿沟"概念，形式化了"认知不正义距离"(EID)指标以量化参考单一主义的代价，并使用AphasiaBank语料库进行实证研究，比较不同转录约定下的WER表现差异。

Result: 实证研究表明，使用AphasiaBank数据验证了WER结果会因所采用的转录约定不同而产生显著差异，证实了参考单一主义确实会对特定说话人群造成不公正的评估结果。

Conclusion: 该研究为ASR评估提出了一个根本性的反思框架，通过引入"诠释鸿沟"概念和EID指标，揭示了评估基础设施中对特定语言群体的系统性偏见。提出的WER-Range方法旨在推动更具包容性的语音技术评估标准。

Abstract: Automatic speech recognition (ASR) evaluation compares system output to ground truth transcripts, with Word Error Rate (WER) quantifying the distance between them. But ground truth transcripts are not discovered - they are produced by human annotators following conventions that encode normative assumptions about which speech features matter. Different conventions (verbatim, non-verbatim, legal) produce different transcripts of identical speech and judge the same ASR output differently. This paper argues that reference monism - enforcing a single transcription convention as ground truth - commits epistemic injustice. Speakers with aphasia, whose speech includes clinically meaningful disfluencies, are systematically disadvantaged when evaluated against "clean" references that treat those disfluencies as errors. The harm is not merely differential performance, but that evaluative infrastructure lacks interpretive resources to recognize their contributions as legitimate. We develop a philosophical framework introducing the hermeneutical gap, formalize Epistemic Injustice Distance (EID) to measure reference monism's cost, and demonstrate empirically using AphasiaBank that WER varies depending on which convention defines ground truth. We propose WER-Range: reporting performance across legitimate conventions rather than assuming a single correct answer.

</details>


### [20] [The Translation Tax Is Not a Scalar: A Counterfactual Audit of English-Source Cue Inheritance in Chinese Multilingual Benchmarks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07093)
*Zezheng Lin,Fengming Liu,Handi Li*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文对"翻译税（Translation Tax）"这一被普遍当作标量处理的假设做了反事实审计：作者在英译中场景下使用四个估计器（回译差、双语标注校准、INCLUDE 原生对照、同题匹配式 LLM 自然化），发现三者相互矛盾——回译差小且对解析器脆弱、标注校准无法预测题目级增益、六模型原生对照显示的是模型族效应而非统一的基准效应；唯一真正"锁定题目内容、只改变中文表层形式"的 E4 实验在修复了一个提示构造缺陷后，也不再支持模型族交互，仅保留"翻译残留高"的题目获益、"残留低"的题目不获益的剂量—反应关系。因此结论是：不存在单一可加的"翻译税"标量，而是一组依赖估计器与题目层面的效度风险（论文同时发布分格证据、自然化协议、人工 QC 与翻译基准报告清单）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多语言大模型评测高度依赖英译基准（MMMLU、Belebele、XCOPA），社区默认认为这些基准因保留英文源语线索（源语结构残留）而系统性虚高分数，把这一偏差笼统称为"翻译税"并视为一个可量化、可统一扣除的标量扣分项。已有工作（Artetxe et al., 2020）诊断了翻译痕迹可被模型当作非语义捷径利用，Wu et al. (2025) 也指出翻译基准与本地人类判断一致性低，但"基准分数中有多少由翻译线索而非真实语言理解驱动"缺乏严谨量化：估计量的识别假设、失败模式与题目异质性都未被交代。若直接把翻译基准与原生基准的分差当作可比的标量税，则会误判模型族能力与基准可比性。

A. text"，所有 E4 数字用修正版 scoring_v2。

Abstract: The Translation Tax is often treated as a scalar: translated benchmarks are assumed to inflate scores by preserving English-source cues. After correcting a prompt-construction bug, this contrast no longer supports a model-family interaction, but it preserves a residue dose-response: high-residue items benefit while low-residue items do not. The result is not a single Translation Tax, but a set of estimator- and item-dependent validity risks. We release per-cell evidence, the naturalization protocol, human QC, and a reporting checklist for translated multilingual benchmark papers.

  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: BLEU/ROUGE/BERTScore 等自动指标依赖词面或嵌入相似度，在开放式叙事生成上与人类判断仅弱相关，无法捕捉象征性、情感共鸣与文化-哲学解释等文学核心特质；现有 LLM-as-judge 研究多聚焦对话质量或指令遵循，少数涉及创意写作者采用无理论根基的单轮评估。文学批评本身也表明质量并非单一、理论中立的标量，而需沿多个解释维度（文化、情感-心理、存在-哲学）分别测量。作者因此主张"本体论式分解"：不同维度在认识论类型上不同，需匹配不同评估方法，并需检验 LLM 能否承担历来依赖人类批评家judgment的这些高层维度。

Abstract: Evaluating literary quality requires assessing interpretive dimensions such as cultural representation, emotional depth, and philosophical sophistication that resist straightforward computational measurement. TL;DR: 本文提出并系统验证了“记忆诅咒”（memory curse）现象：在多智能体重复社会困境中，扩大 LLM 可访问的历史记忆长度（而非扩大上下文窗口本身）反而在 28 个模型-游戏组合中的 18 个里显著降低合作率。其机制被定位为“合作性前瞻意图的侵蚀”，并通过三条干预性证据链加以确认：向前看的 LoRA 微调（可零样本迁移）、保持长度不变的记忆净化、以及去除 CoT 的消融（发现显式推理反而放大该效应）。

  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 主流观点将扩大上下文窗口视为 LLM 能力的单调升级，隐含假设“更长的交互历史能建立信任与协调”（呼应 Folk Theorem 与 RAG/MemoryGPT 等记忆增强范式）。但行为经济学证据（Ma et al., 2021）显示人类在长历史下会因历史噪声而变得记仇、不宽容；人类依赖稀疏、压缩的“遗忘”机制来原谅与适应，而 AI 智能体处理的是逐字、全量、无自然退化的历史记录。这一结构性差异提出了一个尚未被系统检验的部署问题：扩展记忆是在构建必要信任，还是一份完整的“历史账本”必然导致无宽恕的报复？已有 LLM 社会困境研究多在 ≤10 轮的短视野下评估，无法暴露长历史效应，因此需要一次系统性的长周期实证扫描并做机制归因。

Method: 实验设计：7 个开源模型（Gemma-3-12B、GPT-OSS-20B/120B、Llama-3.3-70B、Llama-4-Scout-17B、Mistral-7B、Qwen2.5-Coder-32B）× 4 个经典社会困境（囚徒困境 PD、旅客困境 TD（合作定义为 A3）、公共品博弈 PG、信任博弈 TG）× 9 个历史长度 HL∈{0,1,2,3,5,10,20,40,80} × 3 个随机种子；每局最多 500 轮，以 0.99 概率继续（提示词明确告知 99% 会再来一轮、需最大化长期回报），temperature=0.7，max output=2000 tokens，经 Cloudflare Workers AI API 调用，共产出超过 378,000 条 CoT 推理轨迹。四类博弈均有 Nash 均衡低于社会最优的payoff结构（PD: T=300>R=200>P=100>S=-100；TG: 20/10/6/4/2；PG: 贡献池乘1.5；TD: A0 纳什、A3 帕累托）。\n分析手段：(1) 行为轨迹与方差分析，划分“记忆免疫”（全 HL 合作率≥95%，10 例）与“记忆诅咒”（18 例）；(2) 词表计量学：对 CoT 文本统计前瞻性词典（future、long-term、signal、forgive、recipro、pareto 等）与历史跟随/风险规避词典（risk、exploit、betray、punish、retaliate、pattern 等），计算 Forward-Looking Ratio 与 Paranoia Ratio（每 1000 词归一化）；(3) 针对性微调干预（认知探针）：用 6 个源模型在 PG 上产生的轨迹，经正则预筛 + LLM-as-a-judge（Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct 打分 s_fwd/s_qual/s_spec）+ 反作弊词频校验 + 前缀去模板化三级过滤，得 1,751 条训练轨迹（仅按语义推理风格筛选、不按动作标签筛选），对 Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.1 做 LoRA（r=16, α=32, 加权 SFT 损失 w_i=s_fwd·s_spec/100，左截断 3072 token，3 epoch，AdamW 2e-4 余弦调度），合并后经 vLLM 零样本评测；(4) 记忆净化实验：HL=80 固定窗口长度，将 80−X 轮替换为合成合作记录（IDEAL）与极化含背叛信号的 POLAR 两种模式，扫描 X∈{2,…,80}；(5) 非对称记忆实验：HL=2 的“宽恕者”与 HL=80 的“记仇者”混合，以及 2 记仇 + 1 宽恕的少数派配置；(6) CoT 消融：同一提示结构下去掉推理要求、只输出动作。

Result: 1) 总体规律：HL=0 时合作率接近零（PG/TG 几乎全背叛），HL=2 达到峰值（如 GPT-OSS-20B 在 PD 从 47.4%→92.1%，Mistral-7B 在 PG 达 100%），随后随 HL 增大单调衰减——Gemma-3-12B 在 TG 从 51.2%(HL=2) 跌至 9.5%(HL=80)，累计回报从 8.59 降至 5.19；GPT-OSS-20B 在 PD 从 92.1%→20.6%；Llama-4-Scout-17B 在 PG 从 82.6%→45.8%。同时 HL=80 时方差爆炸（如 ±24.0%），表明早期噪声被放大为路径依赖的报复循环，制度内刚性但跨种子极不稳定。PD 对多数模型免疫（5 个模型全 HL 保持 100%），免疫性依赖“模型×游戏”的策略契合度而非参数规模（GPT-OSS-120B 在 PD 免疫但在 TG 从 92.7% 崩至 7.3%）。2) 认知机制：前瞻比率随 HL 下降，HL=80 时免疫组均值 0.504 vs 诅咒组 0.340；Paranoia 绝对词频基本不变（0.89–1.07×），崩塌主要源于合作性语言流失（GPT-OSS-20B 合作词 0.43×），故 Paranoia Ratio 相对上升——这是“合作意图被挤出”而非“偏执上升”。3) 微调干预有效：Mistral-7B 在 HL=80 上四个游戏合作率提升 +14.7 至 +79.3 个百分点，PG/TG/PD 接近或达到 100%；仅用 PG 的 A0 训练却能零样本在 TD（需 A3）、PD（标签为 Option A/B）实现合作，说明学到的是可迁移的推理风格而非动作标签；GSM8K +2.43%，TriviaQA/HumanEval/MBPP 基本持平（−0.7/−0.6/−0.4%），无明显灾难性遗忘。4) 记忆净化：固定 80 轮长度、仅替换内容即可大幅恢复合作（Llama-3.3-70B 6.9%→97.4%，Llama-4-Scout-17B 2.2%→87.9%，GPT-OSS-20B 3.4%→36.3%），且随暴露真实轮数 X 增加恢复单调递减（X=40 时基本回落）；POLAR 对照进一步证明：仅在合成历史中注入少量背叛信号即可让易感模型崩塌（GPT-OSS-20B 41.8%→3.1%），而免疫模型在两种模式下均维持约 100%——说明“免疫”来自认知上的覆盖能力（override），而非未感知到历史负证据（强模型在约 90% 轨迹中提及背叛仍保持合作）。5) 非对称记忆（“过度思考的悲剧”）：HL=80 的一方是信任瓶颈，个体合作率比 HL=2 伙伴低 10.3–28.1pp；在 3 人 PG 中单个记仇者会“系统性传染”不信任、摧毁群体福利，但在 2 记仇 + 1 宽恕配置下，孤立宽恕者仍维持明显更高的合作（如 GPT-OSS-20B 37.7% vs 5.0%，+32.7pp）。6) CoT 消融：移除显式推理通常减弱对 HL 的敏感性；最大“深思惩罚”出现在 HL=80 的临界游戏上（Llama-3.3-70B 在 TG 从 100% 降至 6.9%，−93.1pp；Qwen2.5-Coder-32B −77.2pp；Gemma-3-12B −64.7pp），说明长记忆提供原始背叛数据，而显式推理过程会主动把这些数据“武器化”为报复性决策。

Conclusion: 论文的核心论断是：记忆是被动的“存档”还是主动的行为决定因素，取决于它诱发的推理风格；扩大上下文窗口本身不是能力升级，长期协作的负债可由互补机制（向前看的推理倾向、选择性遗忘、摘要式记忆治理、检索过滤）来逆转。作者明确将 LoRA 微调定位为“因果探针”而非可扩展的工程方案，并承认三个局限：一是相关-因果的词表计量学只是认知代理指标，词频并不等同于真实意图；二是微调样本中 98% 的合作动作与前瞻风格天然共变，虽未按动作标签硬过滤，仍存在“学风格顺带学动作”的残余混淆（TD 上 ±45.2% 的双峰方差也提示结果不稳定）；三是仅覆盖同质 backbone 的 2–3 人博弈、开源模型与 Cloudflare API 部署，尚未验证跨架构混合、开放式 N 人社会与闭源模型。此外，长历史下的方差爆炸与提示成本、净化实验对“合成记录分布偏移”的敏感性、以及 CoT 消融中部分模型（如 Gemma-3-12B 在 PG 无推理时合作率为 0）提示的“直觉性合作”并非普遍先验，均限制了结论的普适性。后续方向为动态记忆治理、异质 N 人社会中的规范涌现与系统性传染研究。

Abstract: Context window expansion is often treated as a straightforward capability upgrade for LLMs, but we find it systematically fails in multi-agent social dilemmas. Across 7 LLMs and 4 games over 500 rounds, expanding accessible history degrades cooperation in 18 of 28 model--game settings, a pattern we term the memory curse. We isolate the underlying mechanism through three analyses. First, lexical analysis of 378,000 reasoning traces associates this breakdown with eroding forward-looking intent rather than rising paranoia. We validate this using targeted fine-tuning as a cognitive probe: a LoRA adapter trained exclusively on forward-looking traces mitigates the decay and transfers zero-shot to distinct games. Second, memory sanitization holds prompt length fixed while replacing visible history with synthetic cooperative records, which restores cooperation substantially, proving the trigger is memory content, not length alone. Finally, ablating explicit Chain-of-Thought reasoning often reduces the collapse, showing that deliberation paradoxically amplifies the memory curse. Together, these results recast memory as an active determinant of multi-agent behavior: longer recall can either destabilize or support cooperation depending on the reasoning patterns it elicits.

</details>


### [23] [Retrieve, Integrate, and Synthesize: Spatial-Semantic Grounded Latent Visual Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07106)
*Jin Cui,Xinyue Long,Xunyong Zhang,Yadong Zhang,Chuanchang Su,Jingye Gan,Boran Zhao,Pengju Ren*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: RIS（Retrieve, Integrate, and Synthesize）是一种空间-语义接地的隐式视觉推理框架：它在 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 上把中间视觉证据内化到连续隐状态中，通过带边界框与区域描述的接地监督（GLSD 数据集，9.6 万样本）、渐进注意力瓶颈强制答案必须经过隐 token，以及短语言"过渡 token"将隐状态平滑接回词表解码空间。在 V*、HRBench4K/8K、MMVP、BLINK 五个基准上整体相对提升 5.66%，并在定位、结构化视觉搜索与多步感知推理任务上增益最大。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态大模型（MLLM）普遍把连续视觉证据压缩成离散文本 CoT token 再推理，形成细粒度感知的信息瓶颈；"Thinking with Images"类方法依赖外部工具/程序化操作，接口受限。隐式视觉推理（LVR、Monet、Mirage 等）试图在连续隐状态中推理，但作者通过几何分析发现其存在"流形相容性不足"的三大症状：(1) 弱监督隐状态偏离预训练的词汇对齐流形 M_vocab，形成脱节的隐视觉流形 M_vis，层间参数偏移集中在输出层，缺少内部计算回路；(2) 隐轨迹在样本间高度相似，坍缩为与实例无关的通用模式；(3) 注意力分析显示答案 token 几乎绕过隐 token，直接依赖原图与问题（latent bypassing），且需从高熵隐状态突降到低熵答案 token，造成表征失配。因此需要一个"与预训练推理回路相容的扩展"而非"另起炉灶的视觉流形"。

Method: 方法分三阶段训练，基于自建的 Grounded Latent Supervision Dataset（GLSD：将 GQA 训练集经 MLLM 分解为 2–4 步带操作标签、区域语义描述与初步框的推理链，再用 Grounding DINO 校验/校准坐标，共 96k 样本、256,444 个接地步骤；序列化为 <step_start><bbox>b_i</bbox>v_i<step_end>，无监督槽位填 [synthesize]）。
Phase 1（显式接地推理初始化）：用标准 NTP 损失训练骨干生成结构化文本轨迹 T + full answer A_s + final answer A；同时用该模型缓存各步区域描述的文本嵌入作为稳定语义锚点。
Phase 2a（侧头校准）：冻结骨干，训练两个轻量侧头——视觉接地解码器 f_reg（预测归一化框，L1 + λ_GIoU·GIoU 损失）与语义对齐解码器 f_desc（把 <step_start> 处的末层隐状态 z_t 投影到语义空间，与缓存文本嵌入做余弦对齐），合计 L = λ_r L_reg + λ_d L_desc。
Phase 2b（渐进隐式内化，借鉴 Coconut 课程）：解冻骨干，按替换阶段 s∈{1..K} 将前 s 个文本推理块替换为对应隐状态 C_≤s，剩余文本步与答案仍自回归生成；损失为 L_ans + αL_cot + λ_rL_reg + λ_dL_desc，且仅对被替换且有监督的槽位施加侧头损失。
Phase 3（瓶颈式隐式整合）：全部显式推理步替换为隐 token，引入渐进注意力掩码，按 ρ(τ) 从 0.3 退火到 1.0 随机屏蔽答案 token 对原图/问题的注意力，迫使答案条件仅依赖 C（teacher forcing 下 L_ans 只以 C 为条件），去掉 CoT 损失，仅保留答案损失与侧头约束；无监督的"自由 token"只受最终答案目标驱动，从而自发承担证据整合与合成角色。此外用短 full answer A_s 作为 Manifold Transition Tokens（流形过渡 token），提供自回归中间路径把隐状态平缓映射回 M_vocab。推理时 K=5 个隐 token，两个侧头仅训练时使用并移除。附录还给出在 Phase-3 检查点上叠加 VLPO 强化学习（K=5，KL β=0.02，G=4 rollout，奖励 r_acc+0.1r_fmt）的 RIS+VLPO 变体。

Result: 主结果（Table 2）：RIS 全面超过 GPT-4o、开源基线与隐式基线，Overall 60.60（相对提升 +5.66%），其中 V* 83.75（+7.10）、HRBench4K 73.23（+4.93）、HRBench8K 68.52（+4.19）、MMVP 79.05（+4.63）、BLINK 73.55（+10.27）；隐 token 预算 K=5。BLINK 分项（Table 1）显示空间推理 89.60（+2.79）、物体定位 54.63（+11.01）、相对反射 44.25（+4.38）、相对深度 72.02（+3.72）；相比之下，同为显式文本监督的 Base+GLSD 仅 56.25，说明增益主要来自隐式内化而非额外监督。RIS+VLPO 整体 60.95，但并非在所有基准上一致增益，作者认为可靠的隐式 RL 变体仍待探索。
行为分析：隐 token 预算并非越大越好（多数样本仅 3–4 个有监督步，超出部分无接地监督，在 HRBench8K/MMVP 上反而退化并增加优化不稳定）；推理熵动态显示有监督隐 token 保持高熵（保持开放视觉推理空间），无监督槽位熵略升（承担聚合合成），过渡 token 把高熵隐状态平缓过渡到低熵答案 token；隐 token 相似度显著低于 LVR/Monet，无论跨样本还是样本内，表现为多样、任务相关、可解释的轨迹，框解码呈清晰逐步轨迹且合成 token 覆盖多个语义相关区域。
消融：去掉空间/语义侧头监督均退化且方差增大（框监督对 V*、BLINK 等定位任务尤为重要，描述监督主要防止隐空间漂移、起正则作用）；去掉渐进注意力掩码下降最大，并使跨样本/样本内相似度骤升（坍缩），说明无标定隐 token 会被忽略甚至干扰预测；去掉过渡 token 也一致变差，印证其缓解表达性隐视觉流形与词表输出空间的表征失配。训练成本：4×A100-80G，总计约 26.5–33 小时（Phase1 2.5–3h、2a 2–2.5h、2b 16–20h、Phase3 6–7.5h）。

Conclusion: RIS 证明：有效的隐式视觉推理不能只是学到一个与预训练流形分离的隐视觉流形，而必须在视觉输入上接地隐状态、保留对预训练推理回路的访问，并以平滑方式把视觉抽象送回词汇对齐流形以支撑语言解码。通过空间-语义接地监督、渐进注意力瓶颈与语言过渡 token 三者结合，MLLM 能在连续隐空间中完成检索—整合—合成式视觉推理，产生多样、可解释且具因果效用的隐轨迹，为"忠实的内部视觉推理"提供了一条可行路径。作者同时承认三点局限：框架组件多、超参与调度依赖骨干/任务/数据分布需人工配置；隐 token 预算仍为固定值而无法按输入复杂度动态分配（仅由监督/非监督槽位形成隐式自适应）；实验仅覆盖标准图像 VQA 与视觉推理基准，未涉及开放式长文本问答、多图/视频推理与具身交互等场景。

Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have made remarkable progress on vision-language reasoning, yet most methods still compress visual evidence into discrete textual thoughts, creating an information bottleneck for fine-grained perception. Recent latent visual reasoning methods attempt to reason in continuous hidden states, but we find that they suffer from insufficient manifold compatibility: latent trajectories drift away from pretrained reasoning circuits, collapse into instance-agnostic patterns, and are often bypassed during answer generation. To address these issues, we propose RIS (Retrieve, Integrate, and Synthesize), a spatial-semantic grounded framework that develops latent reasoning as a compatible extension of pretrained MLLM computation. We first construct a step-wise grounded reasoning dataset with bounding boxes and region-specific semantic descriptions. Built on this supervision, RIS anchors latent tokens to both spatial and semantic evidence, enforces their causal role through a progressive attention bottleneck, and introduces short language transition tokens to bridge synthesized latent states back to vocabulary-aligned decoding. Experiments on V*, HRBench4K, HRBench8K, MMVP, and BLINK show consistent improvements over closed/open-source and latent reasoning baselines. Further analyses demonstrate that RIS learns diverse, interpretable, and progressively integrated latent trajectories, offering a practical path toward faithful internal visual reasoning in MLLMs.

</details>


### [24] [Securing Computer-Use Agents: A Unified Architecture-Lifecycle Framework for Deployment-Grounded Reliability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07110)
*Zejian Chen,Zhanyuan Liu,Chaozhuo Li,Mengxiang Han,Songyang Liu,Litian Zhang,Feng Gao,Yiming Hei,Xi Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文是一篇综述型论文，提出面向计算机使用代理（CUA）的"架构—生命周期"统一分析框架：用感知/决策/执行三层架构解释能力如何形成与权威如何行使，用创建/部署/运维/维护四阶段生命周期解释风险何时被引入、何时暴露，并据此定位控制干预点。核心论点是：CUA 的部署级可靠性不能由基准任务成功率衡量，且"故障出现的位置"必须与"致因条件被引入的位置"区分开；控制应同时沿层与阶段两个维度布置。作者以 OpenClaw 仅作公开部署模式的说明性例子。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CUA 正从受限基准走向真实软件环境（浏览器、桌面、移动应用、文件系统、终端、工具后端），可靠性不再等同于任务成功率：感知误差、规划漂移、记忆使用、工具中介、权限范围与运行时监督共同决定代理动作是否仍与用户意图一致。已有综述多按方法、平台、基准或威胁类型组织，缺少一个把"能力形成—权威暴露—故障显现—控制落点"贯通的共同坐标体系；而现实部署中同类表象故障可能源自完全不同的上游条件（训练期数据偏差、发布期权限绑定、运行时漂移、维护期生态变更），因此需要一套可诊断、可定位干预面的分析框架。

Method: 组织性/诊断性综述，不提出新基准、不做形式化安全证明、不验证 OpenClaw 内部实现。方法上构建两个正交视角：（1）三层架构——Perception（从截图/DOM/可访问性树/OCR/解析器/检索痕迹构造可执行状态）、Decision（长程一致性、约束保持、验证与不确定性处理、任务分解）、Execution（原子输入、程序化调用、宏动作打包三类执行风格及其权威绑定与可回滚性）；并刻画架构原型（结构化状态代理、解析器增强视觉代理、端到端视觉代理、记忆增强规划器、混合编排代理、混合执行代理）与交叉层耦合（能力提升常把风险转移到其他层而非消除风险）。（2）四阶段生命周期——Creation（先验与接地监督、目标/奖励设计、动作抽象、发布前压力测试）、Deployment（观察通道、工具、会话、权限、记忆/渠道绑定）、Operation（长程漂移、混合信任输入、TOCTOU、意图稀释、显式监督阶梯）、Maintenance（模型/环境/生态三类漂移与持续保证）。每一阶段按"主要塑造对象—主要进入风险—最早有效控制"三带模板展开。安全部分先固定威胁模型（攻击者控制屏幕内容、检索内容、工具输出；受保护资产为执行完整性、机密性与权威边界；三条信任边界），再给出结构性威胁分类（输入侧腐化、决策侧腐化、执行侧滥用）与启发式归因透镜（scope overreach 范围越界 / objective corruption 目标腐化 / environmental misbinding 环境错绑），并用"下载发票"示例说明归因判定规则。最后映射到控制与治理：按阶段划分的控制面、五类人工监督机制（计划预览、步骤确认、中断/接管、动作解释、可逆动作偏好）、控制所有权在开发者/部署团队/运维用户/生态治理者间的分布，以及面向开放部署的保守基线控制栈。

Result: （1）确立"部署级可靠性"作用域：可靠性是软件观察、任务条件化决策、权威执行、记忆、工具使用与监督的联合属性，而非基准分数。（2）给出架构—生命周期坐标系（Table II）及各阶段与三层的压力映射；架构原型表（Table III）显示每类范式的能力增益与随之引入的可靠性压力一一对应（如结构化感知精确但可移植性差，混合执行回滚更难而单次失误后果更大）。（3）失败起源分析：明确区分"故障显现"与"致因引入"，并给出归属规则——例如持久记忆本身属部署期选择、运行中滥用属运维期、记忆更新后回归属维护期；运行时可见的脆弱恢复路径可能源自创建期接地监督不足或部署期权限过宽。（4）安全与隐私分析按生命周期定位：创建期（训练投毒/后门、评测塑造的盲区）、部署期（过度授权与弱隔离、工具/MCP/插件供应链、部署式评测不足）、运维期（注入与欺骗界面、记忆投毒与长程目标漂移、TOCTOU 与动作重绑定、共享与协作面扩散）、维护期（回归与陈旧保证、持久状态滥用与生态漂移）；并指出隐私是与攻击检测并列的平行目标（凭据暴露、跨会话泄漏、记忆保留、截图/OCR/检索诱导披露、第三方工具遥测），其控制点普遍早于攻击检测。（5）治理结论：最优控制通常是仍能作用于相关失效机制的"最早控制"；按阶段与归因双重映射控制面（范围越界→任务范围/确认阈值/记忆边界/数据最小化；目标腐化→来源隔离/工具审查/输出中介/记忆卫生；环境错绑→执行中介/TOCTOU 感知验证/最小权限/可审计绑定）；人工监督需被设计而非假设，且强度应随动作影响面而非任务难度分级。（6）识别出的开放问题：归因能力落后于观测能力、基准成功≠发布就绪度、跨模态鲁棒性（图像补丁、布局线索、OCR 可见指令）尚不成熟、能力提升反而加大策略张力、开放生态缺乏身份/证明/注册表/能力遏制等治理原语。

Conclusion: 结论认为可靠的计算机使用不太可能仅靠更强模型实现，而取决于能力如何绑定到权威、运行时不确定性如何被中介、以及部署后保证如何被维持。架构—生命周期视角的主要价值在于定位三类问题：问题在何处被引入、故障在何处显现、以及有意义控制在何处仍可施加。文章强调框架的适用边界：它是启发式诊断工具而非因果模型或分类学定理，分类彼此不互斥且大量实际系统在同一工作流中混合多种机制。核心张力为：可移植性与可控性、自主权与监督、适应与回归之间的权衡；对应的三项优先事项为：可控且可移植的视觉接地并保持可审计执行、部署感知的评估（同时测权威绑定、抗滥用与监督行为）、维护感知的治理（使模型、工具、记忆、身份与扩展在发布后仍可治理）。

Abstract: Computer-use agents(CUAs)are moving frombounded benchmarks toward real software environments, wherethey operate browsers, desktops, mobile applications, flesystems,terminals, and tool backends. In such settings, reliability isno longer captured by task success alone: perception errors,planning drift, memory use, tool mediation, permission scope,and runtime oversight jointly determine whether agent actionsremain aligned with user intent, Existing surveys organize theCUA landscape by methods, platforms, benchmarks, or securitythreats, but less explicitly connect capability formation, author-ity exposure, failure manifestation, and control placement. Toaddress this gap, the article develops an architecture-lifecycleframework for deployment-grounded reliability in CUAs. Thearchitectural view analyzes Perception, Decision, and Executionas coupled layers that transform software observations intoauthority-bearing actions, The lifecycle view examines Creation.Deployment, Operation, and Maintenance as stages in which priorsare learned, tools and permissions are bound, runtime trajecto.ries are stressed, and assurance must be preserved under drift.Using this lens, the analysis synthesizes representative systems,benchmarks, and security/privacy studies; distinguishes wherefailures become visible from where their enabling conditions areintroduced, and maps recurring intervention surfaces for controloversight, and assurance. OpenClaw is used only as a public moti.vating example of an open deployment pattern, not as a verifedinternal case study. The conclusion highlights open challengesin controllable grounding, long-horizon constraint preservation,safe authority binding, mixed-trust runtime defense, privacy-preserving memory,and continual assurance.

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 Web 智能体研究几乎都把观察空间与动作空间设为同样的元素级粒度：动作确实自然地作用于单个元素，但观察的作用是提供「当前页面状态」的理解，而这种理解不仅来自单个元素，还来自元素之间的关系（即页面的功能组织）。以往提升观察质量的方法（元素过滤/截断，如 Prune4Web、LCoW、AgentOccam）依旧停留在元素级，页面的功能组织只是隐式地散落在各元素中，需要智能体每一步重新推断，既冗余又易错。已有的 GUI/视觉分区方法依赖视觉空间邻近性，而空间邻近并不蕴含共享功能目的（例如同样是卡片网格，既可能是多个独立商品预览，也可能是单个评价展示区）。同时，AXTree 的层级结构反映的是标记嵌套而非功能组织，规则式分解不可行——即使结构重复的卡片，因页面而异可能构成多个独立区域或单一区域。因此需要学习网页「在功能上如何被组织」，并把这一粒度显式化为观察单位。

Method: **预分析（Mind2Web，2350 任务/137 网站，平均 2473 节点）**：①连续动作结构局部化——相邻动作目标元素的 LCA 深度比中位数 0.48，81.7% 高于随机基线 0.22，说明区域是天然的观察构造单位；②同页内观测变化边际——52.9% 的步骤 DOM 零变化，74.4% 变化率 <5%，>90% 者仅 2.5%（多为 SPA 客户端路由），故无需每步重建完整观察。②**Region4Web（两阶段）**：*层次分解*：以 AXTree 为树 T，对每条父子边分类 merge/cut，cut 边移除后得到子树即功能区域；节点特征为 16 维（11 维学习到的 role embedding + 深度/子树大小/子节点数/可访问名存在/子角色多样性 5 个数值特征），EdgeClassifier 与 RegionEncoder 均为 3 层 ReLU MLP（隐层 256，约 536K 参数），以兄弟均值为上下文，在一次自底向上遍历中完成判定与表示聚合（切分决策沿层级向上传播）；因 merge 边远多于 cut 边，用 focal loss（α=0.75, γ=2.0），教师强制训练 140 epoch、选 epoch 125；推理阈值按区域级 P/R/F1（IoU≥0.5 匹配）调至 τ=0.55（区域级 F1=0.7749）。*语义抽象*：微调 Qwen3-0.6B，对每个区域子树输出用途 p 与状态摘要 s（二者正交：前者标识区域「为何存在」，后者说明当前可操作上下文），bf16 全参微调、90 epoch、3×A6000 DDP、选 step 65,350，贪心解码。*训练数据*：以 gpt-5-mini-2025-08-27 为标注器，三阶段「分解→验证→抽象」，仅保留所有区域均通过验证的页面；从 Tranco top-1M 中按 IAB 内容分类选 500 站（253 站可抓取），sitemap 采样得 21,974 页 → 验证后 2,052 页、45,147 区域（平均 22.7 区域/页），区域表示从 176.6 token 压缩到 56.2 token（-68.2%）。③**PageDigest（仅作用于观察空间、复用动作智能体骨干、策略不变）**：新页面进入时用骨干 LLM 依据任务指令+动作历史+全部区域抽象 (p,s) 选出任务相关区域——选中区域以其 AXTree 子树+用途呈现（保留动作空间所需的元素粒度），未选中区域仅以用途呈现；同页内不重新调用 Region4Web，而是将当前 AXTree 与「进入页面时」的快照对比，得出新增/删除/修改节点：删除/修改在已有区域用途下就地更新，新增节点单独成组保留其内部结构（避免并入既有区域改变用途），仅用稳定的用途而非状态摘要参与过渡管理；URL 变化视为换页并重跑 Region4Web 与选择；另提供 view_all 动作在本页内展开全部区域作为兜底。AXTree 预处理沿用 BrowserGym，但保留具两个以上可见子分支的 generic/none 包装节点以维持结构分组，并为无名称的 image/link 补充 src/href。

Result: **主实验（WebArena，812 任务、5 域、每任务≤30 步；因 gpt-4-1106-preview 弃用改用 GPT-4o 做模糊匹配；token 计数用 o200k_base）**：4 个骨干上 PageDigest 平均把观察长度降低 43%（6,437→3,671 token），总体成功率平均 +2.3%p，且与骨干强弱无关——GPT-5.1 45.2→47.5（6,116→4,302, -30%）、Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite 39.4→41.6（-52%）、DeepSeek-V3.2 40.4→43.4（-37%）、Qwen3.5-27B 38.2→39.9（-54%）；迁移到既有方法同样有效：SteP 观察 -50%、成功率 39.5→38.7（基本持平），AgentOccam 观察 -16%、成功率 40.6→41.3（说明区域级观察可替代其元素级对齐）。**消融（WebArena-Lite 165 任务，GPT-5.1）**：基线 48.5/5,410；+Region4Web 50.3/5,922（仅提升理解，长度略增）；元素级变体（LCoW 自上下文化 + 过渡管理）46.1/4,013（说明元素级处理反而拖累）；+PageDigest 53.9/3,814（+5.4%p，长度 -30%）。**尺度分析**：步骤级观察中位数 -33%（3,077→2,066），任务级累计 token 中位数 -25%（26,707→19,944），任务总量中动作智能体观察占 73.9%、区域选择 19.5%、view_all 6.6%；区域选择平均每任务仅 4.8 次调用且作用于抽象层面，view_all 仅 38.1% 任务触发（平均 0.64 次），故辅助开销受换页次数约束。**失败归因（50 条失败轨迹）**：动作侧（骨干选错动作）90.0%，环境错误 16.0%，选择错误 10.0%，分解 2.0%、抽象 2.0%，过渡管理 0（确定性对比），归因上 82% 归骨干能力、仅 8% 归 PageDigest 退化。**局限**：依赖 AXTree 语义完整性，canvas/非语义标记页面结构线索弱；评估仅限 WebArena，真实站点 AXTree 保真度与复杂度差异更大。

Conclusion: 观察粒度是被忽视却直接影响 Web 智能体效率与效果的设计变量：把观察单位从元素提升为「功能区域」，把页面的功能组织在动作选择之前显式化，比单纯做元素级过滤/截断能提供更紧凑且信息更充分的状态理解基础。Region4Web 以学习式层次分解+语义抽象构造区域级观察，PageDigest 将其以跨步持久的页面摘要形式交付，二者贡献互补——前者提供理解质量，后者提供紧凑持久化。在 WebArena 上实现的观察长度约减半、成功率小幅而稳定地提升，且不依赖骨干容量，且失败主要源于骨干本身而非管线。局限与后续方向：受 AXTree 保真度约束、仅在 WebArena 验证，未来将扩展至 Online-Mind2Web 等真实网页环境，并把区域粒度推广到截图式 GUI 智能体（功能目的粒度可跨模态泛化）。

Abstract: Web agents perceive web pages through an observation space, yet its granularity has remained an underexamined design choice. Existing work treats observation at the same element-level granularity as the action space, leaving the page's functional organization implicit and forcing the agent to infer it from element-level signals at every step. We argue observation should instead operate at the granularity of functional regions, parts of the page that each serve a distinct purpose. We propose Region4Web, a framework that reorganizes the AXTree into functional regions through hierarchical decomposition and semantic abstraction, exposing the page's functional organization as the basis for page state understanding. Moreover, we propose PageDigest, a web-specific inference pipeline that delivers this region-level observation to the actor agent as a compact per-page digest that persists across steps. On the WebArena benchmark, PageDigest substantially reduces observation length while improving overall task success rate across diverse backbone large language models (LLMs) and established agent methods, regardless of backbone capacity. These results show that operating at the granularity of functional regions delivers a more compact and informative basis for the actor agent than element-level processing alone.

</details>


### [27] [Structural Rationale Distillation via Reasoning Space Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07139)
*Jialin Yang,Jiankun Wang,Jiajun Wu,Henry Leung,Jiayu Zhou,Steve Drew*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: D-RPC（Distillation through Reasoning Path Compression）提出在蒸馏前先"压缩"教师模型的推理空间：用紧凑、动态维护的"推理路径库"约束教师生成，使相似问题共享可复用的高层推理结构，从而为小模型提供低方差的监督信号。PAC-Bayes 分析把该方法的收益形式化为库大小与覆盖度之间的权衡，五个基准、两个学生模型上平均准确率均优于 CoT、Freeform、DCoT、SGFT、SuperCorrect 等基线，且教师 token 成本低于模板类方法约 33–35%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在把大语言模型的推理能力蒸馏给小模型时，教师对同类问题往往给出结构与策略迥异的 rationale（如同一类速率题一次用"算单价再合并"、一次用"估总量再作差"），造成三类代价：(1) 学生看到大量一次性模式而非可复用策略，难以内化；(2) 为覆盖所有有效解路径需大量教师调用，成本膨胀；(3) 高方差监督在微调中可能放大幻觉。已有的结构化推理方法（Buffer-of-Thought、ReasonFlux）依赖冗长的层级思维模板，推理时带来沉重上下文负担，容量与上下文受限的小模型难以利用。因此核心问题是：能否在蒸馏之前把教师推理空间压缩为一个紧凑、保持一致性的结构？

Method: 三阶段流程。阶段一（推理库初始化）：教师为所有训练问题打上"类别-意图"标签（如 Arithmetic / unit-rate computation），按类别均衡采样 5% 种子集；教师为种子问题生成高层抽象推理路径（有序抽象步骤序列，如 ComputeUnitRate→MultiplyByCount）与答案；用 all-MiniLM-L6-v2 嵌入意图字符串并以 DBSCAN（eps=0.25, min_samples=2）按类别聚类，形成"规范意图"，构建映射 (类别, 规范意图) → 路径集合的推理路径库 ℬ，其规模记为 K_bank。阶段二（库引导的监督生成）：对新问题按问题嵌入（而非噪声较大的意图表面形式）匹配规范意图，用余弦相似度从对应库条目检索 top-K_ret 条候选路径，教师选择最合适路径（若不适用则保守细化）并生成实例化该路径的详细 rationale 与答案，形成监督三元组 Y=(Π,R,A)；若教师产生库外新路径且答案正确，则入缓冲集 ℳ，累积超过 τ_buf 后重聚类并合并回库，实现动态扩充。阶段三（学生训练）：用 LoRA（r=64, α=128，作用于 q/k/v/o 投影）以标准 NLL 损失在收集到的监督上微调学生。理论方面：给出"Banked LoRA 蒸馏界"，泛化间隙为 √(M·N)，其中 M=log K_bank + E[H(R|X,Π)] + E[H(A|X,Π,R)] + ε（ε 为覆盖松弛），N 由冻结模型拟合项与高斯 KL 项构成；Prop.1 给出路径熵上界 log K_bank，Prop.2/3 给出 LoRA 范数控制与 KL 界，Prop.4 给出"银行化降低冻结模型 NLL"的三个充分条件。

Result: 在 GSM8K、AQUA、StrategyQA、AI2ARC、MATH 五个基准上，用同一教师 GPT-5.1 与统一 LoRA 配置：Llama 3.1 8B Instruct 上 D-RPC 平均 73.75%（CoT 70.16、Freeform 69.68、DCoT 68.44、SGFT 66.25），五个数据集全部第一，MATH 上较次优高 3.53 分；Qwen 3 1.7B 上平均 73.24%（CoT 67.55、DCoT 68.09、Freeform 66.98、SGFT 56.04），在 GSM8K/AQUA/AI2ARC/MATH 领先，StrategyQA 略低于 DCoT，MATH 较 CoT 提升 10.51 分。Token 分析显示相对 SuperCorrect 每样例教师 token 减少约 33–35%，学生输出更短于 SuperCorrect。消融：库规模呈倒 U 型，75 条路径（75 种子问题）时 GSM8K 精度峰值 84.34%，49 条或 119–145 条均更差，与覆盖-压缩理论权衡一致；异质 vs 同质初始化在 1k–2k 训练样本时异质更优、3k–5k 时同质更优；结构统计显示 D-RPC 路径复用率 AQUA 95.6%/MATH 90.9%、路径熵 7.16/7.85 bit，显著低于 Freeform（53.2%/45.0%，10.90/11.66 bit）。经验验证（Table 6）：AQUA 上 D-RPC 的冻结模型 NLL 最低（Qwen 2.68 vs 2.70/3.29；Llama 2.01 vs 2.02/2.72），且 CoT 的泛化间隙最大（0.20/0.29）。路径控制实验中 Empty/Random/Random-Global 在 AQUA 上均低于 D-RPC，而在 MATH 上差异在标准差以内（48.89/60.07 vs 48.76/59.72）；按答案正确性过滤的 Filtered-SFT 在 MATH 略升、AQUA 略降。教师答案错误率从 AI2ARC 的 1.6% 到 MATH 的 25.2%。

Conclusion: 在蒸馏时对监督分布做结构化压缩是一条轻量有效的路径：D-RPC 通过共享路径库将相似问题路由到相同规范策略，既降低监督熵又保持跨题型多样性，无需推理时检索，也避免冗长模板占用上下文。PAC-Bayes 界以显式的 log K_bank 项刻画"一致性 vs 覆盖度"的权衡，消融与冻结模型 NLL 诊断共同支持该解释。局限包括：仅用单一教师（GPT-5.1）与两个学生架构，未验证向其他教师/规模/领域（代码、科学问答）迁移；教师查询成本约为 CoT 的 2 倍（分类、种子建库、条件生成三部分，其中分类环节是可行的降本目标）；主结果不确定性仅基于固定种子 42 的 10 次重复（另在附录给出 10 个训练种子的 AQUA 结果）；检索仅用嵌入相似度，可结合 rationale 质量与学生能力需求；理论仅适用于 LoRA + 高斯先验的 SFT，推广到全参数微调、其他 PEFT 方法或非高斯先验仍待研究。

Abstract: When distilling reasoning from large language models (LLMs) into smaller ones, teacher rationales for similar problems often vary wildly in structure and strategy. Like a chef who makes the same dish differently each time, this inconsistency burdens the student with noisy supervision that is hard to internalize. We propose Distillation through Reasoning Path Compression (D-RPC), which constrains the teacher to follow a compact, dynamically maintained bank of reusable high-level reasoning paths. For each training question, D-RPC retrieves the most relevant path and conditions the teacher to follow it, producing rationales that are consistent across similar problems yet diverse enough to cover different problem types. A PAC-Bayes analysis formalizes the resulting trade-off between bank size and coverage: smaller banks reduce supervision entropy but risk coverage gaps, and the generalization bound identifies an optimal intermediate size confirmed by our ablations. Across five math and commonsense reasoning benchmarks with two student models, D-RPC consistently outperforms chain-of-thought distillation, freeform rationale generation, direct distillation, and structured-supervision baselines, while using fewer tokens than template-heavy alternatives.

</details>


### [28] [Beyond Reasoning: Reinforcement Learning Unlocks Parametric Knowledge in LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07153)
*Wanli Yang,Hongyu Zang,Junwei Zhang,Wenjie Shi,Du Su,Jingang Wang,Xueqi Cheng,Fei Sun*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 用二元正确性奖励做 RL，即可显著提升 LLM 的直接事实召回；其机制是把被抑制的正确答案从概率分布低尾部搬到贪心解码可及区，且"模型几乎答不出的难例"贡献了最大增益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RLVR（可验证奖励强化学习）主要在数学、代码等多步推理上取得成功，而 LLM 参数化知识的"直接召回"仍不可靠——模型常"知道得比说出得多"（Orgad et al., 2025；Gekhman et al., 2025）。既有提升知识召回的工作几乎都停留在推理期引出（提示路由、CoT、上下文构造），缺少对"不依赖推理链的直接回忆"在训练期的优化研究；而已有 RL 知识类工作仍聚焦推理中介的知识使用、事实精度或长文本生成。因此本文提出核心问题：超越复杂推理，RL 能否直接改善参数化知识的召回？并强调需要在受控条件下排除"注入新知识"与"训练集记忆"的混淆。

Method: 【任务设置】零样本、单跳、闭卷事实 QA，禁止 CoT（提示只要求输出单个实体），以二元正确性为奖励，形式化为 a~π(·|q)、E(a,a*)∈{0,1}。【去污染】两阶段事实级训练-测试去重：先用 bge-large-en-v1.5 做稠密嵌入检索（cos>0.8，top-10）找候选，再用 Qwen2.5-72B 按"知识图谱三元组（主体,关系,宾语）严格等价"判定并剔除同事实的测试题，确保增益来自真实召回提升而非记忆或 RL 训练中注入的事实。【RL】GRPO（组内相对优势、免价值网络）为主算法，PPO 作对照；奖励由 LLM-as-a-Judge 语义判分（二值），超参全局统一（lr 1e-6、batch 128、8 epoch、β=0.001、clip 0.2、vLLM T=1.0、group n=5、VeRL，8×A100，约 80 GPU 小时）。【模型/数据】Qwen2.5-7B、Llama-3.1-8B、OLMo-2-7B，扩展到 Qwen2.5-14B/32B/72B 与 Qwen3-30B-A3B（MoE）；NQ、TriviaQA、PopQA、SimpleQA（训练集各下采样至 10k/5k/2k/2k）。【基线】训练期：SFT（离策略、仅正例）、DPO（离策略、对比式、硬负例）、RFT（在策略、仅正例、迭代采样微调）；推理期：32 样本多数投票、CoT 提示。【机制探针】(1) pre-RL accessibility：预训练前模型 128 次随机采样中正确答案出现次数，分箱（0,1,2,[3,4],[5,8],[9,16],[17,32],[33,64],≥65）统计 post-RL 修复率；(2) pass@k（k=1..256）曲线对比；(3) 数据归因：按 c（128 次正确数）划分 inaccessible@128 / near-inaccessible(1-2) / partially(3-64) / highly(≥65)，等数据量分层训练 RL，度量"全量增益恢复率"；(4) 奖励动态追踪；(5) 奖励函数消融（EM vs LLM-judge）。【评审器可靠性】与人类标注及 DeepSeek-V3.2/GPT-5/GPT-5.4/Gemini 系列对比。

Result: 1) 效果：RL 平均相对提升约 27%，在 NQ 上三模型均超 53%（如 Qwen 21.42→34.12，Llama 30.15→46.39，OLMo 22.79→36.91），TriviaQA/PopQA 同样显著；SimpleQA 是唯一例外（基座近乎答不出，所有方法均无有效提升）。2) 优于基线：RL > RFT > DPO/SFT，RL 在 TQA/NQ/PQA 全面最优，平均绝对提升约 10%（NQ 约 +15 点）；SFT 迅速过拟合、DPO 曲线近乎平坦、RFT 增益小且在 Llama 上不稳定崩塌；PPO 与 GRPO 结果相当，说明是 RL 范式本身属性；推理期多数投票几乎无增益（提高投票预算亦无效，因正确项困在低概率尾部），CoT 有一定效果但不稳定且显著低于 RL。3) 稳健性：跨数据集迁移（源→目标，同样做事实级去重）普遍成立，仅 SimpleQA 例外；规模扩展到 72B 与 MoE 仍获约 +15 点绝对提升。4) 机制：修复率随 pre-RL 可及性单调上升（9–16/128 约 52%，≥65/128 峰值超 93%），即使 0/128 零可及样例也有 6–13% 被修复；post-RL 的 pass@1/2 ≈ pre-RL 的 pass@16/32，而 k=256 时差距显著收窄，说明 RL 把低概率尾部答案搬到贪心可及位置而非创造新事实。5) 数据归因：inaccessible@128 仅占约 18% 训练数据却恢复约 83% 的全量增益，PA 约 70%，HA 仅 31%；PA+IA 组合平均恢复 100%；IA 子集平均奖励从近零持续上升，说明重复 rollout 偶尔采到稀有正确答案后被不断强化。6) 条件与风险：改用严格 EM 奖励造成奖励稀疏，RL 增益崩塌（如 Qwen 25.12 vs 34.12）；Qwen2.5-72B 评审器与人类一致率 92%（RL 后升至 95%）、假阳性率 0%，缓解了 reward hacking 疑虑。

Conclusion: RL 在无 CoT 的直接事实召回上是有效的独立范式：它不是"灌输"新知识，而是通过强化自身罕见的正确 rollout，把被抑制的参数化知识从输出分布低概率尾部重新分配到可稳定贪心解码的高可及区，即"解锁"而非"习得"知识。据此，贪心解码下的错误不应被视为知识缺失的证据，而应视为可及性失败。有效性边界清晰：目标数据需具备非平凡初始准确率（否则奖励过稀，如 SimpleQA；过于可及又无组内优势空间），且知识虽难但仍可在重复 rollout 中偶尔被采出；因此事实 RL 的数据策展应优先保留低可及性样本而非中等难度样本。总体上，RL 的角色从"推理轨迹优化器"扩展为"记忆访问/可及性优化器"，缩小了模型"知道什么"与"能表达什么"之间的差距。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has achieved remarkable success in LLM reasoning, but whether it can also improve direct recall of parametric knowledge remains an open question. We study this question in a controlled zero-shot, one-hop, closed-book QA setting with no chain-of-thought, training only on binary correctness rewards and applying fact-level train-test deduplication to ensure gains reflect improved recall rather than reasoning or memorization. Across three model families and multiple factual QA benchmarks, RL yields ~27% average relative gains, surpassing both training- and inference-time baselines alike. Mechanistically, RL primarily redistributes probability mass over existing knowledge rather than acquiring new facts, moving correct answers from the low-probability tail into reliable greedy generations. Our data-attribution study reveals that the hardest examples are the most informative: those whose answers never appear in 128 pre-RL samples (only ~18% of training data) drive ~83% of the gain, since rare correct rollouts still emerge during training and get reinforced. Together, these findings broaden the role of RL beyond reasoning, repositioning it as a tool for unlocking rather than acquiring latent parametric knowledge.
