### [394] [Big AI's Regulatory Capture: Mapping Industry Interference and Government Complicity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06806)
*Abeba Birhane,Riccardo Angius,William Agnew,Harshvardhan J. Pandit,Bhaskar Mitra,Roel Dobbe,Zeerak Talat*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 该论文开发了一个包含27种机制的监管捕获 taxonomy，并将这些机制应用于100篇新闻文章的分析，以量化和验证AI监管捕获现象。研究发现话语与认知影响以及法律规避是最常见的捕获机制类别，而"监管扼杀创新"、"官僚主义"和"国家利益"是最常被用来合理化捕获的叙事。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI行业已获得前所未有的经济、政治和社会影响力，但学界对AI监管被企业行为者捕获（capture）的范围和深度理解不足，缺乏系统性的 taxonomy 来全面理解这一问题。

Method: 基于设计科学研究（DSR）方法论和广泛的文献与媒体报告范围综述，首先开发了一个包含5大类27种捕获机制的 taxonomy；然后开发标注模板，对100篇新闻文章进行人工标注与分析（验证 taxonomy 并量化捕获机制及叙事）。

Result: 分析识别出249个捕获机制实例，常与合理化捕获的叙事共同出现；最常见机制类别为"话语与认知影响"（叙事框架）和"法律规避"（反垄断、隐私、版权和劳动法的违规和争议性解释）；最频繁出现的叙事为"监管扼杀创新"、"官僚主义"和"国家利益"。

Conclusion: AI监管捕获的范围和广度应被政策制定者和公众视为紧急事项；论文从其他行业汲取经验教训，提出了揭露、抵抗和挑战大AI捕获的策略，以及构建反叙事的方向。

Abstract: Over the past decade, the AI industry has come to exert an unprecedented economic, political and societal power and influence. It is therefore critical that we comprehend the extent and depth of pervasive and multifaceted capture of AI regulation by corporate actors in order to contend and challenge it. In this paper, we first develop a taxonomy of mechanisms enabling capture to provide a comprehensive understanding of the problem. Grounded in design science research (DSR) methodologies and extensive scoping review of existing literature and media reports, our taxonomy of capture consists of 27 mechanisms across five categories. We then develop an annotation template incorporating our taxonomy, and manually annotate and analyse 100 news articles. The purpose behind this analysis is twofold: validate our taxonomy and provide a novel quantification of capture mechanisms and dominant narratives. Our analysis identifies 249 instances of capture mechanisms, often co-occurring with narratives that rationalise such capture. We find that the most recurring categories of mechanisms are Discourse & Epistemic Influence, concerning narrative framing, and Elusion of law, related to violations and contentious interpretations of antitrust, privacy, copyright and labour laws. We further find that Regulation stifles innovation, Red tape and National Interest are the most frequently invoked narratives used to rationalise capture. We emphasize the extent and breadth of regulatory capture by coalescing forces -- Big AI and governments -- as something policy makers and the public ought to treat as an emergency. Finally, we put forward key lessons learned from other industries along with transferable tactics for uncovering, resisting and challenging Big AI capture as well as in envisioning counter narratives.

</details>


### [395] [AI and Consciousness: Shifting Focus Towards Tractable Questions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06965)
*Iulia-Maria Comsa*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文探讨了AI意识研究的可行性问题。作者认为直接回答"AI系统是否能具有意识"这一基本问题目前是不可行的，因为缺乏统一的意识科学理论且哲学身心问题历史上未有定论。相比之下，研究"感知到的AI意识"(perceived AI consciousness)更为可行且意义重大。随着AI日益拟人化，公众越来越倾向于用人类认知和主观体验的词汇描述AI系统，这种现象已在用户体验、伦理标准和语言规范等方面引发社会变革。作者呼吁加强对AI意识感知的原因和后果的研究，并敦促开发者、决策者和科学界对AI意识话题保持清晰准确的沟通，明确承认其固有的不确定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着基于语言的AI系统日益拟人化，AI是否能具有主观体验的问题变得日益紧迫。这不仅是技术问题，更涉及哲学、伦理和社会多个层面。

Method: 作者采用了概念分析和文献综述的方法，首先论证直接研究AI意识基本问题的不可行性，然后提出以"感知到的AI意识"作为更可行的替代研究方向，并绘制了该领域的研究图景。

Result: 作者论证了AI意识基本问题在直接形式下是不可行的，而感知到的AI意识是可研究的、紧迫的且对社会具有高度影响力的主题。公众对AI意识的态度正在驱动用户体验、伦理标准和语言规范方面的社会变革。

Conclusion: 作者主张加大对感知到的AI意识的原因和后果的研究力度，并呼吁开发者、决策者和科学界对AI意识问题保持清晰准确的沟通，明确承认其固有的不确定性。这一研究方向的转变不仅具有学术价值，更关系到人类如何看待自身与其他人工实体的主观体验。

Abstract: As language-based AI systems become more anthropomorphic, the question of whether they can have subjective experience is increasingly pressing. I focus here on the tractability of research questions in the space of AI consciousness. I argue that the fundamental problem of whether AI systems can be conscious is currently intractable in its direct form, given the absence of a universally accepted scientific theory of consciousness, as well as the historical open-endedness of the philosophical mind-body problem. In contrast, questions around the adjacent subject of perceived AI consciousness are tractable, timely, and highly consequential for society. The general public is increasingly open to the possibility of consciousness in AI systems and routinely adopts the vocabulary of human cognition and subjective experience to describe them. This phenomenon is already driving societal shifts across user experience, ethical standards, and linguistic norms. I therefore propose an increased research focus on uncovering the causes and effects of perceived AI consciousness, which ultimately shape how we see our own human subjective experience relative to artificial entities. To support this, I map the current landscape of AI consciousness perception and discuss its key potential drivers and societal consequences. Finally, I urge developers, decision-makers, and the broader scientific community to commit to clear and accurate communication regarding the topic of AI consciousness, explicitly acknowledging its inherent uncertainties.

</details>


### [396] [The University AI Didn't Replace -- Rethinking Universities in the AI Era](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07056)
*Karol P. Binkowski,Andrew Hopkins*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: The paper presents a four-level framework for AI adoption in higher education, using case studies to demonstrate that the primary institutional challenge lies in moving beyond informal innovation toward strategic integration of AI in curriculum design.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Generative AI is rapidly transforming higher education, but most universities remain in early, informal adoption stages without institutional recognition or strategic direction.

Method: Developed a four-level adoption framework and illustrated it through case studies of AI-enabled curriculum initiatives across multiple university units.

Result: Proposed a four-level framework mapping AI adoption progression; identified the critical transition point from isolated innovation to strategic integration as the key institutional challenge.

Conclusion: Universities must shift from informal AI experimentation to strategic integration by redesigning learning models and realigning institutional policies, workload, and recognition systems to enable genuine educational transformation.

Abstract: Generative artificial intelligence (AI) is reshaping higher education, yet many universities remain in early stages of adoption where AI innovation occurs informally and without institutional recognition. This paper presents a framework describing four levels of AI adoption in universities and illustrates these dynamics through a case study of AI-enabled curriculum initiatives in several units. We contend that the key institutional challenge is moving from isolated innovation to strategic integration, where universities redesign learning around AI-supported reasoning and align policies, workload models, and recognition systems to support educational transformation.

</details>


### [397] [Toward Individual Fairness Without Centralized Data: Selective Counterfactual Consistency for Vertical Federated Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07117)
*Dawood Wasif,Chandan K. Reddy,Terrence J. Moore,Jin-Hee Cho*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 论文提出SCC-VFL框架，在特征垂直划分且存在隐私约束的联邦学习场景中，通过差分隐私特征角色发现、掩码反事实生成和一致性损失惩罚三组件协同，实现个体层面的选择性反事实一致性，在保持精度的同时将决策翻转率降低98%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: In vertical federated learning, individual-level fairness (counterfactual stability) is difficult to ensure because sensitive attributes may be private and proxies are scattered across institutional boundaries under strict privacy constraints.

Method: SCC-VFL combines three mechanisms: (1) differentially private sketch-based feature role discovery without graphs, (2) masked counterfactual generation that edits only permitted mediators, and (3) server-side SCC consistency loss penalizing impermissible prediction changes.

Result: Across three real-world datasets (credit, healthcare, criminal justice), SCC-VFL maintains or improves predictive accuracy while sharply reducing decision flip rates by up to 98% relative to baselines, lowers attribute-inference attack success, and improves robustness.

Conclusion: SCC-VFL achieves individual-level counterfactual fairness in vertical federated learning settings with strong empirical results. The framework delivers up to 98% reduction in decision flip rates while maintaining or improving accuracy, demonstrating favorable utility-fairness-privacy trade-offs in realistic deployments.

Abstract: When algorithmic decisions depend on data distributed across institutions, how can we ensure that an individual's outcome does not change arbitrarily based on a protected attribute? We study this question in vertical federated learning (VFL), where features are split across parties, sensitive attributes may be private, and proxies for protected characteristics can be scattered across institutional boundaries under strict privacy constraints. Our focus is on individual-level counterfactual stability, i.e., per-instance prediction consistency under protected-attribute interventions as formalized in the causal fairness literature, rather than group parity guarantees such as demographic parity or equalized odds. We propose SCC-VFL, a server-centric framework for enforcing selective counterfactual consistency (SCC) at the individual level in VFL. SCC-VFL operationalizes a given policy specification by combining three components: (i) differentially private, graph-free discovery of feature roles into non-descendants, policy-permitted mediators, and impermissible proxies using only a formally private sketch of the sensitive attribute, with a formal per-release privacy that does not extend to the full training pipeline; (ii) masked counterfactual generation that edits only mediators while fixing non-descendants and suppressing proxy leakage; and (iii) server-side enforcement via an SCC consistency loss that penalizes impermissible prediction changes under protected-attribute interventions. Across three real-world datasets spanning credit, healthcare, and criminal justice, SCC-VFL maintains or improves predictive accuracy while sharply reducing decision flip rates by up to 98% relative to strong baselines. It also lowers attribute-inference attack success and improves robustness, demonstrating favorable utility-fairness-privacy trade-offs in realistic VFL deployments.

</details>


### [398] [A Multi-Level Agent-Based Architecture for Climate Governance Integrating Cognitive and Institutional Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07683)
*Ivan Puga-Gonzalez,Önder Gürcan,Vanja Falck,Christopher Frantz,F. LeRon Shults,David Herbert,Larissa Lopes Lima,Markus Grendstad Rousseau*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出一个模块化的多层次主体基模型（ABM）架构，将公民的动机导向认知决策（HUMAT–MOA）、人口同质性（homophily）社会网络影响、以及环境NGO/媒体/政治家的制度性策略行为整合到同一仿真框架中，以土地开发提案的完整生命周期为交互载体，用于模拟民主气候治理。当前成果是架构设计与集成逻辑（不含实证结果），已在挪威Vestland郡案例中实例化与初步校准，代码与技术文档已开源。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 气候治理（尤其是地方/区域层面的土地利用与基础设施决策）涉及公民、环保NGO、媒体与政治决策者之间的复杂互动，包含反馈回路、合法性争议与舆论漂移。现有ABM研究多将"制度规则结构"与"个体行为机制"割裂处理：行为微观基础模型常把机构行动者简化为外生约束，机构治理模型则忽略认知与动机异质性，因而难以研究公众动员与正式治理结果的共同演化。论文以挪威Vestland郡民主城市气候治理（如Bergen Living Lab中土地使用提案）为动机案例，寻求弥合行为建模与制度建模两大传统之间的缺口。

Method: 采用模块化、多层次（微观—中观—宏观）ABM架构，四类主体（公民、eNGO、媒体代理、政治家）共享"土地开发提案"作为中心交互artefact，按月步长推进，典型运行12步（一年）。①微观层：HUMAT动机框架，将价值动机（气候/自然关怀、增长优先）、体验动机（经济安全感）、社会动机（从众）赋予[0,1]重要性权重，通过S_i(o)=Σw·s计算选项期望满意度并取argmax；MOA（动机—机会—能力）作为满意度修正项，仅在动机—决策正向对齐时生效；实现三个决策模块（组建/加入eNGO、常规行动抗议、破坏性抗议），后者额外设"知晓"门槛与"激进倾向对齐"过滤器。②中观层：基于年龄、性别、教育、政治取向四属性同质性生成的静态网络；从众满足度s_conf=2P−1（P为邻居参与比例），实现局部聚簇的级联动员；知晓通过eNGO内部网络与媒体暴露两条渠道扩散；动机权重按逻辑斯蒂敏感性函数w(t+1)=w+(1−w)σ(w)更新，且仅增不减、渐近饱和。③宏观层：eNGO拥有资源R、经验E、战略取向S、文化信任T等属性，四类行动库（直接行动、间接行动、抗议、破坏性抗议）具有资格条件与概率选择，行动强度I_direct=10R+8E+5T、I_protest=5R+5E+10S_p，累计压力遵循C_{t+1}=C_t+γI_t exp(−δC_t)的边际递减；间接行动转为信息信号经社交媒体/传统媒体渠道扩散以放大动机显著度。媒体代理按ρ_f生成新闻、以ρ_e概率作亲环境框定、ρ_s概率同步社交媒体，公民按个体媒体消费档案获得伯努利暴露。政治家为有限理性主体，采用两阶段决策：阶段一聚合六类信号（机构评估U、社会动员S、媒体基调M、eNGO压力D、个人立场P、党派立场PP），经显著性缩放与"选票导向/政策导向/职位导向"战略取向乘数调整权重并归一化，计算U_accept与U_reject并以决断阈值δ区分接受/拒绝/要求修改；阶段二按党派相似度加权的同伴支持度进行立场修正；最终以多数票产出集体决议。校准使用挪威公民面板与公民调查构建合成人群、真实政治构成与立场数据，并通过Bergen Living Lab利益相关者参与确定制度参数；验证采用定量对比与定性合理性评估相结合，分两阶段做敏感度分析。

Result: 论文的产出是架构本身而非实证发现：明确了四层结构、六类政治信号的聚合机制、eNGO行动库与压力累积的饱和逻辑、动机权重的非线性有界更新规则，并给出设计原则（多层整合、经验锚定、模块化透明、跨案例可移植）、模拟时序与交互逻辑（先媒体阶段、再eNGO行动、末两阶段政治决策）、以及校准/敏感度/验证策略。eNGO与政治聚合子系统的初步子系统级敏感度分析已完成，全模型敏感度分析仍在进行中。模型代码（GitLab）与技术文档（Zenodo）公开，并建立在PRO-CLIMATE项目先前的多主体计算机模型交付物基础之上。

Conclusion: 该工作的核心贡献是架构层面的整合，而非单一行为机制：把认知微观基础（HUMAT–MOA）、网络中介的社会影响、组织战略行为与制度性加权聚合统一到透明、模块化、经验锚定的ABM框架中，从而刻画从个体动机到集体动员再到正式治理决议的跨尺度共同演化，为民主气候治理建模提供可复用的设计范式。局限在于本文不报告实证结果，校准仍为"经验锚定但未定稿"，验证依赖有限数据与利益相关者判断，且动机权重只能单调上升、破坏性抗议对齐过滤器等设定带来结构性偏误。未来工作方向包括扩展至其他案例的推广性检验、补充敏感度与验证证据，以及与LLM驱动的社会数字孪生平台对接，以支持交互式情景探索、面向利益相关者的实验性探讨与更灵活的气候治理仿真接口。

Abstract: Climate governance processes involve complex interactions between heterogeneous citizens, advocacy groups, media actors, and political decision-makers. While agent-based models (ABMs) have been widely used to study environmental policy and socio-ecological systems, many existing approaches focus either on institutional dynamics or individual behavioural mechanisms in isolation. This paper presents a modular multi-level agent-based architecture that integrates empirically grounded cognitive decision models with strategic institutional behaviour within a unified simulation framework. The architecture combines (i) motive-based individual decision-making operationalised through the HUMAT and MOA frameworks, (ii) socially embedded influence processes via demographic homophily networks, and (iii) institutional strategy modules for environmental non-governmental organisations (NGOs), media agents, and politicians. Political decisions emerge from the aggregation of multiple signals, including expert input, public mobilisation, party alignment, and media framing. The model is designed to be empirically calibrated through synthetic populations derived from survey data and and institutional parameters informed through Living Lab stakeholder engagement, and to support scenario-based exploration of climate-relevant land-use governance processes. Rather than presenting empirical results, this paper focuses on the architectural design principles, modular structure, and integration logic of the model. We discuss how this multi-layered approach contributes to the modelling of democratic climate governance and outline pathways for generalization and future validation.

</details>


### [399] [Vibe coding before the trend](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07751)
*Leon van Bokhorst,Koen Suilen*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 2025年初，研究者在两所大学（荷兰与南非）针对107名不同专业学生开展vibe coding挑战，通过反思收集发现：AI工具改变了学习焦点（从语法到高阶思维），非技术背景学生对工具可及性认可度最高，学生普遍将AI定位为职业伙伴而非威胁。研究强调这些为实践模式而非定论，供教育者参考。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索AI工具在教育场景中的实际影响，填补vibe coding教学方法的实践空白

Method: vibe coding挑战 + 学生反思收集 + 跨学科对比分析

Result: 揭示5大模式：①从语法→高级思维 ②从记忆→评估 ③AI能力视为职业必需 ④人机关系定位为伙伴而非替代 ⑤非技术学生更认可工具可及性

Conclusion: 研究为AI教育领域提供了早期实践经验，建议 Educators 采用渐进式方法融入AI工具，强调非技术背景学生的独特视角价值

Abstract: Early 2025 we ran a series of vibe coding challenges across four different student cohorts. The cohorts included 54 ICT students, 24 digital marketing students, and 7 journalism students at Fontys University of Applied Sciences (Netherlands), and 22 BA Communication students at North-West University (South Africa).
  From the student reflections, five major patterns emerged. Students reported that AI tools shifted their focus from syntax to higher-order thinking; they also described a skill shift from memorizing to evaluating; they viewed AI proficiency as career-essential; they framed their relationship with AI as partnership rather than replacement; and finally non-technical students showed the strongest appreciation for the accessibility these tools provide.
  This practitioner report documents what we observed during the classroom experiments, we reflect on how the landscape has shifted in the year since, and shares practical lessons for educators considering similar experiments. We present the observations as what they are: patterns from practice, not proven conclusions, in the beleif that sharing early stage experiences contributes to the overall field of AI and education.

</details>


### [400] [What if AI systems weren't chatbots?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07896)
*Sourojit Ghosh,Pranav Narayanan Venkit,Sanjana Gautam,Avijit Ghosh*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本论文批判性地分析了当前AI向会话式聊天机器人界面快速收敛的趋势，认为这一范式选择并非中立，而是带来了广泛的结构性负面影响——包括用户需求满足失效、工作与学习模式退化、以及社会经济与环境的系统性风险。论文呼吁AI开发应转向多元化的任务专用工具设计，并建立制度性治理框架以保障长期社会可持续性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前AI技术快速向会话式聊天机器人界面收敛，论文认为这一趋势并非中立的界面选择，而是一种主导性的社会技术配置，其广泛采用正在重塑社会、经济、法律和环境系统，因此需要批判性审视其潜在的结构性负面影响。

Method: 论文采用跨领域批判性分析框架，从社会技术学视角审视聊天机器人界面对AI发展的系统性影响；通过多维度论证（用户需求满足、工作模式变革、社会经济结构）揭示聊天机器人范式的结构性弊端。

Result: 论文揭示了基于聊天机器人的系统在复杂或高风险情境下难以充分满足用户需求，同时投影过度自信和权威性；聊天机器人交互的常态化改变了工作、学习和决策模式，导致去技能化、知识同质化以及对专业知识的期望转移；同时加剧了劳动力替代、经济权力集中和环境成本上升等问题。

Conclusion: 论文主张AI开发应超越"一刀切"的聊天机器人模式，强调多元系统设计、任务专用工具和制度性保障措施，以应对社会和经济风险；建议向更注重领域特异性、问责性和长期社会可持续性的方向发展。

Abstract: The rapid convergence of artificial intelligence (AI) toward conversational chatbot interfaces marks a critical moment for the industry. This paper argues that the chatbot paradigm is not a neutral interface choice, but a dominant sociotechnical configuration whose widespread adoption reshapes social, economic, legal, and environmental systems. We examine how treating AI primarily as conversational assistants has extensive structural downsides. We show how chatbot-based systems often fail to adequately meet user needs, particularly in complex or high-stakes contexts, while projecting confidence and authority. We further analyze how the normalization of chatbot-mediated interaction alters patterns of work, learning, and decision-making, contributing to deskilling, homogenization of knowledge, and shifting expectations of expertise. Finally, we examine broader societal effects, including labor displacement, concentration of economic power, and increased environmental costs driven by sustained investment in large-scale chatbot infrastructures. While acknowledging legitimate benefits, we argue that the current trajectory of AI development reflects specific value choices that prioritize conversational generality over domain specificity, accountability, and long-term social sustainability. We conclude by outlining alternative directions for AI development and governance that move beyond one-size-fits-all chatbots, emphasizing pluralistic system design, task-specific tools, and institutional safeguards to mitigate social and economic harm.

</details>


<div id='cs.DC'></div>

### [401] [Regulating Branch Parallelism in LLM Serving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06914)
*Swapnil Gandhi,Siva Hari,William J. Dally,Christos Kozyrakis*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出TAPER，一种用于大语言模型服务系统中处理分支级并行的 Admission Controller。核心问题在于，现有系统对分支执行采用"急切执行"或"固定上限"策略，前者会膨胀共享解码步骤，后者则会浪费吞吐量。TAPER将额外分支视为机会性工作，仅在预测的分支外部性符合批次当前松弛预算时才准入。由于分支共享请求前缀KV缓存，动态调整宽度无需内存回收，使得逐步调控切实可行。在Qwen3-32B上，TAPER相比IRP-Off和IRP-Eager分别提升1.77倍和1.48倍的吞吐量，同时保持95%以上的SLO达成率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Existing serving systems execute intra-request parallelism branches either eagerly or under fixed caps, but both approaches are brittle. Eager admission inflates the shared decode step, degrading co-batched requests in serial stages, while conservative fixed caps forgo the throughput that motivated exposing branches in the first place. The excess step latency caused by admitted branches (branch externality) varies dynamically based on batch composition, context lengths, and accumulated slack, which all change continuously over a workload trace.

Method: TAPER is a per-step admission controller that treats extra branches as opportunistic work, admitting them only when the predicted branch externality fits within the batch's current slack budget. The system exploits the fact that branch-level scheduling decouples compute from memory—branches share the request's prefix KV, so expanding or contracting width requires no memory reclamation.

Result: TAPER improves goodput by 1.77× over IRP-Off and by 1.48× over IRP-Eager while maintaining over 95% SLO attainment.

Conclusion: TAPER achieves 1.77× goodput improvement over IRP-Off and 1.48× over IRP-Eager on Qwen3-32B while maintaining over 95% SLO attainment.

Abstract: Recent methods expose intra-request parallelism in LLM outputs, allowing independent branches to decode concurrently. Existing serving systems execute these branches eagerly or under fixed caps. We show that both are brittle: eager admission inflates the shared decode step, degrading co-batched requests in serial stages, while conservative fixed caps forgo the throughput that motivated exposing branches in the first place. We call the excess step latency caused by admitted branches the branch externality and show that the safe width depends on batch composition, context lengths, and accumulated slack, all of which change continuously over a workload trace. We introduce TAPER, a per-step admission controller that treats extra branches as opportunistic work, admitted only when the predicted branch externality fits within the batch's current slack budget. Per-step regulation is practical because branch-level scheduling decouples compute from memory: branches share the request's prefix KV, so expanding or contracting width requires no memory reclamation. On Qwen3-32B, TAPER improves goodput by $1.77\times$ over IRP-Off and by $1.48\times$ over IRP-Eager, while maintaining over $95\%$ SLO attainment.

</details>


### [402] [On Similarity of Computational Kernels in our Codes and Proxies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06968)
*Michael McKinsey,Stephanie Brink,Olga Pearce*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出一套基于硬件计数器（Intel top-down 分析 + NVIDIA ncu）的“性能相似度”度量方法，用标准化后的欧氏距离加聚类（层次聚合、k-means）来判定两个计算内核在给定硬件上的性能特征是否相似，从而可规模化地评估基准测试（benchmark）/代理应用（proxy app）能否代表真实模拟代码的性能特征。作者在 Intel Sapphire Rapids CPU 与 NVIDIA H100 GPU 上，用 RAJA Performance Suite 的 46 个内核与 Kripke 代理应用的 LTIMES 内核做验证：Kripke_LTIMES 在三个数据集上均为与 RAJAPerf 的 Apps_LTIMES 最相似的非 LTIMES 内核（相似度高出次近内核 1.57–3.27 倍），并通过六种聚类数选择准则确定 k=2，将内核划分为“访存受限（memory bound）”与“计算受限（compute bound）”两类。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: HPC 架构正在快速演进（节点内并行度增加、加速器普及），必须深入理解代码到硬件的映射才能发挥性能。但社区习惯用基准测试来快速评估新硬件，却往往不清楚基准能否代表真实模拟代码的性能特征；ECP Proxy App Project 的评估报告显示，即使评估一个简单代理应用也需要大量人工劳动，难以扩展到数十个基准。已有的相似性研究（内存访问的时空局部性比较、执行签名匹配）未涉及聚类或相似性量化，且部分方法（如余弦相似度）会误判 Intel top-down 百分比类派生指标。此外，硬件指标强烈依赖问题规模，若不控制规模，缓存未命中与事务数变化会污染聚类结果，也缺乏系统化选择聚类数的方法。本文的目标是提出可自动化、可扩展的性能相似度指标，回答“基准测试是否代表我们的代码”。

Method: 方法由四部分构成：(1) 硬件指标选择——CPU 侧采用 Intel top-down 分析的四个子类（core bound、memory bound、fetch latency、fetch bandwidth），排除 bad speculation 与 retiring；GPU 侧采用 roofline 变体，以 Caliper 采集 GPU 运行时、ncu 采集硬件计数器，构造四个派生指标：L1 事务率、L2 事务率、HBM 事务率、IPS（warp 指令数/时间），以事务率替代算术强度以避免与 IPS 冗余。(2) 数据标准化——去均值缩放到单位方差，对跨数量级的指标先做自然对数变换。(3) 相似度与聚类——在 n 维标准化指标空间中以欧氏距离定义内核间距离 d(p,q)；用 scikit-learn 的 Ward 层次聚合聚类（层次树状图）与 Lloyd/k-means++ 聚类（PCA 二维可视化）实现；评估维度为划分正确性、紧凑性（内核到质心平均距离）、分离度（质心间平均距离）。(4) 聚类数选择——评估轮廓系数、Gap Statistic（Tibshirani 停止规则）、Calinski-Harabasz 方差比准则、Dunn 指数，并额外考察 Davies-Bouldin 指数与 BIC（因均未选出 2 类而弃用）。实验对象为 Kripke 与 RAJAPerf（46 个内核：Algorithms 2、Applications 13、Basic Patterns 10、LCALS 9、Polybench 8、Stream 4），均用 Caliper 标注，硬件为 LLNL 的 Dane（双路 Xeon Platinum 8480+，112 核）与 Matrix（4×H100 80GB）；CPU 三次试验、GPU 单次试验，使用 Benchpark 保证可复现、Thicket 做 EDA 与聚类。问题规模稳定性通过比较各规模下指标差异（<5% 为稳定）确定，最终采用各平台最大规模。

Result: 1) 问题规模敏感：CPU 需 ≥33.6 MB 才能让 46 个内核中 42 个的 top-down 指标稳定；GPU 即使 268.4 MB 也仅 7 个内核稳定，1 GB 时 38 个稳定（最大差异仍达 71.8%）。2) CPU：top-down 聚类得到 memory bound 簇（中位运行时中 93.5%/93.2% 落在 memory bound 类别）与 compute bound 簇（中位 core bound 13.8%、fetch bandwidth 2.4%、fetch latency 0.6%）；k-means 把 Apps_Zonal_Accumulation_3D、Basic_Array_of_Ptrs、Polybench_Jacobi_2D 判为 memory bound，与聚合聚类相反，说明这些内核在 top-down 指标上处于两类之间，仅靠 top-down 信息不足。3) GPU：两种聚类给出完全相同的划分（35/13），memory bound 簇中位 HBM 事务率 9.1e10/s、L2 事务率 1.5e11/s；compute bound 簇中位 IPS 3.9e11、L1 事务率 5.4e11/s。4) 多平台合并：memory bound 与 compute bound 内核在 CPU/GPU 上高度相关（memory bound 内核 CPU 上 memory bound 高 2.2 倍、GPU HBM 事务率高 3.6 倍；compute bound 内核 CPU core bound 高 3.1 倍、GPU IPS 高 2.6 倍），仅 Apps_VOL3D 在两种方法间归属不同（CPU 偏计算、GPU 兼有）。5) 紧凑性/分离度：memory bound 簇在三个数据集中均更紧凑（top-down 最高达 5.59×、ncu 1.58×、合并 2.33×）；分离度以 top-down+ncu 合并数据集最高（4.31/4.23），但紧凑性最差，构成权衡。6) LTIMES 验证：CPU 上 Kripke 与 RAJAPerf 的 LTIMES 运行时间差异在两种编译器、RAJA 与 Base 实现下均在 1% 内（OneAPI 优于 Clang）；GPU 上 Kripke LTIMES 持续快 15%。距离度量上 Kripke_LTIMES 始终是与 Apps_LTIMES 最相似的非 LTIMES 内核，平均相对相似度 1.57×（top-down）、3.27×（ncu）、2.56×（合并），几何均值 2.27× 表明合并数据集可提升区分度。7) 聚类数选择：合并数据集中 6/8 方法、最多共识选择 k=2；ncu 数据集 5/8 选 k=2；top-down 数据集无方法选 k=2（偏向更大 k），说明 top-down 数据可分性较差，需要更多指标来定义更多可解释的簇。

Conclusion: 本文提出并验证了一套面向 HPC 的实用“性能相似度”方法学：通过基于硬件使用方式的指标集合（CPU top-down 子类 + GPU ncu 派生事务率/IPS）、标准化与欧氏距离、聚类分析，可自动化评估基准/代理应用内核与真实模拟代码内核在 CPU 与 GPU 上的相似性，并以“访存受限/计算受限”两大类刻画内核性能特征；通过 LTIMES 这一标注样例证明该方法能正确区分同一内核的不同实现（源代码影响最大），且多平台指标合并能进一步提高可分性与相似度判别力；此外给出量化与定性相结合的聚类数选择流程（k=2 最具可解释性）。相比 ECP Proxy App Project 的纯人工评估，本文方法更易扩展；相比余弦相似度，欧氏距离可正确处理 top-down 百分比类派生指标；相比使用大量原始计数器，选用手工挑选的少量派生指标可避免噪声对聚类的干扰。局限与后续方向包括：CPU top-down 指标单独使用时可分性不足、部分内核在两类之间难以归属、需要更多指标以定义更多可解释的类别、以及在 CPU/GPU 特征差异极大的内核（如 Apps_VOL3D）上的归类仍具挑战。

Abstract: As high-performance computing (HPC) systems rapidly evolve, with increasing on-node parallelism and widespread use of accelerators, understanding how the code maps to hardware is essential for reaching optimal performance. Benchmarks are commonly used for early assessment of emerging architectures (as well as for informing the design of future hardware), but it is often unknown how well the benchmarks represent the performance characteristics of simulation codes. Existing methods for evaluating how well our benchmarks represent our HPC codes are manual, labor intensive, and challenging to scale to many benchmarks. In this paper, we propose performance similarity metrics based on how the code uses the compute hardware. We define and characterize two broad categories of kernels that exhibit similar performance characteristics. We evaluate the pairwise similarity metrics on kernels in the Kripke proxy application and the RAJA Performance Suite, using both a CPU-only system and a GPU-accelerated system. We validate that our similarity metrics correctly match a kernel in the Kripke proxy app to a kernel in the RAJA Performance Suite. Our proposed similarity metrics enable assessment of the similarity of computational kernels in our codes and the proxy applications we use to represent the codes.

</details>


### [403] [FATE: Future-State-Aware Scheduling for Heterogeneous LLM Workflows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07238)
*Zirui Huang,Yi-Xiang Hu,Feng Wu,Xiangyang Li*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: FATE（Future-stATE-aware）是一个面向异构多阶段 LLM 工作流 DAG 的"未来状态感知"调度器：它用 CP-SAT 在当前就绪前沿（ready frontier）上做带前瞻视野（horizon）的分段规划，并按"即时代价 + 所诱导的下游执行状态质量"联合打分，同时支持受限多设备分片执行与状态条件化的代价估计。在 WfCommons 衍生的工作流 DAG 基准上，归一化 makespan / P95 延迟分别为 0.675 / 0.677，较 RoundRobin 降低 32.5% / 32.3%，较最强非 FATE 基线（Helix）降低 8.9% / 8.8%；消融显示去掉未来规划退化最大（+10.8%），且收益不能仅由前缀复用解释。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代 LLM 应用（尤其 agentic / 软件工程助手）已从孤立推理调用演变为含检索、分解、路由、工具调用、验证、聚合等多阶段的异构工作流 DAG。现有服务与 DAG 调度策略（HEFT、KVFlow、Helix、Halo 等）主要孤立地优化即时队列状态、放置代价或复用信号，会"碎片化"有用状态：当前把某个阶段放在哪台设备上，不仅影响该阶段的执行，还决定了下游继承的执行状态——模型驻留（model residency）是否保留、父输出是否本地、共享前缀是否可复用、后续阶段是否还需跨设备传输。因此论文主张：调度器不应只做短视的负载均衡（因为激进均衡会破坏对端到端延迟更重要的局部性），而应把"未来状态保持（future-state preservation）"作为一等优化目标。

Method: 问题形式化：将工作流实例表示为 DAG G=(V,E)，每个阶段 v 有属性 (m(v) 模型类型, A(v) 可用设备集, R(v) 最大分片度, c_v(d) 基础运行时剖面, φ(v) 阶段元数据, Pa/Ch)；执行状态 s_t=(ρ_t 模型驻留, κ_t 可复用前缀元数据, ℓ_t 已完成父输出的设备位置, τ_t 设备可用时间)；有效代价变为状态相关 ĉ(v,d,s_t)=g(c_v(d), m(v), φ(v), Pa, Ch, s_t)，目标为最小化 E[L(W;π)]。FATE 由三部分组成：(1) CP-SAT 前沿规划器——在每个规划步只在当前就绪前沿上引入二元变量 y_{v,k,d}（阶段 v 的分片槽 k 放到设备 d），目标 max Σ y·Ψ(v,k,d|s_t,H)，约束包括：每设备每波最多 1 个分配、每个分片槽至多 1 个设备、分片槽单调启用（高层槽仅在低层槽启用后才可启用）、仅限合格设备；未来层不作为显式变量展开，而是以折扣的"下游尾部估计"折进 Ψ 中形成 horizon-aware 打分（H=1 仅当前前沿，H>1 引入最多 H−1 层）；(2) commit-and-advance 增量流程——规划结果物化为每设备执行队列，前沿耗尽后重算下一前沿，随执行推进持续更新状态（滚动式、分阶段规划，不做全 DAG 单体求解）；(3) 状态条件化代价估计器——共享测量层，为规划分与调度分提供数值输入，本身不是独立目标。打分函数 S(v,d|s_t) = −λ_q·C_wait − λ_s·C_switch − λ_tr·C_transfer + λ_c·B_colo + λ_p·B_prefix + λ_r·B_parallel，其中 C_transfer = Σ_{u∈Pa(v)} 1[ℓ_t(u)≠d]·β·σ(u,v)，B_colo 为父输出同设备比例，B_prefix = κ_prefix·Overlap(grp(v),d,s_t)。受限多设备分片为查询级（子批级）切分：同一批查询被划分到不同设备各自执行，输出按 query id 合并，不做单查询跨设备切分也不做投机竞速，R(v)≤2，合并/收尾阶段 R(v)=1。

Result: 工作流 DAG 基准：FATE 归一化 makespan 0.675、归一化 P95 0.677，为全场最优；Helix 0.741/0.742、KVFlow 0.748/0.750、HEFT 0.791/0.791、Halo 0.902/0.907、RoundRobin 1.0。机制代理指标同向：X-Device Edge 最低 1.191（Helix 1.235、KVFlow 1.417、HEFT 1.433、RR 1.557），Cache Score 最高 0.129，Model Cont. 最高 0.573。ECDF 显示收益分布广而非个别案例驱动。受控前缀复用基准（重复率 0/0.25/0.5/1.0）：FATE 0.596→0.587 稳定领先，KVFlow 0.702→0.690，Halo≈0.98–1.0，说明前缀复用不是主导解释。消融：去未来规划退化最大 +10.82%（0.748）、去局部性项 +4.63%、去同模型奖励 +2.20%、去分片并行 +1.82%、去前缀项 +1.41%，表明收益来自多维未来状态联合保持。附录：分族结果依赖结构（深度多模型族 Montage/SoyKB/Srasearch 优势大，宽并行族 BWA/BLAST 上 FATE 不占优）；对抗性"冲突压力测试"中 FATE 0.26–0.30 显著优于 Halo/KVFlow≈1.0；超参与代理代价扰动下结果稳定（0.691–0.718）；CP-SAT 开销极低（2175 次求解全部 OPTIMAL，均值 5.9ms，p95 14.2ms，最大 75.4ms）；重复实验 makespan CV 中位 1.40%。

Conclusion: 论文结论是：在异构 LLM 工作流服务中，调度目标不应局限于瞬时负载/队列状态，而应显式优化"执行状态"（模型驻留、父子局部性、可复用前缀结构、受约束的下游可达性）。FATE 通过前沿 CP-SAT 规划 + 视野感知打分 + 状态条件代价建模实现了这一点，在两类基准上同时改善 makespan 与尾延迟，且机制分析显示收益源于多维度未来状态的联合保持而非单一复用信号。论文同时明确其边界：工作负载由 WfCommons 提升（lifting）为带代理代价的 LLM 阶段图，非社区标准基准；KVFlow/Helix/HEFT 为框架内的策略适配而非原系统复现；X-Device Edge、Cache Score 等为代理指标而非硬件计数；未覆盖突发到达、强剖面漂移、内存碎片等部署条件；lifted DAG 规模上限 64 阶段。总体主张是"未来状态保持应被当作异构 LLM 工作流服务的一等优化目标"，而非宣称对生产系统全面占优。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) applications are increasingly executed as heterogeneous multi-stage workflows rather than isolated inference calls. In these workflow directed acyclic graphs (DAGs), scheduling decisions affect not only the currently ready stage, but also the execution state inherited by downstream stages, including model residency, parent-output locality, prefix reuse, and future device reachability. Existing serving and DAG-scheduling policies mainly optimize immediate queue state, placement cost, or reuse signals in isolation, which can fragment useful state and increase end-to-end latency. We present FATE, a future-state-aware scheduler for heterogeneous LLM workflows. FATE combines a CP-SAT-backed frontier planner, horizon-aware candidate scoring, bounded multi-device shard execution, and state-conditional cost estimation. Rather than solving a monolithic full-DAG problem, FATE repeatedly plans over the current ready frontier and scores assignments by both immediate cost and the downstream state they induce. Across real-DAG and controlled prefix-reuse benchmarks, FATE outperforms practical heuristics, classical DAG scheduling, and proxy adaptations of recent workflow-serving policies. On the real-DAG benchmark, it achieves normalized makespan and normalized P95 latency of 0.675 and 0.677, reducing them by 32.5% and 32.3% over RoundRobin and by 8.9% and 8.8% over the strongest non-FATE baseline. Mechanism analysis and ablations show that these gains arise from jointly preserving multiple dimensions of future execution state rather than prefix reuse alone. These results indicate that future-state preservation should be treated as a first-class scheduling objective for heterogeneous LLM workflow serving.

</details>


### [404] [MERBIT: A GPU-Based SpMV Method for Iterative Workloads](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07391)
*Qi Zhang,Zhengan Yao,Zhenglu Jiang,Zan-Bo Zhang*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: MERBIT是一种面向不规则图稀疏矩阵的GPU SpMV方法，结合merge-path全局划分和bit-field局部编码，在50个大规模不规则数据集上平均比cuSPARSE快1.27x（单精度）和1.25x（双精度）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有GPU SpMV方法在处理真实世界大规模图的不规则稀疏矩阵时存在负载不均衡和内存访问不规则的问题，PageRank等迭代工作负载对SpMV性能要求极高。

Method: 在全局层面使用merge-path partitioning平衡非零元素和行边界的工作分配；在局部层面使用紧凑bit-field描述符编码每个merge-path段；同时融入三种优化策略。

Result: 在50个大型不规则数据集上，MERBIT优于cuSPARSE、Ginkgo等主流baseline及学术方法，实现单精度平均1.27x、双精度平均1.25x的加速。

Conclusion: merge-path划分与bit-field编码的结合可有效解决不规则稀疏矩阵SpMV的负载均衡和内存访问局部性问题，该方法具有良好的通用性和实用价值。

Abstract: Sparse Matrix-Vector Multiplication (SpMV) is the cornerstone in many iterative workloads, including large-scale graph analytics and sparse iterative solvers. Accelerating SpMV on real-world graphs remains challenging due to highly irregular sparsity patterns. In this paper, we propose MERBIT, a GPU SpMV method designed for repeated SpMV on irregular, graph-like sparse matrices, with PageRank as a representative motivating workload. MERBIT combines two key ideas from existing GPU SpMV methods. At the global level, it uses merge-path partitioning to balance work over nonzeros and row boundaries. At the local level, it encodes each merge-path segment using a compact bit-field descriptor. MERBIT improves workload balance and promotes coalesced memory access for both matrix loading and output writes; moreover, three optimization strategies are incorporated to further enhance performance. Experiments on 50 large irregular datasets demonstrate that MERBIT outperforms competitive baselines, including cuSPARSE, Ginkgo, and academic approaches, achieving average speedups of 1.27 and 1.25 over cuSPARSE COO in single and double precision, respectively.

</details>


### [405] [RcLLM: Accelerating Generative Recommendation via Beyond-Prefix KV Caching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07443)
*Zhan Zhao,Yuxin Wang,Amelie Chi Zhou*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: RcLLM是一个用于生成式推荐的分布式推理系统，通过Beyond-Prefix KV缓存技术解决LLM处理长个性化提示的高延迟问题。该系统通过分解提示为可复用块、分层分布式存储、亲和性调度和选择性注意机制，显著降低推理延迟，实现实时服务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型语言模型正在将推荐系统从排序任务转变为生成任务，但工业部署受限于处理冗长个性化提示的高延迟问题。标准前缀缓存收益有限，因为推荐工作负载中的复用通常在用户历史和物品上下文之间是非连续的。

Method: RcLLM采用以下技术方案：1）将提示词分解为可复用块，实现超越传统前缀的KV缓存；2）分层分布式存储设计——用户历史缓存采用复制策略实现零延迟检索，物品缓存采用相似性感知分片策略支持大规模目录；3）基于亲和性的全局调度器提升数据局部性；4）选择性注意力机制纠正近似误差。

Result: 实验表明，RcLLM相比当前最先进的前缀缓存系统，首Token生成时间（TTFT）降低1.31x至9.51倍，同时推荐精度损失可忽略。

Conclusion: RcLLM通过Beyond-Prefix KV缓存技术，在实际数据集上将首Token生成时间（TTFT）缩短1.31x-9.51x，超越现有先进的前缀缓存系统，成功实现实时服务且对推荐精度影响可忽略。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are transforming recommendation from ranking into a generative task, but industrial deployment remains limited by the high latency of processing long, personalized prompts. Standard prefix caching provides limited benefit because reuse in recommendation workloads is often non-contiguous across user histories and item contexts. We present RcLLM, a distributed inference system for generative recommendation with Beyond-Prefix KV Caching. RcLLM decomposes prompts into reusable blocks and supports large item catalogs with a stratified distributed storage design: compact user-history caches are replicated for zero-latency retrieval, while massive item caches are sharded using similarity-aware placement. To reduce redundant quadratic attention computation, RcLLM combines an affinity-based global scheduler that improves data locality with a selective attention mechanism that corrects approximation errors. Experiments on real-world datasets show that RcLLM reduces Time-To-First-Token (TTFT) by 1.31x-9.51x compared with state-of-the-art prefix caching systems, enabling real-time serving with negligible impact on recommendation accuracy.

</details>


### [406] [Deadline-Driven Hierarchical Agentic Resource Sharing for AI Services and RAN Functions in AI-RAN](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07547)
*Haiyuan Li,Yulei Wu,Dimitra Simeonidou*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出一种分层智能框架(HAF)，用于AI-RAN中实时RAN功能与异构AI服务之间的计算资源共享，通过结合LLM智能体进行慢时间尺度的服务放置和凸优化算法进行快时间尺度的GPU/CPU分配，实现90%的SLO达成率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI-RAN需要将AI服务和RAN功能统一部署在GPU加速的边缘基础设施上，但实时RAN函数与异构AI服务之间的计算共享面临时间尺度不匹配的调度挑战，且服务迁移可能造成非 negligible的中断，需要在放置适应性和服务连续性之间权衡。

Method: 提出分层智能框架(HAF)：(1) 基于LLM的智能体负责慢时间尺度的AI服务和RAN函数放置决策；(2) 闭环形式的截止时间感知凸优化算法用于快时间尺度的GPU/CPU资源分配；(3) 预测性评论器(critic)模块评估迁移的SLO收益与中断成本，仅在收益大于成本时触发迁移。

Result: 实验结果表明，HAF达到90.0%的整体SLO达成率，较最强基线提升20.5%；AI服务请求达成率从51%提升至85.3%。在多种负载条件下均保持优势，且critic模块在多个开源LLM智能体上均能一致性地提升SLO达成率。

Conclusion: HAF通过分层架构有效协调了AI-RAN中不同时间尺度的调度决策，预测性critic机制成功过滤了不必要的服务迁移，在保证实时RAN性能的同时显著提升了AI服务的资源保障能力。

Abstract: AI-RAN consolidates AI services and Radio Access Network (RAN) functions onto a unified, GPU-accelerated infrastructure at the network edge. However, compute sharing between real-time RAN functions and highly heterogeneous AI services requires coordination of scheduling decisions at mismatched timescales, and placement adaptation may require service migration across nodes with non-negligible interruptions. This paper proposes a hierarchical agentic framework (HAF) for compute sharing in AI-RAN that combines a large language model (LLM)-based agent for slow-timescale placement of AI services and RAN functions with a closed-form, deadline-aware convex algorithm for fast-timescale GPU/CPU allocation. The LLM agent is further equipped with a predictive critic that filters out migrations when the induced service interruption outweighs the expected service-level objective (SLO) benefit. Experimental results show that HAF reaches 90.0% overall SLO fulfillment, a 20.5% improvement over the strongest baseline, and raises AI service request fulfillment from 51% to 85.3%. Further evaluations show that HAF retains its advantage under diverse load conditions, while the critic consistently improves SLO fulfillment across multiple open-source LLM agents.

</details>


### [407] [HexiSeq: Accommodating Long Context Training of LLMs over Heterogeneous Hardware](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07569)
*Yan Liang,Youhe Jiang,Ran Yan,Binhang Yuan,Wei Wang,Chuan Wu*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: HexiSeq 是一个面向异构 GPU 集群的长上下文 LLM 训练系统，将上下文并行（CP）与注意力头并行（HP）从对称网格扩展为完全非对称划分：按各设备的算力、HBM 容量与通信带宽来分配序列分片、注意力头和 A2A 通信组；调度被形式化为带约束的优化问题，并通过分层调度器求解，配套实现 ragged A2A 与子环 KV 交换等运行时机制。在混合 H100–A100 实机上相对最强基线平均提速 1.11×（最高 1.19×），在 32–128 GPU 仿真中平均提速 1.36×（最高 1.72×），并在 FLOP 等价对比中达到与最强同构基线相差约 0.5% 的吞吐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长上下文训练依赖 CP（序列切分 + Ring Attention 的 KV 交换）与 HP（注意力头切分 + Ulysses 式 A2A）的组合，现有系统（USP、LoongTrain、Ulysses、Ring Attention）均假定同构 GPU 网格：A2A 组基数相同、组内各 rank 持有等长序列分片、注意力头均匀分配且通信组对称。但生产环境中的集群长期混用 A100/H100/A800/B200/L40S 等多代加速器，且节点内 NVLink、节点间 RDMA/InfiniBand 带宽差异巨大。这带来两个核心矛盾：C1 算力与显存不匹配——对称切分使快设备空等慢设备，而显存大的设备无法承担其 HBM 能力本应支持的长序列分片，且小 HBM 设备易 OOM；C2 通信带宽非均匀——A2A 再分发与 Ring Attention 的 KV 交换都在关键路径上，最慢链路与最慢环跳会主导延迟。另一方面，已有异构训练系统（HexiScale、Cephalo、Poplar）只处理数据/流水线/张量并行的放置粒度，未触及 CP/HP 这一长上下文核心维度。因此需要让异构性直接暴露给 CP/HP 调度，在不购买同构高端集群的前提下提升长上下文训练的资源利用率与可及性。

Method: 系统设计：将逻辑调度与注意力运行时解耦。调度器输出调度表 T，规定 A2A 组划分、各组序列长度、组内 rank 级序列分片与每 rank 头数；运行时据此物化异构进程组与通信原语。三项关键运行时改造：(1) 调度抽象放松对称性——A2A 组基数可不同、组间序列长度可不等、组内序列分片与头数按设备能力分配；(2) 异构 A2A，采用 per-rank split table 的 ragged 重分发，支持非均匀序列–头映射；(3) 子环 KV 交换，因各 rank 持有不同且可能不连续的头区间，将 KV 交换分解为按连续头范围的子环任务，用批量异步 P2P 与本地注意力计算重叠，非连续切片先打包为连续缓冲。形式化：设备画像 {c_d 计算吞吐, b_d 显存带宽, m_d HBM 容量} 与拓扑图 G=(D,E)（边带宽 B_ij），目标为最小化迭代延迟 T_iter(T)，约束为每设备 Mem(d;T) ≤ m_d；延迟在拓扑、序列放置、头放置之间不可分离，故用解析性能模型（关键路径式：T_blk = max_d T_nonattn + max_k T_A2A + Σ_t T_step；含 roofline 非注意力计算、A2A 瓶颈链路 α+βV、Ring 逐步计算/通信重叠、激活显存公式 Mem_act ≈ B·P·(γ·s_pre·H + 2·L_G·(n_d·d_h))）作为统一打分与硬可行性过滤。分层调度器三阶段：Stage I 在拓扑图上按高带宽优先做贪心聚类生成候选 A2A 划分（阈值剪枝），保留组内带宽最高的前 M1=64 个划分并把每组抽象为超节点（聚合算力、聚合显存带宽、最小显存代理、组内/组间通信成本）；Stage II 枚举组间全局序列划分（按算力比例、开方、显存上限等种子加局部扰动），保留前 M2=16；Stage III 在组内初始化 s_pre 与 n_d，用坐标下降在同组/邻组设备对之间转移少量序列 token 或注意力头，仅当预测块延迟严格下降且所有设备通过可行性检查时接受，最多 I_max=100 次迭代。

Result: 物理测试床（混合 H100/A100，最高 16 GPU；3B/7B/13B 模型，8K–256K 上下文，全局 batch 8，OpenWebText2 + Megatron-LM）：HexiSeq 相对 USP/Ulysses/Ring Attention 中最强基线平均 1.11×、最高 1.19×；3B/7B 在 16K–32K 上为 1.08×→1.10×，7B 在 Setting 1 的 32K 达 1.17×；13B 在 16K/32K 为 1.11×/1.13×；长上下文配置 7B@64K 为 1.15×、3B@128K 为 1.06×、3B@256K 为 1.18×。仿真（32/64/128 GPU，最多四代加速器 H100/A100/A800/L40S，13B/70B，上下文至 1024K）：全部配置均为最优，平均 1.36×、最高 1.72×，四代异构的 Simulation 2 增益最大。FLOP 等价对比（48×H100+8×A100 vs 152×A100，13B@256K；52×H100+4×A100+8×A800 vs 168×A100，13B@128K）：最强同构基线为 Ulysses，HexiSeq 平均仅落后约 0.5%。成本模型验证：多数预测误差在 ±10% 内且能正确复现调度排序（附表 8 例误差 −4.1%~+9.3%）。调度器开销可控：128 GPU 约 9.0 秒，1024 GPU 约 444 秒（<8 分钟）。

Conclusion: 异构性不必是长上下文训练的性能负担：只要把 A2A 分组、序列切分与注意力头放置按设备算力/显存/带宽不对称化并用成本模型引导搜索，混合代际集群即可逼近同构集群的吞吐水平。HexiSeq 的贡献在于把 CP–HP 维度从对称网格解放为完全非对称划分，并配套可落地的 ragged A2A 与子环 KV 交换运行时，以及"拓扑感知分组 → 全局序列分配 → rank 级细化"的分层调度器。局限在于：只优化注意力并行的内部结构，DP/TP/PP 仍作为外层既定决策（未来可联合协同调度）；实测规模仅到 16 GPU，更大规模结论依赖校准后的仿真模型（未来需真实大集群测量以量化背景流量与 NCCL 协议选择等部署效应）；坐标下降只保证局部最优，调度空间随设备数组合增长。

Abstract: Long-context training of large language models (LLMs) is commonly distributed with Context Parallelism (CP) and Head Parallelism (HP), but existing training systems largely assume homogeneous GPU meshes. This paper extends CP and HP to heterogeneous GPU clusters with mixed GPU models and non-uniform network bandwidths, a common setting in production training. We introduce HexiSeq, a system that supports fully asymmetric CP--HP partitioning by assigning sequence shards and attention heads according to device compute, memory, and communication capabilities. We formalize heterogeneous CP--HP allocation as a constrained optimization problem and develop an efficient hierarchical scheduler for finding optimal schedules. We evaluate HexiSeq against state-of-the-art CP and HP baselines on both real and simulated heterogeneous clusters. Across models from 3B to 70B parameters and context lengths up to one million tokens, HexiSeq improves throughput by $1.11\times$ on average and up to $1.19\times$ on mixed H100--A100 testbeds, and by $1.36\times$ on average and up to $1.72\times$ in simulations with 32--128 GPUs spanning up to four GPU models. On FLOP-comparable pairs against homogeneous clusters, HexiSeq reaches throughput close to the strongest homogeneous baseline, showing that heterogeneous clusters can be used efficiently for long-context LLM training.

</details>


### [408] [Stencil Computations on Tenstorrent Wormhole](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07599)
*Lorenzo Piarulli,Daniele De Sensi*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 在Tenstorrent Wormhole RISC-V AI加速器上实现2D 5点 stencil计算，通过Axpy和MatMul两种异构方案，发现虽然CPU整体快3倍，但孤立内核性能具有竞争力，且Axpy在大输入下能效更优，并识别出硬件/软件关键限制及改进方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI加速器在超级计算设施中的部署日益广泛，但其能否高效支持传统科学计算核心（kernels）尚未明确，这是HPC领域的关键问题。

Method: 在Tenstorrent Wormhole（RISC-V AI数据流加速器）上开发两种异构实现方案：Axpy（将stencil分解为逐元素子矩阵操作）和MatMul（将stencil重构为矩阵乘法）；通过详细性能分析和理论建模与CPU基准进行对比。

Result: CPU整体运行仍快3倍，但隔离的Wormhole内核性能与CPU具有竞争力；性能差距主要来自PCIe传输、设备初始化和主机端预处理；Axpy在大输入场景下能耗低于CPU基准。

Conclusion: 识别出当前平台的关键架构和软件限制，并提出具体的硬件/软件改进方向，有望使AI加速器在HPC工作负载中更具竞争力。

Abstract: As investment in AI-focused accelerators grows and their deployment in supercomputing facilities expands, understanding whether these architectures can efficiently support traditional scientific kernels is critical for the future of High-Performance Computing. We investigate the mapping of 2D 5-point stencil computations onto the Tenstorrent Wormhole, a RISC-V AI dataflow accelerator. We develop two heterogeneous implementations: Axpy, which decomposes the stencil into element-wise submatrix operations, and MatMul, which reformulates it as a matrix multiplication. While the CPU baseline remains 3x faster end-to-end, profiling reveals that the isolated Wormhole kernel is competitive with CPU execution, with the gap driven by PCIe transfers, device initialization, and host-side preprocessing. Despite slower runtime, Axpy achieves lower energy consumption than the CPU baseline for large inputs. Through detailed profiling and theoretical analysis, we identify key architectural and software limitations of the current platform and outline concrete hardware and software directions that could make AI accelerators competitive for HPC workloads.

</details>


### [409] [A Scalable Recipe on SuperMUC-NG Phase 2: Efficient Large-Scale Training of Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07726)
*Ajay Navilarekal Rajgopal,Nikolai Solmsdorf*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文在莱布尼茨超算中心（LRZ）的 SuperMUC-NG Phase 2 加速器分区上（Intel Data Center GPU Max 1550，共 240 节点/960 GPU/约123 TB显存），给出一套"开箱即用"的大语言模型分布式训练配方：融合张量并行（TP）、流水线并行（PP）与分片数据并行（ZeRO-1/SDP），在 175B 参数规模上实现每 tile 57 TFLOPs/s，约为理论 bf16 峰值的 10%；扩展至 128 节点（1024 tile）时弱扩展效率约 93%、强扩展效率约 82%。全程使用公开软件栈（Megatron-DeepSpeed v2.4 + DeepSpeed 0.16.9 + PyTorch 2.8.0 + Intel Extension for PyTorch 2.8.0），无需定制 kernel 或移植，方法可被任何用户复现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 训练十亿到万亿参数级 LLM 需要巨量算力（一个 1T 参数 GPT 式模型约需 1.2 亿 exaflops），必须在先进 HPC 基础设施上高效组织计算、显存与通信三者。本文的动机是：在 Intel 架构的生产级加速器系统 SuperMUC-NG Phase 2 上，验证并提炼出一套可复现、无需硬件定制的大模型训练"配方"（recipe），把 Megatron-DeepSpeed 的 3D 并行方法论从 NVIDIA 平台迁移到 x86 + Intel GPU Max 平台，量化各并行维度之间的相互制约与 GPU 效率损失，并给出面向生产的配置建议与扩展性刻画。

Method: 1) 系统与环境：SMNG-P2 共 240 个 GPU 节点（234 计算 + 2 备 + 4 登录），每节点 2 颗第四代 Intel Xeon（112 核）、512 GB DDR5、4 块 Intel Data Center GPU Max 1550（每卡 2 tile，单 tile 64 GB HBM2e，共 8 tile/节点），节点内 Xe Link、节点间 fat-tree NVIDIA/Mellanox HDR InfiniBand（每节点 2 个 HDR 接口，注入带宽 400 Gbit/s 聚合），DAOS 存储层约 1 PB / >750 GB/s 写带宽；GPU 功耗被限至 450 W（标称 600 W），因此结果反映生产受限工况。2) 模型：3.6B / 20B / 175B GPT 解码器，参数公式 P≈12Ld²+Vd，混合精度下每参数约 16 字节（主权重/计算权重/梯度/Adam 状态），总显存需求分别为 57.6 GB / 320 GB / 2.8 TB。3) 基准测试（bf16，每配置仅跑 10 步稳态）：(a) 张量并行——固定 PP=1 与全局批大小，扫 TP∈{4,8,16}，观察跨节点边界（TP>8）后吞吐骤降，源于每层 all-reduce/all-gather 集合通信跨节点带宽与延迟上升、难以与计算重叠；(b) 流水线并行——用 20B 模型三组对照实验：固定 PP 变 M（吞吐先升后平台）、固定 M 变 PP（气泡增大、吞吐下降）、同步增大 PP 与 M 保持 PP/M 恒定（吞吐稳定），证明吞吐主要由气泡比 PP/M 决定，1F1B 下气泡约按 P/M 缩放；(c) 分片数据并行——采用 ZeRO stage 1（只分片优化器状态）分片优化器状态/梯度/参数，权衡显存与通信。4) 自动调优：把并行配置选择建模为黑盒优化问题，用 DeepHyper 0.8.1 做贝叶斯优化（支持 HPC 异步评估），搜索空间 PP∈{12,16,20,24}、TP∈{4,8}、MBS∈[1,10]、GAS∈{25,50,100}，以 Megatron-DeepSpeed 报告的模型 TFLOPs/s 为目标，DP 固定为 1，通过 sbatch 提交 SLURM 作业并回传吞吐；失败运行（OOM、非法因式分解、超时）给予惩罚性 F 值。5) 扩展实验：用最优配置（PP=16、TP=8、MBS=3、GAS=100）在 128 节点（1024 tile）上测弱扩展（全局批随 tile 数增长，每 tile 负载近似不变）与强扩展（固定全局批、增大 tile 数）。

Result: 175B 模型最优配置为 PP=16、TP=8、MBS=3、GAS=100，每 tile 达 57 TFLOPs/s（约理论 bf16 峰值的 10%），与既有大模型训练研究的利用率水平相当；TP 在 3.6B 上 ≤8 tile 时通信局限于节点内 Xe Link，吞吐约 40 TFLOPs/s 量级，TP=16 跨节点后显著下降；PP 扫描显示固定 PP 下增大微批数可摊薄气泡直至饱和，固定 M 增大 PP 必然降吞吐，保持 PP/M 恒定则吞吐稳定（20B 上从约 80 TFLOPs/s 提升至约 450–500 TFLOPs/s 区间后趋稳）；扩展到 128 节点（8× 基线）时弱扩展效率约 93%，强扩展效率约 82%（强扩展下降更明显，因每副本工作量减少加剧同步与通信开销）。BO 搜索轨迹显示从初始低吞吐点持续改善，失败样本主要为 OOM。

Conclusion: 核心经验法则：(1) 将张量并行限制在单节点内（SMNG-P2 上 TP≤8），避免跨节点高频集合通信；(2) 提供足够多的微批数以填充流水线、压低气泡（关注 PP/M 比）；(3) 模型并行效率饱和后主要靠数据并行向外扩展（ZeRO-1）。结论强调：SMNG-P2 运行在功耗受限的生产模式下，故报告的是持续生产工况下的性能而非无约束峰值；作者复现了已有方法论于另一生产平台，取得有竞争力的持续吞吐，为 exascale 系统上下一代基础模型训练提供了可复用的蓝图。能量效率的定量分析被留作未来工作；局限还包括评测仅 10 步而非完整收敛、部分吞吐数字（图 2/3）与正文的表述量级存在不一致、以及未涉及故障恢复与稳定性方面的工程细节。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) continue to demonstrate superior performance with increasing scale, yet training models with billions to trillions of parameters requires staggering computational resources, e.g. a one-trillion-parameter GPT-style model requires an estimated 120 million exaflops. This challenge necessitates efficient distributed training strategies on cutting-edge High-Performance Computing (HPC) infrastructure. In this work, we explore the SuperMUC-NG Phase 2 (SMNG-P2) system at the Leibniz Supercomputing Centre (LRZ) in Garching, Germany, equipped with Intel Data Center GPU Max 1550 accelerators to extract the necessary computational power. We enable and investigate a comprehensive recipe of parallel training techniques, including tensor parallelism, pipeline parallelism, and sharded data parallelism, essential for facilitating the training of LLMs up to 175 billion-parameter scale on SMNG-P2. Through empirical assessment and extensive hyperparameter tuning, we analyze the complex interplay among these techniques and determine their impact on GPU computational efficiency. We identify an optimized combined strategy that yields high throughput and enables the efficient training of LLMs of varying sizes. Specifically, for the 175B model, we achieved per-tile throughput of 10% of theoretical peak per-tile bf16 FLOPs, employing an out-of-the-box publicly available software stack, utilizing standard distributions without further modification. This approach ensures broad accessibility, as our methodology can be replicated by any user on SMNG-P2 system without need for porting or specialized software engineering. Furthermore, we achieved 93% weak scaling efficiency and strong scaling efficiency of 82% on 128 nodes. This scalable recipe provides a crucial blueprint for efficiently utilizing advanced exascale systems for next-generation foundational model development.

</details>


### [410] [Stencil Computations on Cerebras Wafer-Scale Engine](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07954)
*Elia Belli,Daniele De Sensi*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 研究将stencil算法映射到Cerebras WSE-3，提出的CStencil框架利用WSE-3的分布式SRAM和mesh互连消除片外内存瓶颈，相比单精度GPU实现获得最高342倍加速，证明了WSE数据流架构可用于传统科学计算。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统HPC架构（如GPU）上的stencil计算受"内存墙"限制，性能受内存带宽约束；同时，AI导向硬件（如Cerebras WSE）虽提供大规模核并行性和高带宽片上内存，但通常针对低精度工作负载优化。

Method: 提出了CStencil框架用于在WSE-3上实现二维stencil计算；同时将GPU上的ConvStencil求解器从双精度适配为单精度以进行公平比较。

Result: CStencil相比适配后的ConvStencil实现最高342倍加速；roofline模型分析证实CStencil饱和了可用的计算和内存资源。

Conclusion: WSE-3的分布式SRAM和mesh互连可有效消除GPU实现中的片外内存瓶颈。CStencil展示了WSE数据流架构可成功重新用于传统科学算法，为克服当前HPC架构的内存限制提供了有前景的途径。

Abstract: Stencil computations are a fundamental kernel in scientific computing, critical for simulations in domains such as fluid dynamics and climate modeling. However, these computations are often memory-bound on traditional High-Performance Computing architectures like GPUs, struggling against the "Memory Wall". Simultaneously, the rise of AI-oriented hardware, such as the Cerebras Wafer-Scale Engine, offers massive core parallelism and high-bandwidth on-chip memory, though typically optimized for lower-precision workloads. This work investigates the viability of bridging this divergence by mapping stencil algorithms onto the Cerebras WSE-3. The study introduces CStencil, a novel framework designed to implement two-dimensional stencil computations on the WSE-3. To ensure a rigorous and fair performance evaluation, the research also adapts ConvStencil, a state-of-the-art GPU stencil solver, porting it from its original double-precision design to single-precision for execution on an NVIDIA A100 GPU. Experimental results show that the WSE-3's distributed SRAM and mesh interconnect effectively eliminate the off-chip memory bottlenecks common in GPU implementations. CStencil achieves speedups of up to 342x over the adapted ConvStencil version. A roofline model analysis further confirms that CStencil saturates the available compute and memory resources, demonstrating that the WSE dataflow architecture can be successfully repurposed for traditional scientific algorithms. These findings highlight the potential of the WSE-3 to deliver hardware utilization levels unattainable on conventional systems, offering a promising path toward overcoming the memory limitations of current HPC architectures.

</details>


### [411] [Dooly: Configuration-Agnostic, Redundancy-Aware Profiling for LLM Inference Simulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07985)
*Joon Ha Kim,Geon-Woo Kim,Anoop Rachakonda,Daehyeok Kim*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: Dooly 提出一套「配置无关、冗余感知」的 LLM 推理剖析框架：仅通过一次推理前向传播，用污点传播（taint propagation）标注每个张量维度的来源（模型配置 vs. 请求负载），据此为每个操作计算规范化签名（signature），只剖析数据库中尚不存在的操作，从而跨模型/后端/硬件复用已有延迟数据；配合复用服务引擎初始化代码的层次化上下文解析来隔离有状态操作（attention）。在 A100/H100、vLLM/SGLang、三种 attention 后端、12 个模型上，TTFT 模拟误差 <5% MAPE、TPOT <8%，并把剖析 GPU-hours 降低 56.4%（SGLang 上 65.6%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 部署 LLM 需要在硬件（GPU）、系统（服务引擎 + attention 后端）、模型架构、工作负载四个维度上搜索配置空间，而没有单一最优配置（论文用 Llama-3.1-8B 与 Command-R7B 展示了随上下文长度与负载类型发生的「赢家反转」）。基于剖析的模拟器（Vidur、Revati、LLMServingSim、Apex 等）是部署前评估的标准手段，但存在两大缺陷：(1) 静态配置依赖——硬编码操作集合与调用参数，绑定到特定软件栈/模型模板，任何栈升级或新架构都需大量人工改造，模拟器只能覆盖配置矩阵的一列；(2) 剖析开销高——每个新模型或后端都要从零开始对 batch/seq/context 网格做穷举扫描，Vidur 对 4 个 7-8B 模型需 44 次模块剖析、27.7 GPU 小时，成本随模型数线性增长。根因是缺乏对推理结构的理解：每个操作的输入维度要么由模型配置固定（hidden dim、head 数、层数），要么由请求决定（token 数、batch 大小），而模型配置值在多模型间大量重复，因此同一操作会在多配置下被反复剖析。

Method: 系统由三部分构成（DoolyProf）+ 模拟器（DoolySim）。(1) Tainted Runner：拦截服务引擎的模型配置与请求处理入口点做 source tainting（标签为 model_config / num_toks / num_reqs），在一次 dummy prompt 推理中传播污点；区分维度映射类（torch.empty/reshape 需显式 hook，维度合并时按 Conflict/Extend/Merge 规则产生 mix 污点并记录值→污点映射 H）与维度保持类（通过 PyTorch Dispatcher 拦截，按形状匹配继承污点）；在 module / __torch_function__ / __torch_dispatch__ 三层记录标注；模态并行被模拟为单 GPU，集合通信替换为 no-op。(2) Operation Set Finder：把污点 trace 解析为层级调用图，剪掉跨层重复子树，自底向上测试每个叶节点能否独立导入并运行；无法独立运行的（如 unified_attention）回退到父模块，复用引擎自身的初始化代码与 forward context（如 vLLM 的 set_forward_context）重建 KV cache 指针、attention metadata、请求-槽位映射等运行时状态；输入张量按污点生成（model_config 固定、num_toks/num_reqs 取小值、mix 维度按 H 重算）。(3) Duplication-Aware Profiler：签名 = 操作名与 model_config 维度值 + 派发的 GPU kernel 符号 + 模块实例原始属性摘要（如 sliding_window），SHA-256 哈希为主键存入 SQLite 延迟库；按 num_toks/num_reqs 维度做 sweep；通信操作按 (拓扑, TP 度) 单独建模。回归特征沿用 Vidur（非 attention 用 token 数，attention 用 prefill token 数、batch、chunk size、KV cache 大小）。DoolySim 复用引擎调度器复现批调度，按签名查询回归模型。

Result: 准确率：A100 上 TTFT MAPE <5%、TPOT <8%（H100 为 2%/5%），调度决策复现误差 <0.5%，per-batch 延迟在三种后端/两种 GPU 上误差 0.5%–8%（decode-heavy <3.5%），并能正确预测配置反转点；PP=2 误差 ≤3.7%/6.7%，EP=2 + TP=2 的 MoE 误差 7.4%/6.2%。剖析开销：12 模型 × 3 后端共 36 配置中，612 个签名去重为 100 个唯一签名，GPU-hours 从 26.54 h 降至 11.58 h（-56.4%），SGLang -65.6%，13B–72B 九模型 -62.4%，含 MoE 的语料 -61.4%（FusedMoE -72.8%）；95% 的节省来自 attention 签名复用，仅剖析 4 个模型即覆盖 >98% 时间。基线对比：HF-Diff 仅 -7.9%，HF-Model-Diff -39.8%；HMD 误将 Command-R7B 与 Aya-Expanse-8B 视为等价，32K 上下文下 TTFT 误差达 37.3%，而 Dooly 为 4.8%。污点分类准确率 100%；消融显示去掉维度映射规则会残留 448 个未标注操作、去掉维度保持规则会直接失败。模块级与操作级延迟差异 <1%（linear）与 <0.1%（Triton 融合 norm），说明粒度回退只损失去重机会而非精度。

Conclusion: Dooly 通过「结构化理解 + 污点标注 + 签名去重」把剖析成本从「每配置一次」变为「每唯一操作一次」，实现了配置无关、冗余感知的 LLM 推理剖析，同时保持高模拟精度，并可作为现有模拟器（Vidur/Revati 等）的即插即用剖析后端；此外还能支撑 llm-d 一类基于延迟预测的路由器与模型工程的快速配置基准。局限：绕过 PyTorch dispatcher 的算子（如 Triton 实现）缺少 kernel 级污点但其父模块仍被覆盖；当前仅追踪文本提示，扩展到视觉/音频只需标注新的请求入口；随服务引擎演进仍需少量引擎特定维护（如 vLLM v0.25.1 仅 2 行改动）；Context Parallelism（DCP）仅原则性支持，端到端评测留待未来。

Abstract: Selecting the optimal LLM inference configuration requires evaluation across hardware, serving engines, attention backends, and model architectures, since no single choice performs best across all workloads. Profile-based simulators are the standard tool, yet they hardcode their operation set to a specific configuration and re-profile every operation from scratch, making exploration prohibitively expensive. This cost stems from a missing structural understanding: every input dimension of each operation is fixed by the model configuration or determined by the incoming request. Many model-configuration values (e.g., head size, layer count) recur across models, so the same operation runs in many configurations; a single sweep over the request-dependent dimensions can serve them all. We present Dooly, which exploits this structure to achieve configuration-agnostic, redundancy-aware profiling. Dooly performs a single inference pass, labels each input dimension with its origin via taint propagation, and selectively profiles only operations absent from its latency database; stateful operations such as attention are isolated by reusing the serving engine's own initialization code, eliminating manual instrumentation. It builds latency regression models based on the database, which becomes a drop-in backend for existing simulators. Across two GPU platforms, three attention backends, and diverse model architectures, Dooly achieves simulation accuracy within 5% MAPE for TTFT and 8% for TPOT while reducing profiling GPU-hours by 56.4% across 12 models compared to the existing profiling approach.

</details>

### [412] [Polylogarithmic Approximation for Covering and Connecting Multi-Interface Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06899)
*Michał Szyfelbein,Camille Richer*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 本文研究异构成本下多接口网络（IoT 设备）的两个 min-max 近似问题：Coverage（每条边两端需共享至少一个被激活的接口）与 Connectivity（被激活接口诱导的子图需连通/生成）。两者均建模为 ILP 并求 LP 松弛，再做 Set Cover 风格的随机取整。Coverage 得到 O(log n) 近似（紧，因其泛化 Set Cover）以及确定性的 k-近似（k 为接口类型数）；Connectivity 通过在 LP 中加入基于流的割约束保证连通，采样得到连通子图 H 后迭代随机取整，得到 O(log² n) 近似——这是该问题首个非平凡近似算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: IoT 网络设计需要在资源受限的设备上激活通信接口以建立连接，但设备可用接口类型不同、且同一接口在不同设备上代价不同（异构成本）。已有研究主要局限于同构（成本仅依赖接口类型）情形：Coverage 的 min-max 变体在异构成本下缺乏有效的对数近似（此前最好结果为依赖图参数 b 的 O(b·log n)，b 可达 Ω(n)），而 Connectivity 的 min-max 变体甚至没有任何非平凡近似算法（此前仅有 min-sum 的 4-近似等结果）。因此，作者希望在异构成本、min-max 目标下为这两个基础问题提供首个多项式对数级近似算法。

Method: 1) 记号与模型：G=(V,E) 连通简单图，λ: V→2^[k] 给出顶点可用接口，c: [k]×V→N≥0 为异构成本，cost(λ_A)=max_v Σ_{i∈λ_A(v)} c(i,v)（min-max 目标）；Coverage 要求 cov(λ_A)=E，Connectivity 要求 G_A=(V,cov(λ_A)) 连通。

2) 预处理（Appendix B）：多项式次猜测幂次 2^b 并缩放，使所有成本落在 [0,1] 且 OPT≥1/2；再按顶点总可用接口成本是否 ≤1 把顶点分为 cheap（可假设全激活）与 expensive（可假设分析解中 cost(v,λ_A)≥1），并对每个猜测重复 K=⌈log_m C⌉+1 次随机过程以保证高概率成功。

3) Coverage 的 ILP：变量 x_{i,v}∈{0,1}；约束 (1) 每个顶点成本 ≤ 全局 M；(2) 每条边 uv 要求 Σ_{i∈λ(u)∩λ(v)} min{x_{i,u},x_{i,v}} ≥ 1，用辅助变量 z_{i,uv} 线性化；(3) cheap 顶点固定全激活、expensive 顶点要求加权成本 ≥1。求其 LP 松弛。

4) 算法 1（k-近似，无需预处理）：解 LP 后取 λ_A(v)={i: x_{i,v} ≥ 1/k}。由平均性存在某接口在两端均 ≥1/k，故覆盖成立；成本 ≤ k·LP值 ≤ k·OPT。

5) 算法 2（O(log n) 近似）：为每个接口类型 i 抽独立均匀阈值 t_i∈[0,1]，在 v 处激活 i 当且仅当 2 ln m·x_{i,v} ≥ t_i。引理 3.3：用 1-x ≤ e^{-x} 与并合界，单条边不被覆盖概率 ≤ exp{-2 ln m·Σ min{x_{i,u},x_{i,v}}} ≤ 1/m²，故覆盖以概率 ≥1−1/m 成立。引理 3.4：E[cost(v,λ_A)] = 2 ln m·Σ c(i,v)x_{i,v} ≥ 2 ln m，用 Chernoff（δ=2）得单点成本超过 3 倍期望的概率 ≤ e^{-E[cost]} ≤ 1/m²，再对 n 个顶点并合，得 cost(λ_A) ≤ 6 ln m·OPT ≤ 12 ln n·OPT。

6) Connectivity 的 ILP：除 x_{i,v} 外增加边变量 y_{uv}（表示边被覆盖），约束 (6) Σ min{x_{i,u},x_{i,v}} ≥ y_{uv}，以及全局割约束 (8) y(δ(S)) ≥ 1（对所有非平凡 S）。割约束数量为指数级，但可用 max-flow 分离预言机 + 椭球法多项式时间求解 LP 松弛。

7) 算法 3（O(log² n) 近似）：(a) 以 p_e = min{1, 5 ln m·y_e} 独立采样得到边集 H；引理 4.2 证明 H 连通：对每个割 S 有 y(δ(S)) ≥1，取 ℓ≤y(δ(S))<ℓ+1，则 Pr[δ_H(S)=∅] ≤ exp{-5ℓ ln m} = m^{-5ℓ}；结合 Karger 引理（α-最小割个数 ≤ n^{2α}）与 ℓ 的枚举、并合界得失败概率 ≤ Σ_ℓ n^{2ℓ+2}/m^{5ℓ} ≤ 1/(m−1)（利用 m≥n；树的情形 Coverage 与 Connectivity 等价，直接用 O(log n) 算法）。(b) 迭代 T = 2 ln m/(1−1/e) 轮：每轮为每个接口类型抽阈值 t_i，激活 i 于满足 5 ln m·x_{i,v} ≥ t_i 的顶点，取各轮并集。引理 4.4：单轮覆盖 H 中未覆盖边的期望比例 ≥ 1−1/e（用 1−e^{-x} ≥ (1−1/e)x）；引理 4.5：E[|E(H_j)|] ≤ m e^{-α(j−1)}，Markov 不等式给出 Pr[I>T] = O(1/m)；引理 4.6：单轮单点成本以概率 ≥1−1/m⁵ 不超过 15 ln m·OPT，对 n 个顶点与 T 轮并合（失败概率 O(1/m³)），故总成本 ≤ T·15 ln m·OPT ≤ 120 ln²n/(1−1/e)·OPT。

8) 概率工具：文中给出加权 Chernoff 界的自包含证明（Appendix A）。

Result: Coverage：得到 O(log n) 随机近似（高概率成功），因问题泛化 Set Cover 而紧，匹配此前 Ω(log n) 下界（星图、单位成本），并把同构情形下 O(ln Δ + b·min{ln Δ, c_max}) 的结果推广到异构成本、同时改进 O(b·log n) 的算法；同一 LP 松弛的确定性取整给出 k-近似（k 为接口类型数），推广了同构情形的 1+(k−2)(c_max/2c_min) 近似。Connectivity：得到 O(log² n) 随机近似，为该问题首个非平凡近似算法（min-max 变体）。注意摘要用 O(log m)/O(log² m) 表述，正文实际给出 O(log n)/O(log² n)（m≤n² 故等价）。

Conclusion: 本文首次为多接口网络的 Coverage 与 Connectivity（min-max、异构成本）提供了多项式对数级近似：分别为 O(log n)（几乎紧）与 O(log² n)。遗留问题：Connectivity 的 O(log² n) 与下界 Ω(log Δ) 之间仍有差距（星图上 Connectivity 等价于 Coverage，故下界同样适用）；作者亦指出 min-sum 变体可沿用同一思路（算法 1 可直接适配），并留待未来工作。

Abstract: We study problems related to connecting multi-interface networks of wireless devices. These problems are modeled using graphs, where vertices represent the devices and edges represent potential communication links. Each vertex can activate multiple interfaces, and a connection between two vertices is established if they share at least one common active interface. We consider two problems arising in multi-interface networks: Coverage and Connectivity. In the Coverage problem, every connection defined in the network must be established, while in the Connectivity problem, groups of terminals specified in the input should be connected. The solution should minimize the maximum cost incurred by a vertex or the total cost incurred by all vertices. In this work we are interested in approximating the former of the two cost criterions.
  We model both problems using ILPs and we design approximation algorithms based on a randomized rounding of the solution of the linear programming relaxation. For the Coverage problem, this yields an $O(\log m)$-approximation algorithm, which is tight, since the problem generalizes Set-Cover. This improves upon the $O(b\cdot\log n)$-approximation algorithm, where $b$ is a certain graph parameter which can be as large as $Ω(n)$ [Algorithmica '12]. The same relaxation can also be used to get an $k$-approximation algorithm, where $k$ is the number of different interfaces. This generalizes a similar result for the uniform cost case. For the Connectivity problem, we obtain an $O(\log^2 m)$-approximation algorithm, which is the first non-trivial approximation algorithm for this problem. The algorithm is based on a similar LP relaxation with additional cut constraints to ensure connectivity. The rounding procedure is similar to the one for the Coverage problem but requires a more careful analysis to ensure that the connectivity constraints are satisfied.

</details>


### [413] [Accelerated Relax-and-Round for Concave Coverage Problems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06900)
*Matthew Fahrbach,Mehraneh Liaee,Morteza Zadimoghaddam*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 本文提出用于凹覆盖问题的加速松弛-舍入算法，通过投影加速梯度法和平面 Carathéodory 分解结合随机交换舍入技术，在O(mn ε^-1)时间内实现紧近似保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 改进Barman等人(STACS 2021)的relax-and-round框架，通过加速技术提升凹覆盖问题的计算效率。

Method: 用投影加速梯度法替代线性规划松弛，结合Karalias等人的Carathéodory分解算法与Chekuri等人的随机交换舍入，构成 hypersimplex 的专门舍入方案。

Result: 时间复杂度达O(mn ε^-1)，对数奖励函数获得0.827的紧近似比。

Conclusion: 实验表明该算法在最大多覆盖问题上优于使用最先进LP求解器的方法，证明了加速技术在组合优化松弛-舍入框架中的实用价值。

Abstract: We present an accelerated relax-and-round algorithm for concave coverage problems, which generalize the classic maximum coverage problem. Building on the relax-and-round framework of Barman et al. [STACS 2021], we propose two significant improvements. First, we replace the linear programming (LP) relaxation step with a projected accelerated gradient method applied to a smooth surrogate objective to achieve a $\widetilde{O}(mn \varepsilon^{-1})$ running time. Second, we use a specialized rounding scheme for the hypersimplex that combines the Carathéodory decomposition algorithm in Karalias et al. [NeurIPS 2025] with randomized swap rounding of Chekuri et al. [FOCS 2010]. We prove tight approximation ratios for new reward functions, including a $0.827$-approximation for the logarithmic reward $\varphi(x) = \log(1 + x)$. Finally, we conduct maximum multi-coverage experiments on synthetic and real-world graphs, demonstrating that our algorithm outperforms approaches that use state-of-the-art LP solvers.

</details>


### [414] [Modern column generation for estimating single- and multi-purchase ranked list choice models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06948)
*Luciano Costa,Gerardo Berbeglia,Claudio Contardo,Jean-François Cordeau*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 提出列生成框架结合动态规划算法估计排名列表离散选择模型，支持单次和多次购买，实现指数级加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 排名列表离散选择模型中消费者类型数量指数爆炸，传统方法计算不可行

Method: 列生成框架 + 动态规划子问题算法（推广线性排序问题）+ 加速技术

Result: 首个动态规划生成消费者类型的方法，显著加速且保持解质量

Conclusion: 该框架可扩展支持多模型变体，有效应用于估计和 assortment 优化

Abstract: This paper studies the estimation of ranked-list discrete choice models with single and multiple purchases. In this setting, each consumer type is characterized by a ranking over a subset of products and a desired number of purchases, and the estimation task is to identify the set of consumer types and their probabilities that best explain the observed transactional data. This problem is computationally challenging due to the exponential number of possible consumer types and becomes more difficult when multiple purchases are allowed. We propose a column generation framework for this problem. Our main contribution is a dynamic programming algorithm for the column generation subproblem. This subproblem generalizes the linear ordering problem and incorporates acceleration techniques to improve computational efficiency. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first dynamic programming-based approach for generating consumer types in non-parametric models. The proposed framework supports multiple model variants with minor modifications. Computational experiments on synthetic and real data show substantial speedups over existing methods while maintaining high solution quality, and demonstrate effectiveness in both estimation and assortment optimization.

</details>


### [415] [Equivalence of Coarse and Fine-Grained Models for Learning with Distribution Shift](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07005)
*Adam R. Klivans,Shyamal Patel,Konstantinos Stavropoulos,Arsen Vasilyan*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 该论文证明了分布转移学习中两种模型（PQ学习和TDS学习）在分布无关设置下是等价的，并通过对分支程序的弱区分能力进行增强，给出了从PQ到TDS学习的黑盒归约。这导致了第一个TDS学习半空间等基本类的困难性结果，但成员查询可以规避这些困难。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 该研究旨在探索两种主要的分布转移学习模型（PQ学习和TDS学习）之间的关系。PQ学习器仅能拒绝单个离群点，而TDS学习器可以拒绝整个测试集，研究者好奇这两种看似不同的能力是否等价。

Method: 主要技术贡献包括：1）通过分支程序（branching programs）增强已拒绝目标域的TDS学习器的弱区分能力；2）给出从PQ学习到TDS学习的有效黑盒归约；3）使用迭代算法，通过在训练数据上应用连续Forster变换来恢复大间隔分离器。

Result: 证明了PQ学习和TDS学习在分布无关设置下是等价的；给出了第一个TDS学习基本类（如半空间）的计算困难性结果；在赋予成员查询访问权限后，成功实现了半空间的分布无关PQ可学习性。

Conclusion: 该研究证明了PQ学习和TDS学习在分布无关设置下是等价的，并给出了第一个TDS学习基本类（如半空间）的困难性结果。然而，赋予学习器成员查询能力可以规避这些困难性，实现半空间的有效分布无关PQ可学习性。

Abstract: Recent work on provably efficient algorithms for learning with distribution shift has focused on two models: PQ learning (Goldwasser et al. (2020)) and TDS learning (Klivans et al. (2024)). Algorithms for TDS learning are allowed to reject a test set entirely if distribution shift is detected. In contrast, PQ learners may only reject points that are deemed out-of-distribution on an individual basis. Our main result is a surprising equivalence between these two models in the distribution-free setting. In particular, we give an efficient black-box reduction from PQ learning to TDS learning for any Boolean concept class. This equivalence implies the first hardness results for distribution-free TDS learning of basic classes such as halfspaces. The main technical contribution underlying our equivalence is a method for boosting, via branching programs, the weak distinguishing power of TDS learners that have rejected the target domain.
  We also show that giving a learner access to membership queries sidesteps these hardness results and allows for efficient, distribution-free PQ learnability of halfspaces. Our algorithm iteratively recovers large-margin separators obtained by applying successive Forster transforms on the training data.

</details>


### [416] [Estimating Correlation Clustering Cost in Node-Arrival Stream](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07091)
*Kaiwen Liu,Seba Daniela Villalobos,Qin Zhang*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 本文研究了节点到达数据流模型下的相关性聚类问题，提出C⁴Approx流式算法，仅使用节点数量的亚线性空间和常数次遍历即可近似最优聚类代价，并通过仅存储2%的节点达到与Pivot和PrunedPivot算法相当的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统相关性聚类研究主要关注边流模型，但现实场景（如图像、推文等原始对象的数据流）中，节点信息自然产生，相似/不相似边通过相似度函数推导得出。现有方法难以直接应用于此类场景，因此需要研究仅依赖节点信息的流式聚类算法。

Method: 提出C⁴Approx流式算法，采用亚线性空间和常数次遍历策略，通过对节点进行选择性采样和相似度计算，在单遍或多遍数据流中实现相关性聚类成本的近似优化。

Result: 实验表明，C⁴Approx仅需存储2%的节点即可达到与经典Pivot算法及近期PrunedPivot算法相当的性能，且在稀疏图上表现优异。理论方面提供了该问题的下界证明。

Conclusion: C⁴Approx为节点到达数据流模型下的相关性聚类提供了有效的近似算法，兼具理论保证和实用价值，开辟了流式聚类研究的新方向。

Abstract: We study the correlation clustering problem in the node-arrival data stream model. Unlike previous work, where the stream consists of the graph's edges, we focus on the setting in which the stream contains only the nodes. This model better reflects many real-world scenarios in which the data stream naturally consists of raw objects (e.g., images, tweets), and the similar/dissimilar edges are derived through a similarity function. We present C$^4$Approx, a streaming algorithm that approximates the cost of correlation clustering using sublinear space in the number of nodes and a constant number of passes. We further complement this result with lower bounds. Experiments on real-world datasets show that by storing only 2% of the nodes, our algorithm achieves performance comparable to the classic Pivot algorithm and the more recent PrunedPivot algorithm, even on sparse graphs.

</details>


### [417] [Deterministic Monotone Min-Plus Product and Convolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07150)
*Ce Jin,Jaewoo Park,Barna Saha,Yinzhan Xu*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种确定性算法来解决单调最小加法积问题，时间复杂度为 n^(ω+3)/2+o(1) = O(n^2.686)，与现有随机算法相同，同时去掉了随机化这一缺点。该方法可应用于多种下游问题，包括语言编辑距离、RNA折叠、树编辑距离等。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有最快的单调最小加法积算法虽然将时间复杂度从 O(n³) 优化到 O(n^2.686)，但依赖随机化，这会导致所有下游应用也继承随机化特性，在需要确定性保证的场景中不适用。

Method: 通过去随机化技术消除算法中的随机性，同时保持相同的时间复杂度。该方法具有通用性，可推广到矩形矩阵、有界范围 [n^μ] 和列单调矩阵等变体。

Result: 得到确定性算法，时间复杂度为 n^(ω+3)/2+o(1) = O(n^2.686)，改进了之前确定性上界 O(n^2.875)。同时得到确定性单调最小加法卷积算法，时间复杂度为 n^1.5+o(1)。

Conclusion: 去随机化技术成功应用于多个问题，包括语言编辑距离、RNA折叠、最优栈生成、无权重树编辑距离、批量范围众数和近似全对最短路径等。

Abstract: The Monotone Min-Plus Product problem is a useful primitive that has seen many algorithmic applications over the past decade. In this problem, we are given two $n\times n$ integer matrices $A$ and $B$, where each row of $B$ is a monotone non-decreasing sequence of integers from $\{1,\dots,n\}$, and the goal is to compute their Min-Plus product, defined as the $n\times n$ matrix $C$ with $C_{i,j} = \min_{k}\{A_{i,k} + B_{k,j}\}$. The fastest known algorithm for this task [Chi, Duan, Xie, and Zhang, STOC'22] runs in $n^{(ω+3)/2+o(1)} = O(n^{2.686})$ time, significantly improving over the brute-force cubic algorithm. However, its main disadvantage is that it requires randomization, which is then inherited by all downstream applications.
  Our main result is a deterministic algorithm for Monotone Min-Plus product with the same time complexity $n^{(ω+3)/2+o(1)} = O(n^{2.686})$ as its randomized counterpart, improving upon the previous deterministic bound $O(n^{2.875})$ [Gu, Polak, Vassilevska Williams, and Xu, ICALP'21]. Our derandomization also applies to previously studied extensions and variants (e.g., [Dürr, IPL'23]), including rectangular matrices, bounded range $[n^μ]$, and column-monotone matrices. As an immediate consequence, we derandomize state-of-the-art algorithms for multiple problems, including Language Edit Distance, RNA Folding, Optimum Stack Generation, unweighted Tree Edit Distance, Batched Range Mode, and Approximate All-Pairs Shortest Paths.
  Our techniques also yield a deterministic algorithm for the Monotone Min-Plus Convolution problem that runs in $n^{1.5+o(1)}$ time, nearly matching the best known randomized time complexity $\widetilde{O}(n^{1.5})$ [Chi, Duan, Xie, and Zhang, STOC'22]. This algorithm can be used to derandomize state-of-the-art algorithms for Jumbled Indexing for binary strings and several variants of Knapsack.

</details>


### [418] [Connectivity Oracle Under Vertex Failures by Shortcutting Unbreakable Decomposition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07168)
*Xizhe Li,Yaowei Long,David Pidugu,Thatchaphol Saranurak,Benyu Wang*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: We present an improved connectivity oracle under vertex failures that achieves near-linear space and preprocessing time, O(k^6) update time independent of n, and O(k) optimal query time. This improves upon prior work by reducing space from quadratic to near-linear and exponentially improving preprocessing and update/query times through three new techniques: shortcutting over tree decomposition, bootstrapping with n-dependent oracles, and a new patch set mechanism.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Prior connectivity oracles with n-independent update time either require Ω(n²) space or incur 2^{2^{O(k)}} update and query time. Additionally, their preprocessing time is polynomially large in n, far from near-linear. These limitations make prior approaches impractical for large-scale graphs.

Method: We build on the unbreakable decomposition framework of [PSS+22] with three novel contributions: (i) shortcutting over the tree decomposition to achieve near-linear space, (ii) bootstrapping using n-dependent oracles internally to achieve near-linear preprocessing, and (iii) a new patch set mechanism to achieve conditionally optimal O(k) query time.

Result: For constant k, the oracle uses near-linear space and near-linear preprocessing time. After k vertex failures, it performs an O(k^6)-time update independent of graph size n, and answers pairwise connectivity queries in optimal O(k) time.

Conclusion: Our oracle improves upon all prior n-independent update time oracles by achieving near-linear space, near-linear preprocessing time, O(k^6) update time, and O(k) query time. For constant k, this represents space reduction from quadratic to near-linear, and exponential improvement in preprocessing time over prior polynomial-in-n approaches.

Abstract: We give an improved connectivity oracle under vertex failures. After a set of $k$ vertices fails, our oracle performs an $O(k^{6})$-time update independent of the graph size $n$, and then answers pairwise connectivity queries in optimal $O(k)$ time. For constant $k$, it uses near-linear space and can be built in near-linear preprocessing time.
  In contrast, all prior oracles with $n$-independent update time[PSS+22, vdBS19] either require $Ω(n^{2})$ space or incur $2^{2^{O(k)}}$ update and query time. Moreover, their preprocessing time is polynomially large in $n$, far from near-linear.
  Our oracle builds on the unbreakable decomposition framework of[PSS+22], but introduces three new ingredients: (i) shortcutting over the tree decomposition to reduce space from quadratic to near-linear, (ii) bootstrapping that leverages $n$-dependent oracles internally to obtain near-linear preprocessing, and (iii) a new patch set mechanism that yields conditionally optimal $O(k)$ query time.

</details>


### [419] [EPTAS for Hard Graph Cut Problems for Dense Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07265)
*Kaisei Deguchi,Ken-ichi Kawarabayashi,Hiroaki Mori*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 该论文针对everywhere-Ω(1)-稠密图上的基本最小化问题，提出首个高效多项式时间近似方案(EPTAS)，主要贡献是基于弱正则引理设计ConstrainedMinCut的EPTAS，并统一约简得到MinQuotientCut和ProductSparsestCut的EPTAS，避开了之前工作中使用的Lasserre层级或整数规划等复杂工具。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有图割问题的PTAS算法存在运行时间 n^(f(1/ε)) 的瓶颈，对于实际应用而言效率不足，需要将PTAS改进为运行时间仅为 f(1/ε)n^(O(1)) 的EPTAS。

Method: 基于弱正则引理(weak regularity lemma)和采样估计技术(sampling and estimation techniques)设计ConstrainedMinCut的EPTAS，然后通过统一约简将算法作为子程序调用，获得MinQuotientCut和ProductSparsestCut的EPTAS。

Result: 给出四个经典问题的首个EPTAS：ConstrainedMinCut(捕获BalancedSeparator和SmallSetExpansion)、MinQuotientCut、ProductSparsestCut，以及稠密顶点权重的整数版本。

Conclusion: 提出了首个基于弱正则引理和采样估计技术的ConstrainedMinCut的EPTAS算法，并由此统一约简得到MinQuotientCut和ProductSparsestCut的EPTAS。相比之前依赖Lasserre层级或整数规划技术的方法，本方法更加简洁通用。

Abstract: Everywhere-$δ$-dense graphs are defined as graphs on $n$ vertices in which every vertex has degree at least $δn$ for some constant $δ> 0$.
  Approximation schemes are vital for handling NP-hard optimization problems, but for many graph cut problems, existing PTAS algorithms often suffer from running times of $n^{f(1/\varepsilon)}$.
  In this paper, we bring PTASs down to EPTASs for several fundamental minimization problems on everywhere-$Ω(1)$-dense graphs.
  Specifically, we present the first Efficient Polynomial-Time Approximation Scheme (EPTAS), running in time $f(1/\varepsilon)n^{O(1)}$, for the ConstrainedMinCut problem under a global constraint on vertex weights, a problem that captures BalancedSeparator and SmallSetExpansion.
  Moreover, we give the first EPTASs for MinQuotientCut and ProductSparsestCut on everywhere-$δ$-dense graphs with integer-valued dense vertex weights;
  these problems generalize the four well-known problems UniformSparsestCut, EdgeExpansion, Conductance, and NormalizedCut.
  Our main technical contribution is an EPTAS for ConstrainedMinCut, based on the weak regularity lemma and sampling and estimation techniques.
  We then obtain EPTASs for MinQuotientCut and ProductSparsestCut via a unified reduction that invokes this algorithm as a subroutine.
  In contrast, previous works giving PTASs for these problems on everywhere-$δ$-dense graphs typically rely on powerful tools such as the Lasserre hierarchy or specific integer programming technique, which we avoid.

</details>


### [420] [On the Complexity of the Matching Problem of Regular Expressions with Backreferences](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07289)
*Soh Kumabe,Yuya Uezato*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 本文研究带回溯引用的正则表达式（REWBs）的字符串匹配问题的细粒度复杂度。对于硬性下界，证明k-REWBs在SETH下无法在O(n^{2k-ε})时间内解决，且该问题以表达式长度为参数时是W[2]-难的；对于算法上界，为1-use REWBs提出了O(n log² n)时间的算法，显著优于之前最新的O(n²)算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ReDoS攻击（如2016年Stack Overflow和2019年Cloudflare事件）表明，即使二次复杂度的正则表达式匹配引擎也可能被恶意利用，造成系统资源耗尽。带回溯引用的正则表达式（REWBs）具有强大的表达能力，但大大增加了ReDoS风险。核心问题是：能否构建可证明高效的正则表达式匹配引擎？

Method: 1. 归约方法：利用SETH（指数时间假设）证明下界，通过从正则语言成员性问题的下界归约；2. 参数复杂性分析：以表达式长度为参数，采用W[1]/W[2]-难性框架；3. 算法设计：结合后缀树、正则表达式的转换幺半群、分解森林数据结构和字符串周期性质。

Result: 硬性下界：(1) k-REWBs无法在O(n^{2k-ε})时间内解决（基于SETH）；(2) 以表达式长度为参数时是W[2]-难的（强于之前的W[1]-难）；(3) 2-use 2-REWBs无法在n^{1+o(1)}时间内解决（除非三角形检测问题可在该时间内解决）。算法上界：1-use REWBs可在O(n log² n)时间内解决。

Conclusion: 带回溯引用的正则表达式匹配问题具有固有的计算困难性，即使简单的2-use 2-REWB实例也无法达到线性时间。对于实际应用中广泛使用的1-use REWBs，O(n log² n)算法提供了有效且可证明高效的解决方案，为构建安全的正则表达式引擎提供了理论依据。

Abstract: ReDoS is a well-known type of algorithmic complexity attack, where an adversary supplies maliciously crafted strings to a regular expression matching engine, aiming to exhaust computational resources of systems. Even quadratic-time behavior in matching engines has been exploited in successful attacks, as exemplified by major outages at Stack Overflow (2016) and Cloudflare (2019). These incidents motivate a fundamental question: Is it possible to construct matching engines that are provably efficient, running in (near-)linear time in the length of the input string?
  For classical regular expressions (REGEX), Thompson's construction yields a linear-time algorithm. However, practical engines support powerful features such as backreferences, which strictly extend the expressive power of REGEX but unfortunately increase the risk of ReDoS attacks.
  This paper investigates the fine-grained complexity of the string matching problem for regular expressions with backreferences (REWBs). Specifically, we consider $r$-use $k$-REWBs.
  On the hardness side, we show that the string matching problem for $k$-REWBs cannot be solved in $O(n^{2k-ε})$ time for any $ε> 0$ under SETH. We also prove that this problem is \textbf{W[2]}-hard when parameterized by the length of the REWB expression, strengthening the previous \textbf{W[1]}-hardness. Moreover, we prove that this problem for $2$-use $2$-REWBs cannot be solved in $n^{1+o(1)}$ time unless the triangle detection problem can be solved in that time.
  On the algorithmic side, we present an $O(n \log^2 n)$-time algorithm for $1$-use REWBs, which significantly improves upon the recent $O(n^2)$-time algorithm by Nogami and Terauchi (MFCS, 2025). Our algorithm employs several techniques including suffix trees, transition monoids of REGEXes, factorization forest data structures, and periodicity of strings.

</details>


### [421] [Optimal Learning-Augmented Algorithm for Online Bidding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07349)
*Changyeol Lee,Dahoon Lee,Jongseo Lee,Yongho Shin,Changki Yun*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 本文研究了学习增强在线竞价算法中随机设置下的鲁棒性与一致性权衡问题。通过引入竞价档案概念并利用延迟微分方程系统刻画最优策略，成功证明了提出的随机算法达到了Pareto最优性能，并将其方法推广至线性搜索问题取得了显著改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在随机设置下，在线竞价学习增强算法中鲁棒性与一致性之间的权衡界限尚未完全理解，现有上界与下界之间存在差距，需要寻找Pareto最优的随机算法来填补这一理论空白。

Method: 提出了竞价档案（bidding profile）这一新型框架，用于表示算法生成的出价分布；证明了任何竞价算法都可以无损约简为基于竞价档案的算法；通过延迟微分方程系统刻画了最优竞价档案的数学特征。

Result: 提出了Pareto最优的随机学习增强竞价算法，完整闭合了随机设置下的理论与实践差距，并将该方法成功扩展到线性搜索问题，显著提升了现有学习增强算法的性能。

Conclusion: 本研究通过引入竞价档案概念和延迟微分方程系统，成功闭合了随机学习增强算法中鲁棒性与一致性之间的界限，并展示了该方法在解决线性搜索问题中的广泛适用性，为在线优化领域提供了重要的理论突破。
