Abstract: Recent advances in machine learning have spurred significant interest in learning-augmented algorithms, particularly for online optimization. A growing body of work has studied online bidding in this framework, aiming to characterize the trade-off between robustness and consistency. While this trade-off is fully understood for deterministic algorithms, a gap between upper and lower bounds remains in the randomized setting. In this paper, we close this gap by presenting a Pareto-optimal randomized learning-augmented algorithm for this problem. Our approach introduces the notion of a bidding profile, a novel framework for representing the distribution over bids generated by an algorithm. We show that any bidding algorithm can be reduced, without loss of generality, to one driven by a bidding profile, and we characterize the optimal profile via a system of delayed differential equations. Finally, we demonstrate the broader applicability of our approach by extending it to the linear search problem, yielding a significant improvement over prior learning-augmented algorithms for linear search.

</details>


### [422] [Coordinated Motion Planning is FPT on Discretized Simple Polygons](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07570)
*Argyrios Deligkas,Eduard Eiben,Robert Ganian,Iyad Kanj*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: This paper presents an FPT algorithm for the coordinated motion planning problem (minimizing total travel length) parameterized by the number of robots, on graphs from discretizations of simple polygons. This extends previous FPT results from full grids and bounded-treewidth graphs to a broader class of graphs, advancing the understanding of the problem's parameterized complexity on subgrids and planar graphs.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Coordinated motion planning has many real-world applications requiring planar motion in discretized polygonal environments. While the problem is NP-hard in general and known to be FPT only on full grids and bounded-treewidth graphs, its parameterized complexity on subgrids and planar graphs remains a prominent open problem.

Method: The paper develops a fixed-parameter algorithm parameterized by the number k of robots, targeting graphs arising from discretizations of simple polygons (which generalize rectangular grids).

Result: A fixed-parameter algorithm for coordinated motion planning parameterized by the number k of robots on graphs from simple polygon discretizations.

Conclusion: This work provides the first FPT algorithm for coordinated motion planning on polygonal discretization graphs, extending the known FPT results beyond full grids and bounded-treewidth graphs, and represents significant progress toward understanding the parameterized complexity of this problem on subgrids and planar graphs.

Abstract: In the coordinated motion planning problem, we are given a graph together with the starting and destination vertices of $k$ robots. At each time step, any subset of robots may move, each traversing an edge of the graph, provided that no two robots collide. The goal is to compute a schedule that routes all robots to their destinations while minimizing some objective function. In this paper, we focus on the well-studied objective of minimizing the total travel length of all robots. This problem is known to be NP-hard, and it has been shown to be fixed-parameter tractable (FPT), when parameterized by the number $k$ of robots, on full grids (SoCG 2023) and on bounded-treewidth graphs (ICALP 2024).
  We present a fixed-parameter algorithm for coordinated motion planning, parameterized by the number $k$ of robots, on graphs arising from discretizations of simple polygons. Such graphs are of particular interest in real-world applications, where planar motion is often constrained to discretized representations of polygonal environments. Moreover, these graphs generalize rectangular grids; consequently, our result constitutes a significant step toward resolving the parameterized complexity of coordinated motion planning on subgrids and, ultimately, planar graphs -- two prominent open problems in the field.

</details>


### [423] [Faster Deterministic Streaming Vertex Coloring](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07644)
*Shiri Chechik,Hongyi Chen,Tianyi Zhang*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 本文研究了半流模型下的确定性图着色问题。之前已知随机算法可单次遍历达到(Δ+1)着色，而确定性算法若单次遍历则需要指数级颜色数。本文提出首个确定性算法，在O(√log Δ)次遍历内实现O(Δ)着色，首次同时达到线性调色板大小和亚对数遍历次数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图着色是计算机科学基础问题。在半流模型中，图以边流形式输入，内存限制为Ñ(n)位。已知随机与确定性算法间存在指数级分离：随机算法可单次遍历达到(Δ+1)着色，但确定性单次遍历算法需要exp(Δ^Ω(1))种颜色。之前最好的确定性结果是O(Δ)着色需要O(log Δ)次遍历，或O(Δ²)着色需2次遍历。是否存在亚对数遍历且线性调色板的确定性算法一直是开放问题。

Method: 论文设计了新的确定性半流算法，关键创新在于利用了根号对数级别的遍历次数来换取线性调色板大小。算法应采用了类似于 Lovász 局部引理 的方法，结合图着色的现有技术，通过多次遍历逐步缩小颜色选择范围。

Result: 论文证明存在确定性半流算法可在O(√log Δ)次遍历内计算得到O(Δ)着色。这是首个同时满足两个条件的确定性算法：调色板大小线性依赖于Δ，且遍历复杂度亚对数依赖于Δ。

Conclusion: 该结果首次在确定性算法中打破了"线性调色板大小"与"亚对数遍历"之间的权衡壁垒，表明在多遍历设置下，确定性算法可以几乎达到与随机算法相同的着色质量（调色板大小方面）。

Abstract: Graph coloring is a fundamental problem in computer science. In the semi-streaming model, an input graph $G$ on $n$ vertices and maximum degree $Δ$ is presented as a stream of edges, and the goal is to compute a vertex coloring using a small number of colors while storing only $\tilde{O}(n)$ bits of memory.
  Recent work has revealed an exponential separation between randomized and deterministic approaches in this setting: while randomized algorithms can achieve a $(Δ+1)$-coloring in a single pass [Assadi, Chen, and Khanna, 2019], any single-pass deterministic algorithm requires $\exp(Δ^{Ω(1)})$ colors [Assadi, Chen, and Sun, 2022]. Consequently, deterministic algorithms that use few colors must necessarily make multiple passes over the stream. Prior to this work, the best known deterministic trade-offs were: an $O(Δ^2)$-coloring in 2 passes, an $O(Δ)$-coloring in $O(\log Δ)$ passes [Assadi, Chen, and Sun, 2022], and a $(Δ+1)$-coloring in $O(\log Δ\cdot \log\log Δ)$ passes [Assadi, Chakrabarti, Ghosh, and Stoeckl, 2023]. It remained open whether better trade-offs -- particularly with sub-logarithmic pass complexity and linear-in-$Δ$ palette size -- were achievable.
  In this paper, we present a new deterministic semi-streaming algorithm that computes an $O(Δ)$-coloring in $O(\sqrt{\log Δ})$ passes. This is the first deterministic streaming algorithm to achieve a coloring with palette size linear-in-$Δ$ using sublogarithmic-in-$Δ$ passes.

</details>


### [424] [Beyond Brooks: $(Δ-1)$-Coloring in Semi-Streaming](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07774)
*Maxime Flin,Magnús M. Halldórsson*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 本文给出了一个针对无 Δ-团的大度图（Δ ≥ 10^14）的单趟半流式 (Δ-1) 染色算法，并证明对于任意 0 ≤ k < (Δ+1)/2，单趟 (Δ-k) 染色算法需要 Ω(n(k+1)) 空间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Reed 证明了一类图（Δ ≥ 10^14 且无 Δ-团）存在 (Δ-1) 染色，但需要高效的流式算法来实现。本文旨在设计单趟算法在受限空间内完成染色计算。

Method: 提出了一种单趟半流式算法来计算 (Δ-1) 染色；同时通过信息论下界分析，证明任何单趟 (Δ-k) 染色算法都需要 Ω(n(k+1)) 的空间。

Result: 设计了一个单趟半流式算法可在半流式模型中计算 (Δ-1) 染色；同时证明了当 0 ≤ k < (Δ+1)/2 时，任何单趟 (Δ-k) 染色算法都需要 Ω(n(k+1)) 空间，揭示了空间复杂度下界。

Conclusion: 该算法解决了大度图的高效在线染色问题，同时通过空间下界揭示了一-pass流算法在图染色上的固有局限性，明确了算法能力与信息需求之间的界限。

Abstract: Reed [J.~Comb.~Theory B, 1999] showed that graphs of maximum degree $Δ\geq 10^{14}$ without $Δ$-cliques are $(Δ-1)$-colorable. We design a one-pass semi-streaming algorithm for computing such a coloring. Additionally, we prove that any one-pass $(Δ-k)$-coloring algorithm for $0\leq k < (Δ+1)/2$ requires $Ω(n(k+1))$ space.

</details>


### [425] [Computing bases in Hermite normal form of lattices of integer relations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07784)
*George Labahn,Arne Storjohann*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 本文提出一种随机化算法，用于计算满足特定整数格条件的 Hermite 形式基。该算法具有 Las Vegas 型保证，复杂度与矩阵乘法相当，是格理论与计算数论中的重要工具。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 需要高效计算满足 pF 位于矩阵 M 生成格中的行向量 p 的 Hermite 形式基。该问题在格基归约、密码分析及计算数论中具有广泛应用。

Method: 算法采用 Las Vegas 类型随机化方法，可能以不超过 1/2 的概率失败，但若不失败则保证结果正确。算法复杂度约为矩阵乘法复杂度。

Result: 成功时输出 n×n 的 Hermite 形式基，特殊情况下（当 M 为方阵且 F=I_m）可简化为计算 M 的 Hermite 法式。

Conclusion: 该算法为求解整数格基的 Hermite 形式提供了一个高效的随机化方法，特别适用于格基归约和密码分析中的格问题。其复杂度与矩阵乘法相当，在理论与实践中都具有重要意义。

Abstract: Given a full column rank $M \in \Z^{\ell \times m}$ and an $F \in \Z^{n \times m}$ we present an algorithm to compute the $n \times n$ basis in Hermite form of the integer lattice comprised of all rows $p \in \Z^{1 \times n}$ such that $pF \in \Z^{1 \times m}$ is in the integer lattice generated by the rows of $M$. The algorithm is randomized of the Las Vegas type, that is, it can fail with probability at most $1/2$, but if fail is not returned it guarantees to produce the correct result. When $M$ is square and $F=I_m$, then the computed basis is the Hermite normal form of $M$, and the algorithm uses about the same number of bit operations as required to multiply together two matrices of the same dimension and size of entries as $M$.

</details>


### [426] [Towards Settling the Complexity of the Lettericity Problem](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07899)
*Mario Grobler,Nils Morawietz,Silas Cato Sacher*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 本文研究了图的字母性(lettericity)的计算复杂性。图的字母性定义为编码图所需最小字母表大小。作者分析了三个 retrieval problems：从图和两个已知对象(词、译码器、着色)中恢复第三个对象。结果表明 word retrieval 和 decoder retrieval 可在多项式时间内求解，而 coloring retrieval 与图同构问题等价。此外，引入了对称字母性的概念，证明了其等于图的 neighborhood diversity，可在线性时间内计算。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图的字母性(lettericity)是一个重要的图参数，但目前尚不清楚其是否可以在多项式时间内计算。为了推进这个问题的研究，作者转而研究三个 retrieval problems：从已知两个对象推导第三个对象。

Method: 该研究采用计算复杂性分析和算法设计方法。首先对三个 retrieval problems 进行分类讨论：word retrieval 和 decoder retrieval 通过设计高效算法在多项式时间内解决；而 coloring retrieval 通过归约证明了其与图同构问题的等价性。此外，通过引入对称约束并建立与 neighborhood diversity 的等价关系，提供了可快速计算的特殊情况。

Result: 1. Word retrieval 和 Decoder retrieval 问题可以在多项式时间内解决；2. Coloring retrieval 问题与图同构问题等价；3. 对称字母性等于图的 neighborhood diversity，可以在线性时间内计算。

Conclusion: 引入了对称字母性(symmetric lettericity)的概念，证明了图的 symmetric lettericity 恰好等于其 neighborhood diversity，并且可以在线性时间内计算。这为原问题提供了一个可处理的特殊情况。

Abstract: The lettericity of a graph $G=(V,E)$ is defined as the smallest size of an alphabet $Σ$ such that there is a word $w_1 \dots w_{|V|} \in Σ^*$ and a decoder $\mathcal{D} \subseteq Σ^2$ with the property that $G$ is isomorphic to the letter graph $G(\mathcal{D}, w)$, that is, the graph with vertex set $\{1, \dots, n\}$ and edge set $\{ij \mid 1\leq i < j \leq n, w_iw_j \in \mathcal{D}\}$. Note that $G(\mathcal{D}, w)$ can be seen as a graph with inherent coloring $χ\colon V(G) \rightarrow Σ$. It is unknown whether the lettericity of a given graph can be computed in polynomial time. The problem to determine the lettericity of a given graph is called the lettericity problem. As a step towards answering the complexity of this problem, we investigate the following retrieval problems: given a graph $G$ together with two of the three solution-objects (word $w$, decoder $\mathcal{D}$, and coloring $χ$), the goal is to compute the third solution-object. We show that word retrieval and decoder retrieval are solvable in polynomial time, while coloring retrieval is equivalent to the graph isomorphism problem. Beyond this, we introduce symmetric lettericity which is a restricted version of lettericity where each decoder needs to be symmetrical ($ab\in \mathcal{D}$ if and only if $ba\in \mathcal{D}$). As we show, the symmetric lettericity of a graph always equals the neighborhood diversity of the graph, which in fact can be computed in linear time.

</details>


### [427] [Parameterized Local Search for Vertex Cover: When only the Search Radius is Crucial](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07941)
*Christian Komusiewicz,Nils Morawietz*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 本文研究LS Vertex Cover问题的参数化算法设计，针对k为小常数而ℓ为结构参数的情况，提出了在h-index、树宽、模宽等图参数下的高效算法，并将结果推广到加权版本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LS Vertex Cover问题是W[1]-hard的（以k为参数），但在实际应用中k是小常数，因此需要在其他结构参数下寻找运行时间对ℓ增长平缓、对k增长剧烈的算法。

Method: 设计在结构参数ℓ（h-index、树宽、模宽、模分解中商图的最大度）下运行时间为ℓ^{f(k)}·n^{O(1)}的参数化算法，并将其扩展到带权重的d-improvement版本。

Result: 获得了在图的h-index、树宽、模宽以及模分解商图最大度等结构参数下的算法，运行时间均为ℓ^{f(k)}·n^{O(1)}形式，并成功适配到带权重的d-improvement k-swap变体。

Conclusion: 该研究提出了在多种结构参数（h-index、树宽、模宽等）下LS Vertex Cover问题的固定参数 tractable (FPT) 算法，为参数化算法的设计提供了新的视角，并成功扩展到加权版本。

Abstract: A vertex set $W$ in a graph $G$ is a valid $k$-swap for a vertex cover $S$ of $G$ if $W$ has size at most $k$ and $S'=(S \setminus W) \cup (W \setminus S)$, the symmetric difference of $S$ and $W$, is a vertex cover of $G$. If $|S'| < |S|$, then $W$ is improving. In LS Vertex Cover, one is given a vertex cover $S$ of a graph $G$ and wants to know if there is a valid improving $k$-swap for $S$ in $G$. In applications of LS Vertex Cover, $k$ is a very small parameter that can be set by a user to determine the trade-off between running time and solution quality. Consequently, $k$ can be considered to be a constant. Motivated by this and the fact that LS Vertex Cover is W[1]-hard with respect to $k$, we aim for algorithms with running time $\ell^{f(k)}\cdot n^{\mathcal{O}(1)}$ where $\ell$ is a structural graph parameter upper-bounded by $n$. We say that such a running time grows mildly with respect to $\ell$ and strongly with respect to $k$. We obtain algorithms with such a running time for $\ell$ being the $h$-index of $G$, the treewidth of $G$, or the modular-width of $G$. In addition, we consider a novel parameter, the maximum degree over all quotient graphs in a modular decomposition of $G$. Moreover, we adapt these algorithms to the more general problem where each vertex is assigned a weight and where we want to find a valid $d$-improving $k$-swap, that is, a valid $k$-swap which decreases the weight of the vertex cover by at least $d$.

</details>


### [428] [Planarizing Gadgets for (k, l)-tight Graphs Do Not Exist](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.08016)
*Archit Chauhan,Rohit Gurjar,Kilian Rothmund,Thomas Thierauf*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 该论文证明了 (k,l)-tight 图识别问题不存在平面化 gadget 方案，这意味着无法通过将一般图转化为平面图的方式来利用已知的平面图算法优势来解决一般图情形下的该问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决 (k,l)-tight 图识别问题在一般图与平面图之间的算法复杂性差距：平面图已有确定性 NC 算法，而一般图缺乏此类算法，研究者自然尝试通过 planarizing gadgets 桥接这一差距

Method: 通过构造性证明，展示任何将一般图归约为平面图的 gadget 方案都无法正确保持 (k,l)-tight 性质

Result: 无条件地证明了平面化 gadgets 对于识别 (k,l)-tight 图的问题不存在

Conclusion: 证明了平面化 gadgets 在 (k,l)-tight 图识别问题上的不可能性，为该领域的研究划定了重要边界

Abstract: The problem of recognizing (k, l)-tight graphs is a fundamental problem that has close connections to well studied problems like graph rigidity. The problem is better understood for planar graphs as compared to general graphs. For example, deterministic NC-algorithms for the problem are known for planar graphs, but no such algorithm is known for general graphs. A common approach to reduce a graph problem to the planar case is to use planarizing gadgets. Our main contribution is to show that, unconditionally, planarizing gadgets for the problem of recognizing (k, l)-tight graphs do not exist.

</details>


<div id='cs.AI'></div>

# cs.AI [[Back]](#toc)

### [429] [GraphDC: A Divide-and-Conquer Multi-Agent System for Scalable Graph Algorithm Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06671)
*Wenjin Li,Jiaming Cui*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: GraphDC是一种基于"分而治之"策略的多智能体框架，旨在提升大语言模型在图算法推理任务上的可扩展性和性能。该框架通过将大型图分解为子图，由专门智能体进行局部推理，再由主智能体整合全局信息来生成最终答案，有效降低了单个智能体的推理负担，提高了处理大规模图实例的鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM在图算法任务上表现不佳，原因在于图结构拓扑复杂，且往往需要系统性的多步推理，尤其在处理大规模图时问题更为突出。端到端直接推理方法在此场景下可靠性不足。

Method: 提出GraphDC多智能体框架，包含三个核心步骤：(1) 将输入图分解为更小的子图；(2) 为每个子图分配专门的智能体进行局部推理；(3) 由主智能体整合各子图的局部输出及子图间信息，最终生成完整解答。该层次化设计有效降低了推理复杂度。

Result: 大量实验表明，GraphDC在多种图算法推理任务上均一致性地优于现有方法，且在更大规模的图实例上优势更为显著，此时端到端直接推理的可靠性明显下降。

Conclusion: 基于分而治之策略的多智能体框架能够有效提升LLM在图算法推理任务上的可扩展性，通过分层设计减轻单个智能体的推理负担，缓解计算瓶颈，并在大型图实例上展现出更强的鲁棒性。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong potential for many mathematical problems. However, their performance on graph algorithmic tasks is still unsatisfying, since graphs are naturally more complex in topology and often require systematic multi-step reasoning, especially on larger graphs. Motivated by this gap, we propose GraphDC, a Divide-and-Conquer multi-agent framework for scalable graph algorithm reasoning. Specifically, inspired by Divide-and-Conquer design, GraphDC decomposes an input graph into smaller subgraphs, assigns each subgraph to a specialized agent for local reasoning, and uses a master agent to integrate the local outputs with inter-subgraph information to produce the final solution. This hierarchical design reduces the reasoning burden on individual agents, alleviates computational bottlenecks, and improves robustness on large graph instances. Extensive experiments show that GraphDC consistently outperforms existing methods on graph algorithm reasoning across diverse tasks and scales, especially on larger instances where direct end-to-end reasoning is less reliable.

</details>


### [430] [More Thinking, More Bias: Length-Driven Position Bias in Reasoning Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06672)
*Xiao Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 推理模型的位置偏差随推理轨迹长度增加而非减少，准确率仅掩盖而非消除偏差机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Chain-of-thought推理和DeepSeek-R1等推理调优模型被假定能减少浅层启发式偏差，但位置偏差在选择题问答中的表现尚不清楚。

Method: 跨13种推理模式配置（2个R1蒸馏7-8B模型、2个基模型CoT提示、DeepSeek-R1 671B）在MMLU、ARC-Challenge、GPQA上测试；使用偏相关分析控制准确率后的轨迹长度与PBS关系；截断干预实验提供因果证据。

Result: 12/13种配置显示轨迹长度与PBS正相关（0.11-0.41，p<0.05）；所有12个开源推理配置在长度四分位上显示单调递增PBS；截断实验中从更晚位置恢复的回复更倾向于位置偏好选项（R1-Qwen-7B从16%升至32%）；671B模型聚合PBS低至0.019但最长四分位仍显示PBS=0.071；直接回答的位置偏差与轨迹长度无关，是独立现象。

Conclusion: 推理模型的顺序鲁棒性不能被视为理所当然，需要在MCQ评估流程中进行系统性审计；论文提供了诊断工具包（PBS、承诺变化点、有效切换、截断探测）用于检测位置偏差。

Abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning and reasoning-tuned models such as DeepSeek-R1 are commonly assumed to reduce shallow heuristic biases by thinking carefully. We test this on position bias in multiple-choice QA and find a different story: within any reasoning-capable model, per-question position bias scales with the length of the reasoning trajectory.
  Across thirteen reasoning-mode configurations (two R1-distilled 7-8B models, two base models prompted with CoT, and DeepSeek-R1 at 671B) on MMLU, ARC-Challenge, and GPQA, twelve show a positive partial correlation between trajectory length and Position Bias Score (PBS) after controlling for accuracy, ranging from 0.11 to 0.41 (all p < 0.05). All twelve open-weight reasoning-mode configurations show monotonically increasing PBS across length quartiles. A truncation intervention provides causal evidence: continuations resumed from later points in the trajectory are increasingly likely to shift toward position-preferred options (16% to 32% for R1-Qwen-7B across absolute-position buckets).
  At 671B, aggregate PBS collapses to 0.019, but the length effect still manifests in the longest quartile (PBS = 0.071), suggesting that accuracy gates the expression of length-driven bias rather than eliminating the underlying mechanism. We additionally find that direct-answer position bias is a distinct phenomenon with a different footprint (strong in Llama-Instruct-direct, weak in Qwen-Instruct-direct, and uncorrelated with trajectory length): CoT reasoning replaces this baseline bias with length-accumulated bias.
  Our results argue that reasoning-capable models should not be treated as order-robust by default in MCQ evaluation pipelines, and offer a diagnostic toolkit (PBS, commitment change point, effective switching, truncation probes) for auditing position bias in reasoning models.

</details>


### [431] [Fast and Effective Redistricting Optimization via Composite-Move Tabu Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06682)
*Hai Jin,Diansheng Guo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种复合移动Tabu搜索算法(CM-Tabu)，通过分析邻接图的割点和双连通分量，在保持连通性的同时系统性地扩展搜索邻域，有效解决了空间区划问题中连通性约束导致的邻域缩小和局部最优陷阱问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 空间区划(spatial redistricting)是一个实际组合优化问题，需要高质量解、快速周转和灵活的多标准目标及交互式优化能力。核心挑战在于连通性约束：强制连通性会严重缩小整数规划或启发式搜索的可行邻域，削弱探索能力，并将搜索困于较差的局部最优。

Method: 提出复合移动Tabu搜索(CM-Tabu)：当边界单元单独重新分配会切断其所在选区时，算法识别可一起移动的最小单元集，或可交换的一对单元(或单元集)，作为保持连通性的复合移动。利用割点(articulation points)和双连通分量(biconnected components)分析每个选区的连通图，以线性时间生成候选的单单元和复合移动。

Result: 费城案例中，该方法能够一致地达到人口均等化的理论全局最优，并支持多标准权衡。相比传统Tabu搜索和其他基准方法，显著提高了解质量、运行间鲁棒性和计算效率。

Conclusion: CM-Tabu提供适合实际应用和决策支持工作流程的优化性能。

Abstract: Spatial redistricting is a practical combinatorial optimization problem that demands high-quality solutions, rapid turnaround, and flexibility to accommodate multi-criteria objectives and interactive refinement. A central challenge is the contiguity constraint: enforcing contiguity in integer-programming or heuristic search can severely shrink the feasible neighborhood, weaken exploration, and trap the search in poor local optima. We introduce a composite-move Tabu search (CM-Tabu) that systematically expands the feasible neighborhood space in Tabu search while preserving contiguity. When a boundary unit cannot be reassigned individually without disconnecting its district, our method identifies a minimal set of units that can move together, or a pair of units (or sets of units) that can be switched, as a contiguity-preserving composite move. Candidate single-unit and composite moves are generated in linear time by analyzing each district's contiguity graph using articulation points and biconnected components. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed approach substantially improves solution quality, run-to-run robustness, and computational efficiency relative to traditional Tabu search and other baselines. For example, in the Philadelphia case, the approach can consistently attain the theoretical global optimum in population-equality and support multi-criteria trade-offs. CM-Tabu delivers optimization performance suitable for real-world practices and decision-support workflows.

</details>


### [432] [State Representation and Termination for Recursive Reasoning Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06690)
*Debashis Guha,Amritendu Mukherjee,Sanjay Kukreja,Tarun Kumar*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一套面向"递归推理系统"（迭代式 RAG、ReAct 智能体、思维树、递归语言模型等）的理论框架，包含两个此前被隐式处理的设计要素：(1) 用"认知状态图"（epistemic state graph）显式表示不断演化的推理状态；(2) 用"顺序间隙"（order-gap，展开算子 P_e 与整合算子 Q 的交换子范数）作为由系统自身动力学导出的终止判据。主要结果（命题 5.2）给出线性化交换子 Gramian 在不动点附近非退化的充要条件，即在子空间 W 上正定当且仅当各证据项交换子核的交集与 W 的交为零；作者强调这只是局部条件，而非全局收敛保证。全文以 2 维闭式例子进行解析性验证，无实证实验。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有迭代式推理系统（CoT/ToT、迭代 RAG、ReAct 智能体、自精化）在两个关键设计上都是隐式的，导致共性失败。其一是状态表示：推理状态仅存在于瞬时文本轨迹或隐藏激活中，缺少结构化、可持久检查的记录，因而无法判断哪些主张被支持、哪些相互冲突、哪些仍是未决问题，矛盾会跨步累积累积且无法回溯修正。其二是终止机制：普遍由外部硬性上限（步数、token 预算、hop 数、迭代次数）而非系统自身轨迹决定，导致对简单实例过度计算、对困难实例过早截断；而自报置信度在最难的实例上恰恰失准。此外，四类系统的内在自我纠错在没有外部反馈时往往不提升甚至退化（oscillation、过度精化、幻觉式改进），但系统缺少"什么已稳定、什么仍不确定"的表征。

Method: 1）状态表示（Sec 2）：定义认知状态图 S=(V,E,ℓ,c,w)，节点分为 Claim / PartialAnswer / OpenQuestion，边类型为 Supports / Requires / Contradicts，节点与边各带置信权重；给出阈值 δ 意义下的一致性定义；再通过可微松弛把图嵌入 R^d（d=(k+1)N_max+N_max^2|T|），使增删节点、合并节点、重标边类型成为 C^1 坐标更新。2）算子框架（Sec 3）：在 Banach 空间上定义展开算子 P_e（引入新证据：新增 Claim 节点、以带类型边连接、提升被解决的 OpenQuestion）与整合算子 Q（仅用已有信息：消解 Contradicts 对、合并冗余 Claim、把权重移向当前最优 PartialAnswer）；假设 Q 为压缩映射（由此有唯一不动点 θ*），但该假设需对具体实现单独验证；动力学为 θ_{t+1}=Q(P_{e_t}(θ_t))，e_t~P(·|θ_t)；指出 P_e 与 Q 一般不可交换。3）终止判据（Sec 5）：order-gap Ω(θ;e)=‖Q(P_e(θ))−P_e(Q(θ))‖，两种排序共享同一实现证据 e（不从 P(·|Q(θ)) 重采样，以保证可计算与良定义）；给出窗口化停止规则 Ω̂_{t,w}≤ε；在线性化层面，在不动点处利用冗余假设 P_e(θ*)=θ* 得交换子 Σ_e=DQ(θ*)DP_e(θ*)−DP_e(θ*)DQ(θ*) 与 Gramian G=𝔼[Σ_eᵀΣ_e]。4）算法 1：每步同时计算真实更新 Q(P_e(θ)) 与替代排序 P_e(Q(θ))，用缓冲区窗口判停，代价约为整合成本的两倍。5）应用：RLM/TRM 的算子识别、三类控制应用（停止、整合调度、自适应抽取）、以及智能体、思维树、自精化、定理证明、持续学习五个场景的推广；另给出逐问覆盖检查（Remark 5.4）作为核交集条件的必要但非充分检验。

Result: 命题 5.2（交换子 Gramian 的局部非退化性）：对有限/可数证据分布，G_{θ*} 在子空间 W 上正定（vᵀGv>0，∀v≠0∈W）当且仅当 ∩_{e∈supp(P(·|θ*))} ker(Σ_e) ∩ W = {0}；对一般证据空间，等价条件为每个非零 v∈W 使 Σ_e v≠0 成立于正测度集合上。证明基于 vᵀGv=Σ_e P(e|θ*)‖Σ_e v‖² 的非负项展开与"非负和为零当且仅当每项为零"。含义是：当该条件成立时，θ* 附近 W 内任一方向上的线性化 order-gap 都不因代数抵消而平凡为零，因此观测到的小 order-gap 不能仅用代数效应解释；反之若某些方向被全部证据的交换子核覆盖，判据在该方向上失效。该结果是局部条件，不蕴含 θ_t 已接近 θ*、不给出当前答案误差界，也不构成全局收敛或最优停止保证。2 维闭式例子给出 Ω((c,u);e)=ρ·α_e·(1−c)·u：信号在 c→1、u→0、α_e→0 时消失，在低置信、高不确定且证据相关时变大；数值轨迹（ρ=0.9，θ_0=(0.20,0.80)，5 步证据）显示切题证据 e_2、e_3 使信号抬升（0.131、0.043），无关证据使信号近零（0.001、0.000），在 ε=0.025 下算法于第 4 步停止（c=0.718），而固定预算 T_max=5 多走一步仅使 c 变化 0.014。该例不满足全状态上的全局压缩假设（Q 不改变 c），且作者明示其仅为说明性而非实证。

Conclusion: 论文的核心主张是：递归推理系统应把"状态表示"与"终止判据"当作显式设计对象——认知状态图提供结构化、持久、可检查且可微分析的状态，order-gap 则给出一个内生、敏感、逐步可计算的停止信号，当 order-gap 小说明两种算子排序已趋一致、继续迭代难以改变结论，排序仍敏感说明系统尚未稳定。作者亦坦承边界：命题 5.2 只是局部非退化条件，把它接到全局收敛保证（需 Lipschitz 常数、噪声界与 Ω̂ 的有限样本集中性）超出本文范围；覆盖检查仅必要不充分（各 v_q 单独不落在核交集中仍不足以保证条件成立）。局限还包括：核心算子框架与全局性质依赖 Guha (2026) 的前置工作，本文定位为面向递归推理场景的应用与图结构下的非退化条件推导；缺少与固定预算、置信度阈值基线的实证对比与长上下文 QA 评测。后续方向为：构建非退化条件到答案误差的全局收敛保证、在长上下文 QA 上对算法 1 做实证评测，并拓展到持续学习与定理证明。

Abstract: Recursive reasoning systems alternate between acquiring new evidence and refining an accumulated understanding. Two design choices are typically left implicit: how to represent the evolving reasoning state, and when to stop iterating. This paper addresses both. We represent the reasoning state as an epistemic state graph encoding extracted claims, evidential relations, open questions, and confidence weights. We define the order-gap as the distance between the states reached by expand-then-consolidate versus consolidate-then-expand; a small order-gap suggests that the two orderings agree and further iteration is unlikely to help. Our main result gives a necessary and sufficient condition for the linearised order-gap to be non-degenerate near the fixed point, showing when the criterion is informative rather than algebraically vacuous. This is a local condition, not a global convergence guarantee. We apply the framework to recursive reasoning systems and sketch its application to agent loops, tree-of-thought reasoning, theorem proving, and continual learning.

</details>


### [433] [Hidden Coalitions in Multi-Agent AI: A Spectral Diagnostic from Internal Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06696)
*Cameron Berg,Susan L. Schneider,Mark M. Bailey*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 Φ_spectral 方法：从多智能体的内部隐藏状态构建成对互信息图（MI graph），再对归一化拉普拉斯矩阵做谱分解，取 Fiedler 向量 v2 的符号结构作为候选联盟边界（A*, B*），并以跨割权重占比作为标量统计量。实验在 REINFORCE 多智能体环境与 Qwen3-0.6B（token 位置视作 agent）两个域验证：能恢复层级/动态联盟结构，剔除"行为一致但无信息流"的假阳性，并在 LLM 中揭示显式标签主导于交互模式的表征层级。核心结论是联盟结构在隐藏状态的统计依赖中比在外显行为中更早、更清晰可见，但该方法为观察者相对的成对统计量，不构成因果或 IIT 严格意义上的 Φ 估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多智能体系统会形成联盟，对 AI 安全与对齐具有重要意义。行为层面的监控往往不足以区分"真正的信息耦合"与"虚假的行为相似"——相似输出可能来自共同训练数据、共享提示或相同奖励压力；而关键的联盟重组可能在行为尚无明显变化时就已经在内部表征中发生。已有工作（Bailey & Schneider 的 Φ_spectral）仅把 Φ_spectral 当作全系统整合度的标量指标，未利用其 Fiedler 二分作为结构性读数；此外缺乏可在分布式 AI 中监测涌现组织结构的可扩展诊断工具。作者借鉴 IIT 及"弱 IIT"（观察者相对的整合度估计）视角，明确采用较弱的观察者相对立场：目标不是重建内在因果 Φ，而是判断内部表征是否组织成彼此弱耦合的子群。

Method: 方法论上给出完整形式化：(1) 定义 coalition 为隐藏状态依赖模式上的操作性子群，而非消息图或奖励结构；(2) 逐对估计互信息 I(H_i;H_j)，构建对称矩阵 M（对角为 0），连续隐状态用离散化或 k 近邻估计；(3) 以 M 为加权无向图邻接矩阵，定义度、体积、割权重与归一化割 Ncut，求对称归一化拉普拉斯 L_sym=I−D^(−1/2)MD^(−1/2)，取第二小特征值对应的 Fiedler 向量 v2，按符号划分 A*={(v2)_i≥0}、B*={(v2)_i<0}；(4) 定义标量 Φ_spectral=cut(A*,B*)/Σ_{i<j}M_ij，以及描述性对比量 组内/组外平均互信息比 R(A,B)=M̄_in/M̄_out；(5) 递归分解产生层次化联盟（当 R>τ、规模≥m_min 且分割稳定时递归），并可在时间窗上估计 M^(t) 追踪动态重组；(6) 理想化植入分块模型 M=[[a(J−I),bJ],[bJ,a(J−I)]] 证明谱松弛可精确恢复真实分割。实验设计：REINFORCE 环境为三层前馈网络（d_h=32，K=4 动作）、12 个 agent 分 3 组×2 子对，含层级奖励与第 10000 episode 的组交换实验；负对照为 12 个 agent 各自独立拟合冻结随机 oracle（组内行为一致率 0.984），测量时给每个 agent 独立随机输入以排除输入驱动的混淆；LLM 桥接实验用 Qwen3-0.6B（28 层，d=1024），取第 14 层 Alice/Bob/Carol/Dave 四个单 token 的隐藏状态，每条件 200 条 prompt 改写、5 个种子；提示条件含模块化、整合、隐式模块化、对抗性解离（对齐/解离/仅交互）与动态重分配；设名称与槽位顺序置换控制。MI 估计：REINFORCE 每测点 150 episode、均匀分箱 8 bin、每对采样 8 神经元对平均；LLM 用分位数分箱、32 神经元对。统计：配对 t 检验 + 10,000 次自助法 95% CI + ARI 分区正确性评估。

Result: REINFORCE 层级实验：训练后 M 呈清晰块对角；Level 1 在 5 个种子中 4 个干净分离出某一组，Level 2 递归在全部种子零方差地恢复 6/6 子对，协调准确率在 5000 episode 后 >0.95。动态交换实验：行为奖励仅短暂下探后恢复、无持久行为信号，但 agent 2/4 与新旧组的 MI 完全翻转，递归 Fiedler 分割在 5/5 种子恢复新结构。负对照：行为组内一致率 0.984，但独立输入下 R(A*,B*)=1.01、无组结构可分；k-means 与行为谱聚类 ARI=1.00（假阳性报告三个联盟），本文神经 MI 谱分割 ARI=0.217（正确不报）；共享输入的"对照之对照"恢复出虚假块对角，验证独立输入协议必要性。LLM：模块化条件 5/5 正确、S=0.944[0.938,0.949]、R=1.086，整合条件仅 1/5（随机）、S=0.303[0.040,0.598]、R=1.004，配对 t=3.97、p=0.017；动态重分配 Phase 2 匹配新团队 5/5、旧团队 0/5，S_new=0.972 vs S_old=0.221（t=94.3、p<10⁻⁷）；隐式模块化（仅交互描述）5/5 正确、R=1.075，隐式整合 0/5、S 0.941 vs 0.253（t=11.94、p=2.8×10⁻⁴）；对抗解离中 aligned 与 dissociated 均跟踪标签（标签 S=0.94/0.96，交互 S=0.05/0.03，p<10⁻⁵），interaction-only 翻转为跟踪交互（R=1.19，标签 S=0.05、交互 S=0.99，t=−48.2）。标量对比：三种对抗条件下总跨体互信息 T(M)≈3.49–3.81（变异系数约 4%）无法区分结构，但分区在条件间发生质性翻转；模块化 vs 整合的 T(M)=2.58 vs 1.13 差异本身有歧义，需 R（1.16 vs 1.00）消歧。

Conclusion: 作者将 Φ_spectral 从"全系统整合标量"重新定位为"联盟检测结构读数"，主张成对互信息图加 Fiedler 二分这一简单流水线可作为分布式 AI 中模块化组织的可扩展、观察者相对诊断工具：它能在行为监控沉默、瞬态或误导时检出内部耦合子群，并在 LLM 中给出标签结构与交互结构的表征层级。结论同时明确限定：方法为成对、无向、观察性统计量，不能区分直接因果与共同驱动/提示诱导结构，不重建内在因果结构，也不等同于 IIT 严格意义的 Φ；LLM 桥接仅证明方法可迁移至基础模型表征，不能证明单个语言模型以与多智能体相同的意义"拥有"联盟，且效应绝对量级偏小（强配对统计来自低跨种子方差）。作者建议的最贴近近期角色是作为筛查工具，用于标记新出现的表征联盟以便进一步因果/行为审查，而非独立的合谋或意图探测器。未来工作包括比较替代 MI 估计量、量化分割稳定性、引入有向/扰动统计、扩展到更大模型与真正多智能体语言模型、层次化嵌套联盟。

Abstract: Collections of interacting AI agents can form coalitions, creating emergent group-level organization that is critical for AI safety and alignment. However, observing agent behavior alone is often insufficient to distinguish genuine informational coupling from spurious similarity, as consequential coalitions may form at the level of internal representations before any overt behavioral change is apparent. Here, we introduce a practical method for detecting coalition structure from the internal neural representations of multi-agent systems. The approach constructs a pairwise mutual-information graph from the hidden states of agents and applies spectral partitioning to identify the most salient coalition boundary.
  We validate this method in two domains. First, in multi-agent reinforcement learning environments, the method successfully recovers programmed hierarchical and dynamic coalition structures and correctly rejects false positives arising from behavioral coordination without informational coupling. Second, using a large language model, the method identifies coalition structures implied by descriptive prompts, tracks dynamic team reassignments, and reveals a representational hierarchy where explicit labels dominate over conflicting interaction patterns. Across both settings, the recovered partition reveals subgroup organization that a scalar cross-agent mutual-information measure cannot distinguish. The results demonstrate that analyzing hidden-state mutual information through spectral partitioning provides a scalable diagnostic for identifying representational coalitions, offering a valuable tool for monitoring emergent structure in distributed AI systems.

</details>


### [434] [CASCADE: Case-Based Continual Adaptation for Large Language Models During Deployment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06702)
*Siyuan Guo,Yali Du,Hechang Chen,Yi Chang,Jun Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出CASCADE（基于案例的部署期持续适应框架），将LLM生命周期中"部署后学习停止"的缺陷形式化为"部署期学习（DTL）"这一第三阶段：在冻结LLM参数的前提下，通过显式的、不断演化的情景记忆（案例库）复用历史经验，并将案例检索建模为上下文老虎机问题（提出Neural-LinLogUCB算法），从而在长期交互中获得无遗憾（no-regret）保证。16个任务上宏平均成功率相对零样本提示提升20.9%，持续优于梯度式（REINFORCE+LoRA）与记忆式基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前LLM范式是"预训练+微调"两阶段流水线，一旦部署，学习即停止，这与自然智能基于交互持续适应的机制形成鲜明对比。已部署的LLM多以黑盒API形式访问，无法做反向传播；同时LLM规模下梯度更新成本高昂（如REINFORCE+LoRA需多张高端GPU），而在线场景每个任务只允许一次奖励观测，无法像离线RL那样反复rollout。已有工作各有局限：Reflexion/TextGrad等测试时自适应只针对单个查询、既不积累经验也不跨任务泛化；DSPy/GEPA沿用"训练-测试"范式，部署后完全静态；Agent KB、Memento、FLEX等记忆式方法亦为静态；DC、ACE等在线上下文适应虽属先驱，但缺乏有原则的学习机制，且依赖强骨干模型。作者因此主张把部署视为LLM生命周期的第三阶段（部署期学习），并将学习焦点从模型参数转移到提示、记忆、检索等智能体组件上。

Method: **问题形式化**：DTL被定义为带bandit反馈的在线学习问题——在T个时间步中查询流q_t到达，智能体生成答案a_t，环境返回二值奖励r_t∈{0,1}，目标是最小化伪遗憾R_T=E[Σ(R(q,a*)-R(q,a))]，理想目标为次线性遗憾（无遗憾学习）。\n\n**CASCADE框架**：基于经典案例推理（CBR）的4R循环（Retrieve-Reuse-Revise-Retain）构建演化式案例库M_t，案例定义为三元组(q,a,r)。复合策略π_CASCADE(a|q,M)=Σ_{c∈M} μ(c|q,M)·p_LLM(a|q,c)。因LLM冻结，其响应行为视为环境动态的一部分，适配仅需学习轻量检索器策略。成功案例（r=1）被保留入案例库，失败则不改变案例库——覆盖缺口随案例库增长而收缩。\n\n**检索管线**：两阶段。第一阶段用固定的预训练嵌入模型（gte-modernbert-base）从案例库召回Top-K=32候选；第二阶段用基于交叉编码器的重排器打分选出最优案例，其中重排器在线训练。\n\n**Neural-LinLogUCB算法**：把"拉臂"类比为"检索一个案例"，上下文为查询与案例的拼接x=[q;c]，奖励服从伯努利分布P{r=1|x}=σ(h(x))。为解耦表示学习与不确定性估计，采用深度Transformer编码器f(x;ω)（初始化自gte-reranker-modernbert-base）做表示学习，配浅层线性头θ做不确定性估计，UCB打分=⟨θ,f(x;ω)⟩+α‖f(x;ω)‖_{A^{-1}}，A=λI+Σff^T。线性头每步用SGD近似带L2正则的逻辑回归单步更新，编码器每H=32步做一次小批量梯度更新。\n\n**理论保证**：将总遗憾分解为覆盖缺口Δ_t（案例库不完备导致）与检索遗憾ρ_t（检索器选错导致）。定理1/4：覆盖缺口在相似查询解相似、LLM保持非零成功率、查询i.i.d.且满足密度条件三个假设下为Õ(T^{(d0-1)/d0})（d0>1）或Õ(1)（d0≤1）；定理2/5：检索遗憾为Õ(B/κ_σ·√T)；定理3：总遗憾次线性，即冻结LLM下仍可达无遗憾。理论分析基于NTK矩阵与Abbasi-Yadkori等经典引理。\n\n**扩展**：采用组合神经bandit框架可检索top-k个案例；补充材料给出"人在环路"设定（人参与Revise步、以及E-E-D探索-利用-发现框架下的discovery触发策略）。基准DTLBench开源（部分MIMIC-IV因许可后续开放），代码开源。

Result: **单轮12任务（Qwen3-32B，5随机种子）**：宏平均成功率从零样本48.33%→CASCADE 66.68%（约+20.9%）；最强记忆基线NP-CBR为63.76%，说明bandit式自适应检索策略额外带来+2.92绝对提升。CASCADE在12任务中9项优于REINFORCE+LoRA，其余3项在检索案例数增至4时被反超。消融显示：Neural-LinLogUCB平均66.68最优，NeuralLinUCB 65.49、NeuralLogUCB 65.39、LinLogUCB 63.95、w/o Exploration 66.37（即纯利用下降0.31），w/o Neural-LinLogUCB（即NP-CBR）63.95。\n\n**资源效率**：CASCADE仅需<4GB显存（单张消费级GPU）即取得最高平均成功率，位于性能-资源Pareto前沿；REINFORCE+LoRA需多张高端GPU。\n\n**模型规模泛化**：Qwen3-4B/8B/14B/32B上CASCADE在多数设置最佳；12任务中9项的"CASCADE下界"超过"零样本上界"，说明小模型+DTL可超越大模型零样本。失败情形：Qwen3-4B在MIMIC-IV-MR上所有方法均失败，说明DTL依赖骨干模型的最低基础能力。\n\n**黑盒API**：gemini-2.0-flash上CASCADE平均72.58%，较NP-CBR相对提升约3%，梯度式方法不适用。\n\n**多轮具身任务**：ALFWorld 62.01%→67.43%，ScienceWorld 59.36%→66.84%；ScienceWorld中find-animal/find-living-thing/find-non-living-thing提升超20%/40%/80%；ALFWorld 134个未见任务上成功率接近零样本两倍，OOD泛化良好；作为即插即用组件接入ReAct后，两任务达81.74%和74.67%。\n\n**真实任务**：2Wiki深度检索（本地RAG 45.94%→50.06%，Web搜索 53.29%→66.51%），且平均工具调用次数增加；MIMIC-III表格推理零样本仅20.75%，NP-CBR 44.02%，CASCADE 55.76%，平均调试轮次下降。\n\n**人在环路**：Exploit与UCB作为discovery指标相对标准CASCADE平均相对增益8.83%/8.73%（随机策略仅5.61%）。

Conclusion: 本文的核心论点是：部署不应被视为学习的终点，而应作为LLM生命周期中独立且必要的第三学习阶段。其关键洞见是——已部署LLM系统的有效学习并不需要修改基础模型，而是可以把适配的"落点"转移到提示、记忆与检索等智能体组件；这既是对梯度不可得、算力受限、黑盒API等现实约束的原则性回应，也带来了可解释性与计算效率。把案例推理形式化为带二值反馈的上下文老虎机问题，使CASCADE成为首个具有可证明无遗憾保证的LLM智能体部署期学习算法，作者视其为与规模、数据、架构正交的第三条进步轴线。\n\n**局限与未来工作**：(1) 更长部署时域下的行为未探明，涉及记忆膨胀、案例管理与遗忘机制；(2) 当前仅从成功经验学习，丢弃了同样含信息的失败案例，如何借助LLM自反思能力从失败中学习是有前景的方向；(3) DTL依赖骨干模型的最低基础能力，零样本近零时在线改进难以保证；(4) 理论上Neural-LinLogUCB的遗憾界比Neural-LinUCB多一个κ_σ因子，作者解释这源自二值反馈与连续反馈的本质差异。\n\n总体而言，论文在概念框架（LLM生命周期的第三阶段）、算法设计（Neural-LinLogUCB）与理论保证（次线性遗憾）三个层面形成了自洽的贡献，并在多领域多规模上验证了参数无关的部署期学习是可行且有效的。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have become a central foundation of modern artificial intelligence, yet their lifecycle remains constrained by a rigid separation between training and deployment, after which learning effectively ceases. This limitation contrasts with natural intelligence, which continually adapts through interaction with its environment. In this paper, we formalise deployment-time learning (DTL) as the third stage in the LLM lifecycle that enables LLM agents to improve from experience during deployment without modifying model parameters. We present CASCADE (CASe-based Continual Adaptation during DEployment), a general and principled framework that equips LLM agents with an explicit, evolving episodic memory. CASCADE formulates experience reuse as a contextual bandit problem, enabling principled exploration-exploitation trade-offs and establishing no-regret guarantees over long-term interactions. This design allows agents to accumulate, select, and refine task-relevant cases, transforming past experience into actionable knowledge. Across 16 diverse tasks spanning medical diagnosis, legal analysis, code generation, web search, tool use, and embodied interaction, CASCADE improves macro-averaged success rate by 20.9% over zero-shot prompting while consistently outperforming gradient-based and memory-based baselines. By reframing deployment as an adaptive learning process, this work establishes a foundation for continually improving AI systems.

</details>


### [435] [From Storage to Experience: A Survey on the Evolution of LLM Agent Memory Mechanisms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06716)
*Jinghao Luo,Yuchen Tian,Chuxue Cao,Ziyang Luo,Hongzhan Lin,Kaixin Li,Chuyi Kong,Ruichao Yang,Jing Ma*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个针对大语言模型(LLM)智能体记忆机制的进化框架，将发展过程形式化为三个阶段：存储(轨迹保存)、反思(轨迹优化)和经验(轨迹抽象)，并分析了推动这一进化的三个核心驱动力：长程一致性需求、动态环境挑战和持续学习目标，同时探索了前沿经验阶段的两大革命性机制——主动探索和跨轨迹抽象。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前LLM智能体记忆机制研究呈现碎片化状态，徘徊于操作系统工程与认知科学之间，缺乏统一的技术综合视图和连贯的演化视角。这阻碍了该领域的系统性发展。

Method: 提出了一个新颖的进化框架，将LLM智能体记忆机制的发展形式化为三个递进阶段：Storage(存储)、Reflection(反思)、Experience(经验)；分析了三个核心驱动力(长程一致性、动态环境适应性、持续学习)；深入探讨了前沿Experience阶段的两个变革性机制。

Result: 建立了记忆机制从轨迹保存→轨迹优化→轨迹抽象的演化路径；识别了推动进化的三大驱动因素；揭示了主动探索与跨轨迹抽象作为下一代智能体设计的关键机制。

Conclusion: 该框架为LLM智能体记忆机制提供了统一的设计原则和发展路线图，对下一代智能体系统的开发具有重要指导意义，有望推动人工智能向更高级的认知能力演进。

Abstract: Large Language Model (LLM)-based agents have fundamentally reshaped artificial intelligence by integrating external tools and planning capabilities. While memory mechanisms have emerged as the architectural cornerstone of these systems, current research remains fragmented, oscillating between operating system engineering and cognitive science. This theoretical divide prevents a unified view of technological synthesis and a coherent evolutionary perspective. To bridge this gap, this survey proposes a novel evolutionary framework for LLM agent memory mechanisms, formalizing the development process into three stages: Storage (trajectory preservation), Reflection (trajectory refinement), and Experience (trajectory abstraction). We first formally define these three stages before analyzing the three core drivers of this evolution: the necessity for long-range consistency, the challenges in dynamic environments, and the ultimate goal of continual learning. Furthermore, we specifically explore two transformative mechanisms in the frontier Experience stage: proactive exploration and cross-trajectory abstraction. By synthesizing these disparate views, this work offers robust design principles and a clear roadmap for the development of next-generation LLM agents.

</details>


### [436] [When Does a Language Model Commit? A Finite-Answer Theory of Pre-Verbalization Commitment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06723)
*Long Zhang,Wei-neng Chen,Feng-feng Wei,Zi-bo Qin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究语言模型答案偏好何时稳定的问题。通过有限答案偏好稳定化（finite-answer preference stabilization）这一可计算对象，将模型的延续概率投影到有限答案集上，在二元任务中简化为精确的对数赔率代码 δ(ξ)。实验表明，使用Qwen3-4B-Instruct时，上下文有限答案投影在答案可解析之前就已稳定，平均领先17-31个token。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型在给出最终答案前通常先生成推理过程，但可见答案无法揭示模型答案偏好何时变得稳定。现有方法（如贪婪 rollout 或学习探针）存在局限性，需要一种更精确的测量方法来理解模型的内部决策过程。

Method: 1) 将模型延续概率投影到有限答案集合上；2) 在二元任务中使用精确对数赔率代码 δ(ξ)=Sθ(yes|ξ)-Sθ(no|ξ)；3) 定义基于解析器的答案起始点（onset）和回顾性稳定时间；4) 不依赖贪婪 rollout 或学习探针。

Result: 在Qwen3-4B-Instruct的受控延迟判决任务中，上下文有限答案投影在答案可解析前就已稳定，主要模板中平均领先17-31个token；在解析器清洁的复现实验中也有正向但更短的领先。结果还表明该信号追踪模型的最终输出而非真实答案，可从紧凑隐藏摘要线性恢复，与光标进展部分可分离，且作为共享信息转移。

Conclusion: 测量信号与在线停止、言语器无关信念和因果答案控制可分离；精确 steering 显示 δ 具有局部敏感性但无法可靠控制生成。该方法为理解语言模型内部答案偏好形成提供了有效的测量工具。

Abstract: Language models often generate reasoning before giving a final answer, but the visible answer does not reveal when the model's answer preference became stable. We study this question through a narrow computable object: \emph{finite-answer preference stabilization}. For a model state and specified answer verbalizers, we project the model's own continuation probabilities onto a finite answer set; in binary tasks this yields an exact log-odds code, $δ(ξ)=S_θ(\mathrm{yes}\midξ)-S_θ(\mathrm{no}\midξ)$. This target defines parser-based answer onset, retrospective stabilization time, and lead without relying on greedy rollouts or learned probes. In controlled delayed-verdict tasks with Qwen3-4B-Instruct, the contextual finite-answer projection stabilizes before the answer is parseable, with 17--31 token mean lead in the main templates and positive, shorter lead in a parser-clean replication. The signal tracks the model's eventual output rather than truth, is linearly recoverable from compact hidden summaries, is partly separable from cursor progress, and transfers as shared information without a single invariant coordinate. Diagnostics separate the measurement from online stopping, verbalizer-free belief, and causal answer control; exact steering shows local sensitivity of $δ$ but not reliable generation control.

</details>


### [437] [MASPO: Joint Prompt Optimization for LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06623)
*Zhexuan Wang,Xuebo Liu,Li Wang,Zifei Shan,Yutong Wang,Zhenxi Song,Min Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: MASPO是一种用于LLM多智能体系统的自动提示词优化框架，通过联合评估机制（评估提示词对下游智能体的促进能力）和进化束搜索策略，解决了多智能体系统中局部目标与全局目标不对齐的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前多智能体系统中，提示词质量至关重要，但跨交互智能体联合优化提示词面临挑战：局部智能体目标与整体系统目标之间存在 misalignment，导致难以同时优化多个智能体的提示词。

Method: 1. 提出联合评估机制：通过下游智能体任务成功度评估提示词质量，弥合局部交互与全局目标间的差距，无需ground-truth标签；2. 采用数据驱动的进化束搜索方法高效搜索高维提示空间。

Result: MASPO在6个不同任务中始终优于最先进的提示优化方法，实现了平均准确率提升2.9%。

Conclusion: MASPO通过自动化迭代优化多智能体系统中的角色提示词，在6个不同任务中平均准确率提升2.9%，始终优于最先进的提示优化方法。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based Multi-agent systems (MAS) have shown promise in tackling complex collaborative tasks, where agents are typically orchestrated via role-specific prompts. While the quality of these prompts is pivotal, jointly optimizing them across interacting agents remains a non-trivial challenge, primarily due to the misalignment between local agent objectives and holistic system goals. To address this, we introduce MASPO, a novel framework designed to automatically and iteratively refine prompts across the entire system. A core innovation of MASPO is its joint evaluation mechanism, which assesses prompts not merely by their local validity, but by their capacity to facilitate downstream success for successor agents. This effectively bridges the gap between local interactions and global outcomes without relying on ground-truth labels. Furthermore, MASPO employs a data-driven evolutionary beam search to efficiently navigate the high-dimensional prompt space. Extensive empirical evaluations across 6 diverse tasks demonstrate that MASPO consistently outperforms state-of-the-art prompt optimization methods, achieving an average accuracy improvement of 2.9. We release our code at https://github.com/wangzx1219/MASPO.

</details>


### [438] [Weblica: Scalable and Reproducible Training Environments for Visual Web Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06761)
*Oğuzhan Fatih Kar,Roman Bachmann,Yuanzheng Gong,Anders Boesen Lindbo Larsen,Afshin Dehghan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Weblica是一个用于构建可扩展、可复现的网页环境的框架，通过HTTP级缓存和LLM环境合成技术，在数千个多样化网页环境中训练视觉web智能体。其8B参数模型在多个网页导航基准测试中优于同规模开源基线模型，且推理步数更少、测试时计算扩展性好，甚至可与API模型竞争。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 网页环境复杂、开放且不断变化，导致视觉web智能体的训练数据难以规模化。现有的数据收集方法仅限于离线轨迹的监督微调或少量模拟环境，无法捕捉真实网页的多样性，限制了web智能体的训练效果和泛化能力。

Method: 提出Weblica框架，包含两个核心组件：1) HTTP级缓存机制，捕获并回放稳定视觉状态同时保留交互行为；2) 基于LLM的环境合成方法，以真实网站和核心网页导航技能为基础生成多样化环境。在此框架上开展大规模强化学习训练。

Result: Weblica-8B模型在多个网页导航基准测试中表现优于同规模的开放权重基线，推理步数更少，测试时计算扩展性良好，且可与API模型竞争。

Conclusion: Weblica框架成功实现了大规模、可复现的网页环境构建，使强化学习训练能够在数千个多样化环境中进行。该工作为视觉web智能体的训练提供了可扩展的解决方案。

Abstract: The web is complex, open-ended, and constantly changing, making it challenging to scale training data for visual web agents. Existing data collection attempts remain limited to offline trajectories for supervised fine-tuning or a handful of simulated environments for RL training, thus failing to capture web diversity. We propose Weblica (Web Replica), a framework for constructing reproducible and scalable web environments. Our framework leverages 1) HTTP-level caching to capture and replay stable visual states while preserving interactive behavior and 2) LLM-based environment synthesis grounded in real-world websites and core web navigation skills. Using this framework, we scale RL training to thousands of diverse environments and tasks. Our best model, Weblica-8B, outperforms open-weight baselines of similar size across multiple web navigation benchmarks while using fewer inference steps, scales favorably with additional test-time compute, and is competitive with API models.

</details>


### [439] [When Does Critique Improve AI-Assisted Theoretical Physics? SCALAR: Structured Critic--Actor Loop for Agentic Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06772)
*Vasilis Niarchos,Constantinos Papageorgakis,Alexander G. Stapleton,Sokratis Trifinopoulos*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SCALAR（Structured Critic–Actor Loop for AI Reasoning）是一个"Actor–Critic–Judge"三角色流水线，用于研究生级量子场论（QFT）与弦论习题的可控评测研究。作者系统操纵Actor人格（专业水平×推理风格，12种）、Critic反馈风格（adversarial/strict/pedagogical/lenient/default，5种）、Actor模型族与规模（DS70B、DS8B、Haiku），在3道教科书题上共进行约2100次运行（约9.4×10⁷ token等效算力），用统一QWQ评分器测量。核心结论：（1）多轮Critic对话普遍优于单次作答（DS70B收敛率65.7%，平均增益+13.4分）；（2）Critic反馈策略的效果强烈依赖Actor–Critic配对——只在非对称的Haiku Actor + Sonnet Critic组合中显著（Kruskal–Wallis p=0.0009），同族DeepSeek组合中无统计效应，且严格/对抗式反馈在任何配置下都不是最优；（3）Actor人格提示（"你是专家"等）影响可忽略（DS70B 12种人格跨度仅5分，p=0.99）；（4）族内规模提升（8B→70B）改善较易题目但无法消除最难题目（Polchinski 2.7）的瓶颈，两种规模在该题上均在 s≈63 处出现"投影不动点"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理论上物理学家已开始日常使用LLM，但学界缺乏对"人—智能体交互结构如何影响结果"的系统性回答：现有工作多关注单轮基准（TPBench等）或开放式案例，缺少在已知答案（known-answer）科学问题上对交互变量（人格提示、批评风格、模型规模）的可控隔离研究。与此同时，多轮交互存在"粘性错误状态"与能力退化、结构化多智能体可降低幻觉的证据相互矛盾；"设定人格可使性能提升数十个百分点"等提示工程传说也需在推理型模型上重新检验。作者的目标有三点：评估整段交互而非仅首答；为"物理学家监督一组AI智能体"的工作流提供设计依据；把SCALAR作为检验提示工程断言的受控试验台。论文采用教育心理学脚手架（Wood, Vygotsky, Shute）的隐喻：Actor=学生，Critic=助教，Judge=教师。

Method: **流水线**：给定题目+人格/策略配置，Actor给出初始解；Critic可访问参考解但被要求不得泄露，负责指出错误并给出结构化反馈；Judge依据参考解对Actor当前解打分（0–100分，六维：正确性50+严谨性10+逻辑流10+论证质量10+完整性10+物理自洽10）并给出pass/fail。若通过、或触发早停条件（迭代上限4/5轮，或分数停滞），则存档终止；否则反馈回传给Actor继续迭代。Judge在循环外、其分数不回流，因而可用其他Judge对存档记录重新评分，以分离"交互效应"与"评分者效应"。

**操纵变量**：Actor人格=专业水平（expert/novice/default）×推理风格（meticulous/physical/skeptical/default），共12种；Critic反馈策略=5种（adversarial/strict/pedagogical/lenient/default），做12×5全因子扫描。

**题目**（3道标准教材题）：Peskin & Schroeder 2.3（类空间隔费曼传播子的Bessel函数结果）、Peskin & Schroeder 4.2（重标量衰变到两个轻标量的最低阶寿命）、Polchinski 2.7（自由玻色子CFT的OPE系数与张量性判定，含线性膨胀子理论）。作者明确指出题集小、可能存在预训练污染，结果应视为"交互结构的受控案例研究"而非通用基准。

**模型配置**：DS70B（Actor与Critic同族）+ QWQ-32B为主评分器，900次运行（每格15次重复，T=0.7）；DS8B（DeepSeek-R1-0528-Qwen3-8B）+ DS70B Critic + QWQ Judge，900次；Haiku 4.5（Actor）+ Sonnet 4.6（Critic与主Judge），900次。

**指标与统计**：平均逐轮分 s̄、端点增益 g=s_T-1−s_0、收敛率 R（任一轮满足最终答案等价、总分≥80、正确性≥40）；并定义按"模型—题目"局部基线归一化的问题归一化对比 D_s̄ 与 D_R，用于跨题目比较策略。对策效应使用Wilcoxon符号秩检验、Kruskal–Wallis检验、Mann–Whitney检验（均基于原始run级量，非归一化对比量）。

**动力学分析**：把每轮记录的"配置+对话记录"视为对话的Markov态，将Judge分数作为其标量投影，定义score-update场 v(s)=E[Δs_t | s_t≈s]，用分箱估计漂移与bootstrap 95%置信区间，零点称为"投影不动点"；同时给出局部涨落尺度 D̂=½Var(Δs)与仅用分数的Markov闭合检验（回归残差对 s_{t−1} 的记忆项）。

Result: **1. 多轮普遍优于单次**：三种Actor设置下最终解均显著优于首答（QWQ评分下DS70B：turn-0 67.3→终态80.7，收敛率65.7%，增益+13.4；DS8B：收敛52.4%，终分76.6，增益+13.3）。Haiku在两个Peskin题上收敛率高达88.0%与86.6%，Polchinski 2.7全量扫描仅30.9%。DS70B分题收敛率：PS4.2 90.7%、PS2.3 64.7%、Polchinski 2.7 41.7%；DS8B则把PS2.3（69.0%）看得比PS4.2（54.3%）更易，与DS70B顺序相反。

**2. 规模不解决瓶颈**：8B→70B在族内改变了较易题目的动力学（DS8B在PS4.2上出现 s≈63 的中期不动点，DS70B则全程正漂移），但两者在Polchinski 2.7上均存在 s≈63 的不动点区，即"增大参数改变易/中区行为，但不移除难题瓶颈"。该结论仅基于两个尺度点，作者明示为未来缩放研究的动机而非缩放定律。

**3. Critic策略是模型依赖的**：Haiku对策略最敏感——pedagogical/lenient/default高于局部基线，strict/adversarial低于基线（s̄ 的Kruskal–Wallis p=0.0009），但收敛率的策略差异不显著（p=0.27），故不应视为五种策略的严格排序。DS70B五种策略统计上不可区分（p=0.61 / p=0.17），DS8B亦然（p=0.10 / p=0.22）；描述性上DeepSeek族偏好lenient，但作者把它限定为"QWQ条件下的倾向"。跨全部设置，无任何证据表明adversarial或strict是最优策略。

**4. 人格提示几乎无效**：DS70B在12种人格上的s̄跨度仅[69.4, 74.1]（Kruskal–Wallis p=0.99），Haiku的expertise轴亦无稳健效应（default 76.7 vs expert 76.4）；60格persona×strategy热图呈不规则块结构，无一致占优人格公式。

**5. 评分者敏感性**：QWQ评分与人工复核一致性好，且比DS70B重评分更接近闭源Opus审计集，故以QWQ作为跨模型可比的主评分器；DS70B重评分下DS8B/DS70B的族内规模排序会翻转，作者因此不把规模排序当作评分者无关的结论。分数分量诊断显示"论证质量"是最持久的评分缺口。

**6. 机制层面**：单轮直接通过、多轮后被救回、以及始终卡住三类run-fate混合导致端点增益掩盖策略效应；DS70B的score-update曲线在PS2.3持续正漂移、在PS4.2仅在高分区才接近零点。分数残差对 s_{t−1} 的记忆项小于其标准误，与"仅分数闭合"一致，但未做预测性核模型验证。

Conclusion: **实践建议**：(1) 用对话而非仅一次性提问——单次有缺陷的回答常被误当成对模型的判决；(2) 不要指望Actor人格提示（"你是专家理论家"）能决定结果，本实验中它不是可靠设计变量；(3) Critic反馈风格是最值得测试的杠杆，但不要假定"越严越好"——严格与对抗式反馈在任何配对中都从未稳定占优，最好起点是保留正确部分、指向缺失的物理检查（量纲、极限、对称性、特例、丢因子）后再收紧标准；构造性反馈的清晰信号仅存在于非对称Haiku–Sonnet配置。

**方法论定位**：作者强调三点限定——(a) Critic是"参考条件化"的（可见答案但被禁止泄露），因此本工作更接近有监督辅导而非开放式自主发现，不能据此宣称多智能体对话普遍优于单轮评测；(b) 判分体系预设了已知答案，"科学发现"只是面向未来无参考解工作流的目标；(c) 三道题不构成受控复杂度阶梯，故不主张相变行为。

**展望**：把Actor–Critic交换视为受控动力系统，进一步变化模型尺度、Critic强度、轮数预算与题目难度，用转移核（含吸收态"通过"）预测留出轨迹的分数直方图、收敛率与剩余轮数，并把Critic分数作为第二观测量（区分"反馈差"与"反馈好但Actor未吸收"）；最终以符号检验、极限情形、模拟、实验、定理证明器或专家一致性审查替代参考解，届时"正确性"与通过规则将退化为约束满足度，而过程性指标（严谨性、逻辑流、论证质量、完整性、物理自洽）仍可保留。代码包SCALAR已开源于GitHub（xand-stapleton/ai_agents）。

Abstract: As large language models (LLMs) show increasing promise on research-level physics reasoning tasks and agentic AI becomes more common, a practical question emerges: How does the interaction between researchers and agents affect the results? We study this using SCALAR (Structured Critic--Actor Loop for AI Reasoning), an Actor--Critic--Judge pipeline applied to quantum field theory and string theory problems. The Actor proposes solutions, the Critic provides iterative feedback, and an independent Judge evaluates the transcript against reference solutions. We vary the Actor persona, the Critic feedback strategy, and the Actor model family and scale. Multi-turn dialogue improves over single-shot attempts throughout, but both the mechanism of improvement and the value of different prompting choices depend strongly on the Actor--Critic pairing. Increasing the scale within one model family (e.g. from the 8B-parameter DeepSeek-R1 variant to DeepSeek-R1 70B) improves some easier-problem behavior, but does not remove the hardest bottleneck we observe. Critic feedback strategy matters most clearly in the asymmetric Actor--Critic setting (e.g., a lightweight Haiku Actor guided by a stronger Sonnet Critic), where constructive feedback improves mean-score outcomes. In same-family Actor--Critic settings, strategy effects are weaker: lenient feedback is sometimes favored, while strict and adversarial feedback are not beneficial. Taken together, SCALAR provides a controlled testbed for evaluating which interaction structures help or hinder AI-driven scientific discovery.

</details>


### [440] [Towards Security-Auditable LLM Agents: A Unified Graph Representation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06812)
*Chaofan Li,Lyuye Zhang,Jintao Zhai,Siyue Feng,Xichun Yang,Huahao Wang,Shihan Dou,Yu Ji,Yutao Hu,Yueming Wu,Yang Liu,Deqing Zou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 Agent-BOM(智能体物料清单),把 LLM 智能体系统建模为分层带属性的有向图:静态能力层(模型、工具、长期记忆)与动态运行时语义层(目标、推理轨迹、动作),通过语义边与安全属性连接,统一支撑事后安全审计;并基于图查询范式与 OWASP Agentic Top 10 实例化审计流程,在 OpenClaw 环境实现插件,可重建跨会话记忆投毒、供应链劫持、多智能体劫持等隐蔽攻击链。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 智能体系统通过动态工具调用、有状态记忆管理与多智能体协作执行复杂自主任务,其"语义驱动"的执行范式在底层物理事件(如工具调用、日志记录)与高层执行意图(目标、推理链、策略)之间产生严重语义鸿沟,导致事后安全审计难以进行。现有机制如静态 SBOM 仅描述组件构成、运行时日志仅记录离散事件,只能提供碎片化证据,无法刻画:①认知状态(目标/推理轨迹)的演化过程;②行为与能力之间的跨层绑定关系;③持久化记忆的污染路径;④交互智能体之间的级联风险传播。因此需要一个统一、可查询、能表达"能力-状态-意图"结构依赖与因果传播链的表示层,使审计从碎片比对转向路径级(root-cause path)溯源。

Method: 1) 表示层设计:提出 Agent-BOM,将智能体系统建模为分层带属性有向图(HADG)。底层为静态能力基座层(Capability Base),包含模型、工具/插件、长期记忆、身份凭据等;上层为动态运行时语义状态层(Runtime Semantic State),包含目标(goal)、推理轨迹(reasoning trajectory)、动作(action)及其状态变迁。两层通过语义边(语义边/调用边/记忆读写边/多智能体通信边)与安全属性(来源可信度、权限范围、敏感度、注入标记等)连接,把结构依赖、状态演化、能力调用与跨智能体传播组织为可查询的"审计路径"。2) 审计范式:提出基于图查询的路径级风险评估,标准化为四阶段——入口定位(entry localization)、后向溯源(backward tracing)、前向传播分析(forward tracing)、属性裁定(attribute adjudication)。3) 威胁知识库实例化:以 OWASP Agentic Top 10 作为威胁分类基准对图路径进行匹配与风险判定。4) 系统实现:在 OpenClaw 环境部署审计插件,拦截/插桩实时执行以构建 Agent-BOM 图(节点抽取、边关联、属性标注),并支持查询与攻击链重建。5) 评估:在若干真实世界智能体攻击场景上测试,验证其对隐蔽攻击链的重建能力。

Result: 实验表明 Agent-BOM 能够准确重建多类隐蔽攻击链,包括:跨会话记忆投毒与工具滥用、能力供应链劫持与意外代码执行、多智能体生态劫持、权限与信任滥用(privilege & trust abuse)。这些结果表明统一图表示能够把碎片化执行痕迹转化为可导航的攻击路径,为根因分析与安全裁定提供可审计基础;同时该方法也暴露出现有 SBOM/日志范式在覆盖记忆污染与级联传播上的盲区。

Conclusion: Agent-BOM 通过分层带属性有向图统一了智能体系统的静态能力构成与动态运行时语义状态,使"意图—能力—状态"之间的依赖与传播关系显式化、可查询化,克服了 SBOM 与运行时日志的碎片化局限;结合图查询式四阶段审计范式与 OWASP Agentic Top 10 实例化,以及 OpenClaw 插件的落地,验证了其对多类隐蔽智能体攻击的还原能力。结论性意义在于:为复杂智能体生态提供统一、可审计的根因分析与安全裁决基础,并使安全评估从"组件清单检查"升级为"攻击路径级"分析。局限与展望方面,论文可进一步考虑图的自动属性推断精度、跨框架互操作性、与运行时防护(在线检测)的结合,以及真实生产环境大规模部署的性能与成本开销。

Abstract: LLM-based agentic systems are rapidly evolving to perform complex autonomous tasks through dynamic tool invocation, stateful memory management, and multi-agent collaboration. However, this semantics-driven execution paradigm creates a severe semantic gap between low-level physical events and high-level execution intent, making post-hoc security auditing fundamentally difficult. Existing representation mechanisms, including static SBOMs and runtime logs, provide only fragmented evidence and fail to capture cognitive-state evolution, capability bindings, persistent memory contamination, and cascading risk propagation across interacting agents. To bridge this gap, we propose Agent-BOM, a unified structural representation for agent security auditing. Agent-BOM models an agentic system as a hierarchical attributed directed graph that separates static capability bases, such as models, tools, and long-term memory, from dynamic runtime semantic states, such as goals, reasoning trajectories, and actions. These layers are connected through semantic edges and security attributes, transforming fragmented execution traces into queryable audit paths. Building on Agent-BOM, we develop a graph-query-based paradigm for path-level risk assessment and instantiate it with the OWASP Agentic Top 10. We further implement an auditing plugin in the OpenClaw environment to construct Agent-BOM from live executions. Evaluation on representative real-world agentic attack scenarios shows that Agent-BOM can reconstruct stealthy attack chains, including cross-session memory poisoning and tool misuse, capability supply-chain hijacking and unexpected code execution, multi-agent ecosystem hijacking, and privilege and trust abuse. These results demonstrate that Agent-BOM provides a unified and auditable foundation for root-cause analysis and security adjudication in complex agentic ecosystems.

</details>


### [441] [Uneven Evolution of Cognition Across Generations of Generative AI Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06815)
*Isaac Galatzer-Levy,Daniel McDuff,Xin Liu,Jed McGiffin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 研究团队采用韦氏成人智力量表改编版本来评估多模态AI模型的认知能力，发现当前AI模型存在严重的认知能力失衡：语言理解和短时记忆能力接近天花板（第98百分位以上），但感知推理能力极低（第1百分位以下）。此外，团队开发了AIQ基准测试来追踪AI能力的演变，发现语言形式的抽象推理能力远快于视觉形式，暗示当前架构存在对语言符号操作的系统性偏好。结论认为，仅通过扩大规模和优化可能无法克服AI实现类人通用智能的根本性架构局限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 追求通用人工智能（AGI）需要超越狭窄任务表现的认知能力评估方法。当前缺乏系统性的框架来衡量生成式AI的认知特征，并将其与人类认知规范进行比较，同时也缺乏追踪AI认知能力演进轨迹的工具。

Method: 研究采用改编自韦氏成人智力量表（WAIS）的任务来评估多模态AI模型的认知表现，并与人类常模进行对比。此外，团队开发了AIQ基准测试，对六个世代和两个模型家族的AI系统进行纵向追踪。

Result: 1. 多模态模型呈现极度不均衡的认知架构：言语理解和短时记忆接近天花板（>第98百分位），但感知推理接近地板（<第1百分位）。2. AIQ基准测试显示，AI能力存在显著但不对称的提升。3. 语言呈现的抽象定量推理能力远超视觉等效格式，呈现明显的架构偏好。4. 抽象视觉推理有所改善，但视觉-感知组织能力基本停滞。

Conclusion: 生成式AI的认知能力正在以不均衡的方式演进，仅靠规模化和优化方法可能不足以克服实现类人通用智能中的根本性架构限制。未来需要新的架构设计来解决认知平衡问题。

Abstract: The pursuit of artificial general intelligence necessitates robust methods for evaluating the cognitive capabilities of models beyond narrow task performance. Here, we introduce a psychometric framework to assess the cognitive profiles of generative AI, comparing them to human norms and tracking their evolution across generations. Initial evaluation of leading multimodal models using tasks adapted from the Wechsler Adult Intelligence Scale revealed a profoundly uneven cognitive architecture: near-ceiling performance in verbal comprehension and working memory (>$98^{\text{th}}$ percentile) contrasted with near-floor performance in perceptual reasoning (<$1^{\text{st}}$ percentile). To track developmental trajectories beyond human-normed limits, we developed the Artificial Intelligence Quotient (AIQ) Benchmark and applied it to six generations and two model families, revealing significant but asymmetric performance gains. Notably, we uncovered a sharp dissociation between modalities; abstract quantitative reasoning matured far more rapidly when presented linguistically compared to a visually analogous format, indicating an architectural bias towards language-based symbolic manipulation. While abstract visual reasoning improved, visual-perceptual organization remained largely stagnant. Collectively, these findings demonstrate that the cognitive abilities of generative models are evolving unevenly, suggesting that scaling and optimization approaches to AGI development alone may be insufficient to overcome fundamental architectural limitations in achieving balanced, human-like general intelligence.

</details>


### [442] [Beyond the Black Box: Interpretability of Agentic AI Tool Use](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06890)
*Hariom Tatsat,Ariye Shater*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究提出基于稀疏自编码器和线性探针的机械可解释性工具包，用于在AI智能体采取行动前预测其工具调用意图和后果，从而在企业工作流程中实现内部可观测性监测，解决现有外部方法无法提前预警工具调用失败的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前AI智能体在企业高风险工作流程中的可靠部署受限于工具调用失败的诊断和控制困难。现有可观测性方法主要是外部的（提示、评估、日志），只能事后发现相关性，而无法在模型行动前检测问题。在长-horizon场景中，早期工具错误会改变后续轨迹、增加token消耗并产生下游安全和风险。

Method: 使用稀疏自编码器（SAEs）将模型激活分解为稀疏特征，结合线性探针在每个动作前读取模型状态，推断是否需要工具调用以及该工具动作的可能后果。通过特征消融测试功能重要性。在NVIDIA Nemotron函数调用数据集的多步轨迹上训练探针，并应用于GPT-OSS 20B和Gemma 3 27B模型。

Result: 框架能够识别与工具决策最相关的内部层和特征，通过特征消融验证其功能重要性，为模型行动前的内部信号提供可见性。

Conclusion: 该研究展示了机械可解释性如何支持实际的企业级AI智能体监控，通过在模型采取行动前提供内部状态可见性，帮助识别智能体失败的深层原因，特别是在长-horizon场景中早期错误会重塑后续交互的情况。

Abstract: AI agents are promising for high-stakes enterprise workflows, but dependable deployment remains limited because tool-use failures are difficult to diagnose and control. Agents may skip required tool calls, invoke tools unnecessarily, or take actions whose consequence becomes visible only after execution. Existing observability methods are mostly external: prompts reveal correlations, evaluations score outputs, and logs arrive only after the model has already acted. In long-horizon settings, these failures are especially costly because an early tool mistake can alter the rest of the trajectory, increase token consumption, and create downstream safety and security risk.
  We introduce a mechanistic-interpretability toolkit built on Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) and linear probes. The framework reads model states before each action and infers both whether a tool is needed and how consequential the next tool action is likely to be. By decomposing activations into sparse features, it identifies the internal layers and features most associated with tool decisions and tests their functional importance through feature ablation. We train the probes on multi-step trajectories from the NVIDIA Nemotron function-calling dataset and apply the same workflow to GPT-OSS 20B and Gemma 3 27B models.
  The goal is not to replace external evaluation, but to add a missing layer: visibility into what the model signaled internally before action. This helps surface deeper causes of agent failure, especially in long-horizon runs where an early mistake can reshape the rest of the agentic interaction. More broadly, the paper shows how mechanistic interpretability can support practical internal observability for monitoring tool calls and risk in agent systems.

</details>


### [443] [Randomness is sometimes necessary for coordination](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06825)
*Rohan Patil,Jai Malegaonkar,Henrik I. Christensen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 针对"同质智能体全参数共享 + 置换对称观测"下确定性策略无法区分角色这一痼疾，本文提出 Diamond Attention：每个智能体每时间步采样一个标量随机数并单轮广播，由其诱导出临时的严格秩排序，智能体在 agent-to-agent 交叉注意力中屏蔽排名低于自身的同伴（task 注意力完全不加掩码），从而以一次广播轮实现 Case et al. (2005) 所需的随机比特协调协议，同时借助集合式注意力支持不同队伍规模的零样本部署。实验表明：XOR 对称博弈成功率 1.0（所有确定性基线停在随机下限 0.5/0.22）；VMAS 上 N=4 训练的策略零样本泛化到 N∈[2,8]；SMACLite 上从 2s3z 零样本迁移到 3s5z 取得 49.7% 胜率（基线全部 0%），而用 dropout 替代结构化掩码则胜率 0%，说明起作用的是协议空间结构而非随机噪声本身。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 合作式 MARL 普遍采用全参数共享（CTDE + VDN/QMIX 等），但在多模态奖励结构下（多个等价最优联合策略），共享的确定性策略在结构相同的观测下必然输出相同的动作分布，角色分化从定义上不可能，训练再久也无法摆脱对称均衡。理论上，Angluin (1980) 证明匿名处理器无法确定性打破对称，Case et al. (2005) 进一步证明在缺乏唯一标识符时共享随机比特是协调的必要而非仅有益条件。现有两类方法各缺一环：修改参数共享/优化动力学的方法（Kaleidoscope 的可学习稀疏掩码、GradPS、pH-MARL）在执行时仍是确定性的，不满足理论要求；自回归方法（MAT、Sable）虽能打破对称，但需 O(N) 推理轮次与外部施加的执行顺序，而在真正去中心化的同质环境中"决定谁先执行"本身就等价于对称打破问题，构成循环论证。本文目标是在单轮广播内实现该随机比特协调协议，并保留集合式注意力带来的队伍规模无关性（零样本可扩展）。

Method: 1) 理论建模：将玩家定义为 Inexhaustible Interactive Turing Machine 机器，含 Compute / Broadcast / Receive / Sample 四个例程；定义同质性（相同输入与相同随机比特下输出相同、消耗比特数相同）。定理 3.4 证明：n 个同质玩家解决广义 XOR 博弈（n 玩家 n 动作）的概率，等于每个玩家生成并共享 k 比特后能就执行顺序达成一致的概率，两者均为 C(2^k,n)·n!/2^(nk)（附录用构造 M' 的经典计数论证给出证明）。
2) 架构 Diamond Attention：任务嵌入（地标/食物/敌方单位的相对位置与属性经两层 MLP+SiLU 投影）与智能体嵌入（本地位置、速度及其他智能体相对位置）之间做交叉注意力。每个智能体每步采样 r_i ~ Uniform[0,1] 追加到观测并单轮广播，用以构造掩码 M_{i,k}=0 若 r_k ≥ r_i，否则 -∞：智能体 i 屏蔽所有排名低于自己的同伴，仅关注同级或更高排名者；任务方向注意力完全不加掩码，保证所有智能体都能访问目标结构。最低排名者关注全部同伴，最高排名者不关注任何同伴、仅按任务结构行动，形成每步动态的临时层级与不对称注意力模式；掩码并行计算，无需顺序通信或外部智能体 ID。整体由三个 Diamond Attention 块组成，输出 V_A 与 V_T 后生成固定长度动作向量；因采用集合式注意力，可接受任意数量智能体与任务。
3) 实现：改写 StableBaselines3 的 PPO 为集中式观测输入 + 共享策略输出 + 共同 critic，使用全局团队奖励；超参数见附录 B（Titan X GPU，64 环境，lr 1e-4 等）。
4) 消融：Ours w/o mask（去掉结构化掩码）与 Ours dropout（用标准 dropout 随机性替代掩码），用于区分"协议空间结构"与"随机噪声"。SMAC 迁移场景中把最后一个 Diamond Attention 块替换为两层线性投影以适配随敌方数量变化的离散动作空间，模型规模不变。

Result: XOR 博弈：本文方法在 n=k=2 与 n=k=3 的直接训练配置下，贪心（π*）与采样（π）两种动作选择均达 1.0 成功率；MAPPO/QMIX/IPPO/MASAC/pH-MARL/GSA 以及两个消融均停在随机动作下限（n=k=2 为 0.5，n=2,k=3 为 0.22）。MAT 在直接训练配置也达 1.0，但在 n=2,k=3→n=3,k=3 迁移上仅 0.44；本文方法在该迁移列上为 0.0，显示其泛化脆弱性。VMAS：N=4 训练后零样本部署 N∈[2,8]，Simple Spread 与 Food Collection 上均保持接近最优且方差低，优于 GSA 与 pH-MARL（两者在未见规模上显著退化）；固定规模基线（MAPPO/QMIX/IPPO/MASAC/MAT）只能在 N=4 评估；Food Collection 中 w/o mask 与完整模型相当，符合"环境自带不对称时掩码冗余"的预期分析。SMACLite：2s3z 训练、3s5z 零样本，本文方法 49.7% 胜率，所有标准基线因固定头动作空间约束迁移失败（0%），w/o mask（训练场景降至 0.832）与 dropout 消融迁移均为 0%。总体结论：确定性架构无法突破对称协调任务的随机动作下限，结构化随机性可以；起作用的成分是协议空间的随机序结构，而非一般随机噪声；分布内环境不对称与协议不对称可互换，但跨分布失效时只有协议空间不对称存活。

Conclusion: 本文把分布式计算中的"随机比特是协调的必要条件"（Case et al. 2005）操作化为一个 MARL 架构原语：Diamond Attention 用每步标量随机数诱导的秩序掩码，在单轮广播内完成对称打破，代价仅为分布式理论中的最小通信量，且不依赖外部排序、顺序执行或唯一标识符。其集合式注意力设计进一步提供队伍规模解耦的零样本可扩展性（VMAS 上训练 N=4 泛化到 2–8，SMACLite 上跨场景迁移）。核心洞见是：协调所需的不对称既可来自环境也可来自协议，二者在分布内可互换，但在分布偏移（部署统计变化）时唯有协议空间不对称有效；消融（去掉掩码、换成 dropout 均 0%）支持了这一论点。局限包括：为适配 SMAC 可变动作空间而以线性投影替换末层 Diamond Attention 块，牺牲了训练场景性能（0.832 vs 1.000）；PPO 在 n>5 的 XOR 规模上因奖励稀疏仍不收敛，属学习能力瓶颈而非架构缺陷，可由离策略或课程学习缓解；协议假设单时间步内的广播模型，严格点对点部署需额外共识层。作者亦坦承双重用途风险（内部随机协调状态较难被对手预测或干扰，对自治对抗集群同样有吸引力），认为底层机制通用、缺乏干净的缓解方案。

Abstract: Full parameter sharing is standard in cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) for homogeneous agents. Under permutation-symmetric observations, however, a shared deterministic policy outputs identical action distributions for every agent, making role differentiation impossible. This failure can theoretically be resolved using symmetry breaking among anonymous identical processors, which requires randomness. We propose Diamond Attention, a cross-attention architecture in which each agent samples a scalar random number per timestep, inducing a transient rank ordering that masks lower-ranked peers from agent-to-agent attention while leaving task attention fully unmasked. This realizes a random-bit coordination protocol in a single broadcast round, and the set-based attention enables zero-shot deployment to teams of different sizes. We evaluate across three regimes that isolate when structured randomness matters. On the perfectly symmetric XOR game, our method achieves $1.0$ success while all deterministic baselines plateau near $0.5$. On control coordination tasks, a policy trained on $N=4$ generalizes zero-shot to $N \in [2,8]$. On SMACLite cross-scenario transfer, we achieve zero-shot transfer where standard baselines cannot transfer due to structural limitations. Furthermore, replacing the structured mask with standard dropout-based randomness results in a 0\% win rate, confirming that protocol-space structure, not stochastic noise, is the operative ingredient. https://anonymous.4open.science/r/randomness-137A/

</details>


### [444] [Extracting Search Trees from LLM Reasoning Traces Reveals Myopic Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06840)
*Sixing Chen,Ji-An Li,Saner Cakir,Sinan Akcali,Kayla Lee,Marcelo G. Mattar*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文通过分析四子棋游戏中LLM推理轨迹提取搜索树，揭示LLM规划与人类规划的关键差异：LLM搜索深度浅于人类，性能由搜索广度而非深度决定，且LLM不会真正利用深层前瞻节点进行决策，而人类的规划能力主要由深层搜索驱动。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前研究对LLM生成的扩展思维链(CoT)推理是否构成真正的规划、其结构如何、以及哪些方面驱动性能表现理解不足。之前研究主要关注输入输出行为，缺乏对推理过程中规划结构本身的深入分析。

Method: 1) 在四子棋游戏中从LLM推理轨迹中提取并量化搜索树；2) 通过计算模型拟合搜索树来表征规划结构；3) 设计因果干预实验，选择性剪枝CoT段落验证因果关系。

Result: 1) LLM搜索深度比人类更浅；2) 性能由搜索广度而非深度预测；3) 尽管LLM扩展了深层节点，但移动决策最佳解释模型是完全忽略这些深层节点的短视模型；4) 因果干预实验进一步表明移动选择主要由浅层节点驱动。5) 人类规划则主要由深层搜索驱动。

Conclusion: LLM规划与人类规划存在关键差异：人类专长由深层搜索驱动，而LLM不会真正利用深层前瞻。这一发现为对齐LLM与人类规划能力提供了针对性指导，同时该框架为跨战略领域解释LLM规划结构提供了通用方法。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs), especially reasoning models, generate extended chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning that often contains explicit deliberation over future outcomes. Yet whether this deliberation constitutes genuine planning, how it is structured, and what aspects of it drive performance remain poorly understood. In this work, we introduce a new method to characterize LLM planning by extracting and quantifying search trees from reasoning traces in the four-in-a-row board game. By fitting computational models on the extracted search trees, we characterize how plans are structured and how they influence move decisions. We find that LLMs' search is shallower than humans', and that performance is predicted by search breadth rather than depth. Most strikingly, although LLMs expand deep nodes in their traces, their move choices are best explained by a myopic model that ignores those nodes entirely. A causal intervention study where we selectively prune CoT paragraphs further suggests that move selection is driven predominantly by shallow rather than deep nodes. These patterns contrast with human planning, where performance is driven primarily by deep search. Together, our findings reveal a key difference between LLM and human planning: while human expertise is driven by deeper search, LLMs do not act on deep lookahead. This dissociation offers targeted guidance for aligning LLM and human planning. More broadly, our framework provides a generalizable approach for interpreting the structure of LLM planning across strategic domains.

</details>


### [445] [Multi-Objective Constraint Inference using Inverse reinforcement learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06951)
*Syed Ihtesham Hussain Shah,Floris den Hengst,Aneta Lisowska,Annette ten Teije*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: MOCI是一个从异构专家轨迹中联合提取共享约束和个人偏好的新框架，解决了现有方法假设同质化演示、难以捕捉个体偏好及计算效率低的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有约束推理方法存在三个主要局限：(1)假设演示数据来自单一或目标相同的多专家；(2)难以捕捉个体偏好差异；(3)计算效率有限。这限制了方法在现实场景中的适用性，因为真实世界中往往存在具有不同目标的多个专家。

Method: 提出Multi-Objective Constraint Inference (MOCI)框架，核心思想是：(1)从多个目标各异的专家轨迹中联合学习共享约束和个人偏好；(2)有效建模和学习多样化、甚至冲突的行为模式；(3)在标准网格世界基准上验证性能。

Result: 实验结果表明：显著优于现有基线方法，预测性能大幅提升，计算效率具有竞争力。

Conclusion: MOCI是一种准确、灵活且计算实用的方法，可用于现实世界的约束推理和偏好学习任务。

Abstract: Constraint inference is widely considered essential to align reinforcement learning agents with safety boundaries and operational guidelines by observing expert demonstrations. However, existing approaches typically assume homogeneous demonstrations (i.e., generated by a single expert or multiple experts with identical objectives). They also have limited ability to capture individual preferences and often suffer from computational inefficiencies. In this paper, we introduce Multi-Objective Constraint Inference (MOCI), a novel framework designed to jointly extract shared constraints and individual preferences from heterogeneous expert trajectories, where multiple experts pursue different objectives. MOCI effectively models and learns from diverse, and potentially conflicting, behaviors. Empirical evaluations demonstrate that MOCI significantly outperforms existing baselines, achieving improved predictive performance, and maintaining competitive computational efficiency on a standard grid-world benchmark. These results establish MOCI as an accurate, flexible, and computationally practical approach for real-world constraint inference and preference learning tasks.

</details>


### [446] [AGWM: Affordance-Grounded World Models for Environments with Compositional Prerequisites](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06841)
*Qinshi Zhang,Weipeng Deng,Zhihan Jiang,Jiaming Qu,Qianren Li,Weitao Xu,Ray LC*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文针对模型预测中动作执行前提条件被忽视的问题，提出AGWM框架，通过学习动作前提依赖的有向无环图(DAG)结构来显式追踪动作的动态可执行性，从而在多步预测中降低误差累积。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统世界模型假设状态转移是平稳的，但在交互环境中，动作的可执行性是动态变化的——某些动作需要满足前置条件才能执行，或当前提被破坏后变得不可执行（SC事件）。这种动态性导致模型在每一步预测中都基于错误的可执行性假设，误差随 rollout 长度不断累积放大。

Method: 提出AGWM（Affordance-Grounded World Model），学习一个抽象的affordance结构，用有向无环图（DAG）表示动作间的先决依赖关系。该DAG显式建模动作的执行条件，从而在预测时能够追踪当前状态下哪些动作是可执行的。

Result: 在基于游戏的模拟环境中验证了该方法的有效性：多步预测误差更低，对新颖配置的泛化能力更强，且具有更好的可解释性。

Conclusion: 通过显式建模动作的动态可执行性，AGWM能够有效解决传统世界模型在长时序预测中的误差累积问题，为模型预测与策略学习提供了更可靠的 imagination 基础。

Abstract: In model-based learning, the agent learns behaviors by simulating trajectories based on world model predictions. Standard world models typically learn a stationary transition function that maps states and actions to next states, when an action and an outcome frequently co-occur in training data, the model tends to internalize this correlation as a general causal rule while ignoring action preconditions. In interactive environments, however, agent actions can reshape the future affordance space. At each timestep, an action may becomes executable only after its prerequisites are met, or non-executable when they are destroyed. We term such events structure-changing events (SC events). As a result, a conventional world model often fails to determine whether a given action is executable in the current state, especially in multi-step predictions. Each imagined step is conditioned on an incorrect affordance state, and therefore the prediction error compounds over the rollout horizon. In this paper, we propose AGWM (Affordance-Grounded World Model), which learns an abstract affordance structure represented as a DAG of prerequisite dependencies to explicitly track the dynamic executability of actions. Experiments on game-based simulated environments demonstrate the effectiveness of our method by achieving lower multi-step prediction error, better generalization to novel configurations, and improved interpretability.

</details>


### [447] [Agentick: A Unified Benchmark for General Sequential Decision-Making Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06869)
*Roger Creus Castanyer,Pablo Samuel Castro,Glen Berseth*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Agentick 是一个面向「通用序贯决策」的统一评测基准：37 个程序化生成的 2D 网格世界任务，分为 6 个能力类别（导航、规划、推理、记忆、泛化、多智能体）、4 个难度等级，并通过统一的 Gymnasium 接口同时输出 5 种观测模态（ASCII 字符网格、自然语言描述、结构化字典、512×512 等距像素渲染、numpy 状态数组）。基准自带 Coding API、全任务 oracle 参考策略、120K/250K/500K 条 SFT 轨迹数据集、可组合 agent harness 与公开排行榜。在 31 种配置、108,550 条回合的大规模评测中，无单一范式占优：SFT-250k 以 0.447 ONS 领先整体，GPT-5 mini 在泛化上领先（0.437），PPO 在多智能体协调上领先（0.432）；推理型 harness 使冻结 LLM 性能提升 3–10 倍；ASCII 观测始终优于自然语言。作者认为该基准最核心的潜在价值在于作为「基础模型 RL 后训练」的真正序贯环境训练场。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前智能体研究横跨两大范式：从零开始交互学习的深度 RL（PPO/DQN/SAC），以及依赖互联网规模预训练先验的基础模型智能体（LLM/VLM，通过提示工程与推理时扩展做零样本决策），中间还有 FM 引导的奖励塑形、FM 后训练 RL、FM 技能发现等混合设计。二者在任务语义、程序化实例、动作语义与指标上并未统一，导致"从交互中学习"与"利用预训练知识"各需多少才能构建完全胜任的自主智能体这一问题无法被公平回答。已有基准各偏一端：ALE、DM Control、bsuite、MiniGrid、MiniHack、Crafter、NetHack、Procgen 主要面向 RL；BALROG 仅把 6 个已有游戏包装为文本/视觉接口而无新任务、无能力分解、无统一评分；ARC-AGI-3 支持 RL+LLM 但只有单一聚合分与私有 SDK；RLVR 类环境（MATH、GSM8K、SWE-bench、Reasoning Gym）回合单步、转移完全确定，无部分可观测性、随机动力学或多智能体交互，无法暴露多步信用分配与探索等核心序贯难题。因此需要一个能在同一任务、同一随机种子、同一度量下横向比较 RL / LLM / VLM / 混合 / 人类智能体的基准。

Method: 设计遵循四原则：(1) 范式跨度接口——每个状态同时产出 5 种同步观测；(2) 能力分解——沿 6 个维度给出诊断性评分而非单一总分；(3) 训练优先——可向量化环境、编程式 Coding API（空间查询、BFS 寻路、实体查找、动作原语）、全 37 任务 oracle 策略、HuggingFace 上的预建 SFT 数据集；(4) 受控难度——4 档难度由种子化生成器参数区间决定（网格尺寸、物体数、约束复杂度、回合长度），每种子布局唯一。核心指标为 Oracle-Normalized Score（ONS）=(agent_return − random)/(oracle_return − random)，按 (任务,难度) 对计算后按类别与总体算术平均；评测用 SHA-256("{task}::{difficulty}::eval") 派生的 25 个确定性种子（共 3,700 回合/智能体），另设每任务-难度 2,000 个训练种子池，报告 95% bootstrap 置信区间。智能体侧提供可组合 harness：BaseAgent = ModelBackend（OpenAI/Gemini/HF/vLLM）× HarnessPreset（系统提示、观测格式化、历史管理、推理激发、动作解析），内置 Markovian（仅当前观测，直接输出动作）与 Markovian Reasoner（加简洁 CoT）两种无记忆预设。实验覆盖冻结前沿 LLM（GPT-5 mini、Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite、Claude Haiku 4.5，temperature 0、ASCII + Reasoner）、从像素从零训练的 PPO（Stable-Baselines3，512×512 等距渲染重采样至 84×84 灰度、4 帧堆叠，dense/sparse 奖励，500k/2M 步，148 个单任务策略）、开源 Qwen3/Qwen3.5 系列（0.8B–4B，vLLM 服务，{ASCII, language} × {Markovian, Reasoner} 全组合），以及对 Qwen3.5-4B 用 oracle 状态-动作样本做 rank-16 LoRA SFT（120k/250k，2 epoch，仅 ASCII 状态+动作，无 CoT）。

Result: 总体排名：SFT-250k 0.447 ONS（CI [.38,.52]）> SFT-120k 0.354 > 冻结 GPT-5 mini 0.309 > 像素 PPO(2M) 0.287 > 冻结 Qwen3.5-4B(Reasoner) 0.228 > PPO(500k) 0.226 > Gemini 2.5 FL 0.187 > Qwen3.5-2B 0.133 > Qwen3.5-0.8B 0.094 > Qwen3-4B 0.085；最佳者仍不到 oracle 上限的一半。能力分解显示互补性：SFT-250k 领先导航(.568)、规划(.557)、推理(.445)、记忆(.413)；GPT-5 mini 领先泛化(.437)；PPO 领先多智能体(.432)，且 GPT-5 mini 多智能体仅 .150、PPO 导航仅 .250。hard 难度下前沿模型无绝对赢家（Haiku 4.5 在 ResourceManagement .76 vs GPT-5 mini .12；ToolUse 三模型 .96–1.0），而 GraphColoring、LightsOut、SwitchCircuit、ProgramSynthesis、SymbolMatching 全部 0.0 成功率，说明纯提示难以完成系统搜索与状态跟踪。harness 效应：Markovian Reasoner 对所有模型与模态带来 3–10× 增益（Qwen3.5-4B 0.023→0.228；0.8B 0.020→0.094），且 ASCII 稳定优于语言（4B: .228 vs .181），0.8B 反而优于参数多 5 倍的 Qwen3-4B(.094 vs .085)。SFT：Markovian ONS 0.0232→0.3544(120k)/0.4466(250k)，Reasoner 0.2280→0.3489/0.4436，120k→250k 再提升 .0922/.0947，且冻结模型 direct 与 Reasoner 间 .2048 的差距在 SFT 后收敛至 .0030；泛化(.350)与多智能体(.348)仍是行为克隆之外方法的主要机会。PPO 训练呈近平稳：任务均衡平滑成功率 500k/1M/1.5M/2M 为 .243/.329/.377/.393，末段增益仅 +.016；难度上所有 agent 严格退化（easy→expert 平均成功率 .548→.173，下降 68.3%，SFT-250k 退化最小 53.1%，PPO 2M 退化最大 82.8%）。

Conclusion: Agentick 的核心贡献不是"选出最佳智能体"，而是把任务语义、程序化实例、动作语义与指标对齐到同一环境契约之上，从而揭示不同范式的互补能力剖面，并证明推理时策略（harness 设计）与观测表示是与模型规模同等重要的一等变量——这只有依靠共享任务、种子与指标才能做受控对比。工程上它同时是评测框架（雷达图能力剖面、排行榜）与训练基座（oracle 演示热启动、向量化环境、Foundation 模型的 RL 后训练）。作者明确指出当前局限：任务限于离散 2D 回合制，能力类别为非排他性诊断分组而非验证过的认知分类法，oracle 在含随机性任务上不保证全局最优，多智能体对手为脚本策略而非学习所得，各范式间未做算力/监督/模态对齐，且尚未评测 VLM、混合 RL/FM 智能体与旗舰前沿模型；算力上 PPO 约 150 GPU-hours（A100），Qwen vLLM 推理约 200 GPU-hours，前沿 API 约 $290，oracle 数据生成约 8 CPU-hours。值得注意的是摘要（27 配置、>90,000 回合、GPT-5 mini 以 0.309 居首）与正文（31 配置、108,550 回合、SFT-250k 以 0.447 居首）存在版本不一致，属论文修订未同步的编辑性问题。

Abstract: AI agent research spans a wide spectrum: from RL agents that learn from scratch to foundation model agents that leverage pre-trained knowledge, yet no unified benchmark enables fair comparison across these approaches. We present Agentick, a benchmark for sequential decision-making agents designed to evaluate RL, LLM, VLM, hybrid, and human agents on common ground and to power research on the fundamental challenges of sequential decision-making. Agentick provides 37 procedurally generated tasks across six capability categories, four difficulty levels, and five observation modalities, all exposed through a single Gymnasium-compatible interface. The benchmark ships with a Coding API, oracle reference policies for all tasks, pre-built SFT datasets, a composable agent harness, and a live leaderboard. An evaluation spanning 27 configurations and over 90,000 episodes reveals that no single approach dominates: GPT-5 mini leads overall at 0.309 oracle-normalized score while PPO dominates planning and multi-agent tasks; the reasoning harness multiplies LLM performance by 3-10x; and ASCII observations consistently outperform natural language. These findings highlight the substantial room for improvement that remains across all agent paradigms. Agentick's capability-decomposed, multi-modal design provides the empirical infrastructure needed to drive progress toward general autonomous agents, both as an evaluation framework and as a training ground for RL post-training of foundation models in truly sequential environments.

</details>


### [448] [ARMOR: An Agentic Framework for Reaction Feasibility Prediction via Adaptive Utility-aware Multi-tool Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07103)
*Ye Liu,Botao Yu,Xinyi Ling,Daniel Adu-Ampratwum,Xia Ning*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ARMOR 是一个面向“反应可行性预测”的智能体（agentic）多工具协同框架：显式建模各工具的“效用（utility）”，先用验证集上表现最好的工具（层级一）做初始判定，若冲突则依据工具特有的“反应模式（pattern）”自适应挑选 top-L 工具，再通过基于对比性示例的记忆增强推理（memory-augmented reasoning）裁决工具冲突。在 FREA 数据集（12,000 条，验证/测试各 6,000，13 个工具）上，ARMOR 取得 91.62% 总体准确率与 0.8323 MCC，显著优于最强单工具 BERT（87.90%）与最强基线 HarderMoE（89.50%），且在工具预测冲突的困难样本上增益最大（+6.89%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 1) 单一工具不可靠：不同工具在不同反应上表现差异巨大——分类式预测器（BERT）在结构规整反应上较好，LLM 推理类工具在需复杂化学推理的反应上更好；理论上限（任一工具预测正确即算对）达 99.90% 准确率，说明工具高度互补。2) 既有“多工具”方法（多数投票、加权投票、DES、KNORA、HarderMoE、ToolEyes）依赖简单聚合或启发式分配，属于隐式能力估计，未刻画“哪个工具在哪类反应上更适用”，易产生系统性偏差（多数工具共有的错误无法纠正）。3) 现有 LLM 智能体研究多聚焦于为不同子目标编排功能各异的工具，而“用多个功能相同的工具解决单一任务”（尤其在领域专属性任务上）仍属空白。本文首次提出显式建模工具效用的方向。

Method: 任务形式化：给定反应 r=(S→D) 与工具集 T={t_i}，输出二分类可行性。

三模块框架：
(1) 工具层级构建（Sec 3.1）：在验证集上以准确率对 13 个工具排序，前 ρ=25%（BERT、Molecular、DRFP）进入一级 T^(1) 承担初始决策，其余进入二级 T^(2) 提供互补/专业化证据。
(2) 效用感知工具优先级（Sec 3.2）：在“ T^(1) 预测不一致”的验证集子集 R_v^¬(1) 上，为每个工具构造 M=100 个诊断子集 {r11, r10, r01, r00}（真值×工具预测四象限，N∈{5,10,25,45}）；由 LLM 抽取模式 P_t=(描述 d_t、解释 e_t、样例集 X_t)；用 Align（样例集内正确率）与 Cov（覆盖率）阈值 τ1=τ2=1 精炼；合并同名模式后在整个 R_v^¬(1) 上计算 Conf（该模式覆盖反应中被正确预测的比例），保留 Conf≥τ3=0.5 的 top-5 模式。推理时若 T^(1) 无共识，则匹配覆盖新反应的模式，取每个工具覆盖该反应的置信度最高模式 P*_t(r′)，按 Conf 选出 top-L=5 工具 T^(s)(r′)；若仍一致则直接输出，否则进入冲突消解。
(3) 工具冲突消解（Sec 3.3）：构建冲突记忆 M，对每个难例存储对比实例 x_{r,t+}={r, t+（预测正确工具）, P*_{t+}, {t-}（预测错误工具）, {P*_{t-}}}，并由 LLM 生成“为何 t+ 优于 t-”的推理依据 G；推理时用 DRFP 反应指纹检索 top-K=8 个最相似反应，各随机取一条对比实例作少样本示例，提示 LLM 结合所选工具及其模式输出最终选定工具与预测。

实现：骨干 LLM 为 T3Q-Qwen-14B（do_sample=False）；数据来自 FREA（源自 USPTO，含经化学动机扰动生成的不可行反应），验证集 6,000/测试集 6,000，工具训练数据与评测数据严格无重叠（无训练集，避免数据泄漏）；工具含 3 个分类器、2 个前向生成模型、8 个 LLM 推理器；2×A100；基线覆盖单工具、统计聚合、动态选择（DES/KNORA/HarderMoE）与 LLM 选择（ToolEyes、GPT-5.4-mini、DeepSeek-v4-flash、Claude-Sonnet-4.6）。

Result: 总体：ARMOR 91.62% ACC（可行 91.57%、不可行 91.67%）、F1 91.61/91.62、MCC 0.8323，为全场最佳，且类间均衡；对比最强基线 HarderMoE 89.50%（+2.12）、ToolEyes 87.25、Claude-Sonnet-4.6 85.55、最强单工具 BERT 87.90、多数投票 82.88、加权投票 86.35；多数/加权投票未能超过最强单工具，KNORA-U、DES 系列甚至低于多数投票；ToolEyes/Claude 在不可行类高（94.77%/96.53%）但可行类偏低（87.25%/74.57%），存在明显类偏倚。

消融：逐步移除组件性能单调下降——去掉冲突消解明显下降，再去掉效用感知优先级进一步下降，去掉工具层级（退化为全局多数投票）降幅最大，说明三层结构均有贡献。

分类别增益（对 HarderMoE）：T^(1) 已一致 4,328 例（72.13%）仅 +0.26；经模式选择后一致 569 例（9.48%）+7.03；仍冲突 1,103 例（18.38%）+6.89，增益主要来自冲突/困难样本。

演示数 K 影响：0→90.80、2→91.12、4→91.30、8→91.62，K 增大带来更均衡结果（K=2 可行类最好，K=8 不可行类显著提升）。

工具选择分布：在 1,103 例冲突集中，一级工具 DRFP 从未被选、Molecular 仅 4 次，而二级工具 Chemformer_Llama 被选 490 次（其上准确率 77.35% vs 全测集 60.55%）、ICL_Llama 162 次（80.25% vs 55.12%）、ICL_T3Q 仅 17 次但准确率 100%；1.00% 案例无可选工具而退化为直接询问 LLM。局限：依赖带标签验证集；1% 失败样本；BERT 在其被选冲突样本上准确率低于全测集，说明最强全局工具在难例中的利用仍有改进空间。

Conclusion: 显式建模工具效用并结合冲突消解，是把“多个功能相同但强弱不一的工具”组合成可靠决策器的有效路径：相比隐式路由（HarderMoE）或统计聚合，ARMOR 在整体与类间均衡性上均更优，且在工具持续冲突的少数困难样本上收益最大，证明“工具互补性”必须被显式刻画而非隐式路由。作者指出该框架可推广到分子逆合成、个性化内容生成与推荐等“不同工具在不同输入上表现不一”的任务；未来方向包括利用自身预测结果作弱监督实现工具效用的在线持续更新，并建议在高风险科学场景中采用 human-in-the-loop 的专家验证。

Abstract: Reaction feasibility prediction, as a fundamental problem in computational chemistry, has benefited from diverse tools enabled by recent advances in artificial intelligence, particularly large language models. However, the performance of individual tools varies substantially across reactions, making it difficult for any single tool to consistently perform well across all cases. This raises a critical challenge: how to effectively leverage multiple tools to obtain more accurate feasibility predictions. To address this, we propose ARMOR, an agentic framework that explicitly models tool-specific utilities, adaptively prioritizes tools, and further resolves the potential tool conflicts to produce the final prediction for each reaction. Unlike existing approaches that rely on simple aggregation or heuristic assignment over various tools, ARMOR organizes tools into a hierarchy that prioritizes top-performing tools and defers others when needed, characterizes their strengths through tool-specific patterns, and resolves conflicts via memoryaugmented reasoning.
